sourceRange.text: 元年春正月辛丑，即天王位。柴燎告天，朝百官於路門。追尊皇考文公為文王，皇妣為文后。大赦天下。封魏帝為宋公。是日，槐里獻赤雀四。百官奏議云：「帝王之興，罔弗更正朔，明受之於天，革民視聽也。逮於尼父，稽諸陰陽，云行夏之時，後王所不易。今魏曆告終，周室受命，以木承水，實當行錄，正用夏時，式遵聖道。惟文王誕玄氣之祥，有黑水之讖，服色宜烏。」制曰可。以大司徒、趙郡公李弼為太師，大宗伯、南陽公趙貴為太傅、大冢宰，大司馬、河內公獨孤信為太保、大宗伯，柱國、中山公護為大司馬。以大將軍寧都公毓、高陽公達奚武、武陽公豆盧寧、小司寇陽平公李遠、小司馬博陵公賀蘭祥、小宗伯魏安公尉遲迥等並柱國。

context.beforeSource: 是日，魏帝遜于大司馬府。
context.afterSource: 壬寅，祠圓丘。
context.beforeLocal: 是日，魏帝遜于大司馬府。
context.afterLocal: 壬寅，祠圓丘。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Down to the Master, when he examined yin and yang, he said to follow the seasons of Xia—a rule later kings did not alter.

sourceRange.text: 高祖武皇帝諱邕，字禰羅突，太祖第四子也。母曰叱奴太后。大統九年，生於同州，有神光照室。幼而孝敬，聰敏有器質。太祖異之，曰：「成吾志者，必此兒也。」年十二，封輔城郡公。孝閔帝踐阼，拜大將軍，出鎮同州。世宗即位，遷柱國，授蒲州諸軍事、蒲州刺史。武成元年，入為大司空、治御正，進封魯國公，領宗師。甚為世宗所親愛，朝廷大事，多共參議。性沉深有遠識，非因顧問，終不輒言。世宗每歎曰：「夫人不言，言必有中。

context.afterSource: 」武成二年夏四月，世宗崩，遺詔傳帝位於高祖。

sourceRange.text: __NOCC__宣皇帝諱贇，字乾伯，高祖長子也。母曰李太后。武成元年，生於同州。保定元年五月丙午，封魯國公。建德元年四月癸巳，高祖親告廟，冠於阼階，立為皇太子。詔皇太子巡撫西土。文宣皇后崩，高祖諒闇，詔太子總朝政，五旬而罷。高祖每巡幸四方，太子常留監國。五年二月，又詔皇太子巡西土，因討吐谷渾。宣政元年六月丁酉，高祖崩。戊戌，皇太子即皇帝位，尊皇后為皇太后。癸丑，歲星、熒惑、太白合於東井。甲子，誅上柱國、齊王憲。封開府于智為齊國公。

items.sourceTextOverride: 大象元年春正月癸巳，受朝於露門，帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，羣臣皆服漢魏衣冠。大赦，改元大成。初置四輔官，以上柱國大冢宰越王盛為大前疑，相州總管蜀國公尉遲迥為大右弼，申國公李穆為大左輔，大司馬隨國公楊堅為大後丞。癸卯，封皇子衍為魯王。甲辰，東巡狩。丙午，日有背。以柱國、常山公于翼為大司徒。辛亥，以柱國、許國公宇文善為大宗伯。癸丑，日又背。戊午，行幸洛陽。立魯王衍為皇太子。

sourceRange.text: 孝閔帝元皇后名胡摩，魏文帝第五女。初封晉安公主。帝之為略陽公也，尚焉。及踐祚，立為王后。帝被廢，后出俗為尼。建德初，高祖誅晉國公護，上帝尊號為孝閔帝，以后為孝閔皇后，居崇義宮。隋氏革命，后出居里第。大業十二年，殂。

sourceRange.text: 隋文帝詔有司備禮冊，祔葬於孝陵。武帝李皇后名娥姿，楚人也。于謹平江陵，后家被籍沒。至長安，太祖以后賜高祖，後稍得親幸。大象元年二月，改為天元帝太后。七月，又尊為天皇太后。二年，尊為天元聖皇太后。冊曰：「天元皇帝臣贇，奉璽綬冊，謹上天皇太后尊號曰天元聖皇太后。伏惟月精効祉，坤靈表貺，瑞肇丹陵，慶流華渚。雖率由令典，夙奉徽號，而因心盡敬，未極尊名。是用思弘稱首，上昭聖德，敢竭誠敬，永綏福履。顯揚慈訓，貽厥孫謀。」宣帝崩，靜帝尊為太帝太后。隋開皇元年三月，出俗為尼，改名常悲。八年殂，年五十三，以尼禮葬于京城南。

sourceRange.text: 后父山提本高氏之隸。仕齊，官至特進、開府、東兗州刺史、謝陽王。高祖平齊，拜大將軍，封（浙）〔淅〕陽郡公。大象元年，以后父超授上柱國，進封鄅國公，除大宗伯。宣帝元皇后名樂尚，河南洛陽人也。開府晟之第二女。年十五，被選入宮，拜為貴妃。大象元年七月，立為天右皇后。二年二月，改為天右大皇后。冊曰：「咨爾資靈姜水，載德塗山，懿淑內融，徽音潛暢。是用加茲寵數，式光踐禮。爾其聿修儀範，肅膺顯冊，祗承休命，可不慎歟。」帝崩，后出俗為尼，改名華勝。初，后與陳后同時被選入宮，俱拜為妃，及升后位，又同日受冊，帝寵遇二后，禮數均等，年齒復同，特相親愛。及為尼後，李、朱及尉遲后等並相繼殞沒，而二后于今尚存。后父晟，少以元氏宗室，拜開府。大象（末）〔元〕年七月，以后父進位上柱國，封翼國公。

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年，以后父超授上柱國，進封鄅國公，除大宗伯。
manualTranslations.literal: First year of Daxiang, as father of the empress he was exceptionally granted Senior Pillar of State, advanced to Duke of Yu State, and appointed Grand Director of Ceremonial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: First year of Daxiang, as father of the empress he was exceptionally granted Senior Pillar of State, advanced to Duke of Yu State, and appointed Grand Director of Ceremonial.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝元皇后名樂尚，河南洛陽人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Yuan, consort of Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun, was named Yue Shang, a native of Luoyang in Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Yuan, consort of Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun, was named Yue Shang, a native of Luoyang in Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 開府晟之第二女。
manualTranslations.literal: She was the second daughter of opening-the-feudatory Sheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was the second daughter of opening-the-feudatory Sheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十五，被選入宮，拜為貴妃。
manualTranslations.literal: At age fifteen she was selected to enter the palace and appointed Noble Consort.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At age fifteen she was selected to enter the palace and appointed Noble Consort.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年七月，立為天右皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Seventh month of the first year of Daxiang, she was installed as Heavenly Right Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Seventh month of the first year of Daxiang, she was installed as Heavenly Right Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年二月，改為天右大皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Second month of the second year, she was retitled Grand Heavenly Right Empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Second month of the second year, she was retitled Grand Heavenly Right Empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 冊曰：「咨爾資靈姜水，載德塗山，懿淑內融，徽音潛暢。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict of investiture stated: "I address you thus: Your endowment draws upon the spiritual waters of Jiang, your virtue is borne upon Mount Tu; gentle grace inwardly suffuses, and fine renown quietly flows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict of investiture stated: "I address you thus: Your endowment draws upon the spiritual waters of Jiang, your virtue is borne upon Mount Tu; gentle grace inwardly suffuses, and fine renown quietly flows.

manualTranslations.zh: 是用加茲寵數，式光踐禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore I add this measure of favor and extend the splendor of your investiture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Therefore I add this measure of favor and extend the splendor of your investiture.

manualTranslations.zh: 爾其聿修儀範，肅膺顯冊，祗承休命，可不慎歟。」
manualTranslations.literal: Adorn your bearing and walk the model, reverently receive the manifest investiture, respectfully accept this blessed mandate—can you not be careful?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Adorn your bearing and walk the model, reverently receive the manifest investiture, respectfully accept this blessed mandate—can you not be careful?"

manualTranslations.zh: 帝崩，后出俗為尼，改名華勝。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor died, the empress left the lay life to become a nun, changing her name to Huasheng (Floral Victory).
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor died, the empress left the lay life to become a nun, changing her name to Huasheng (Floral Victory).

manualTranslations.zh: 初，后與陳后同時被選入宮，俱拜為妃，及升后位，又同日受冊，帝寵遇二后，禮數均等，年齒復同，特相親愛。
manualTranslations.literal: Initially the empress and Empress Chen were selected together to enter the palace, both appointed as consorts; when elevated to empress rank they received investiture on the same day. The emperor favored both empresses equally in ceremonial treatment; their ages were likewise the same, and they were especially close.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Initially the empress and Empress Chen were selected together to enter the palace, both appointed as consorts; when elevated to empress rank they received investiture on the same day. The emperor favored both empresses equally in ceremonial treatment; their ages were likewise the same, and they were especially close.

manualTranslations.zh: 及為尼後，李、朱及尉遲后等並相繼殞沒，而二后于今尚存。
manualTranslations.literal: After becoming nuns, Empresses Li, Zhu, and Yuchi and others all died in succession, but the two empresses remain alive to this day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After becoming nuns, Empresses Li, Zhu, and Yuchi and others all died in succession, but the two empresses remain alive to this day.

manualTranslations.zh: 后父晟，少以元氏宗室，拜開府。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress's father Sheng, in youth on account of his status in the Yuan imperial clan, was appointed opening-the-feudatory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress's father Sheng, in youth on account of his status in the Yuan imperial clan, was appointed opening-the-feudatory.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象
manualTranslations.literal: Daxiang
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Daxiang

manualTranslations.literal: (end)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (end)

manualTranslations.zh: 〔元〕年七月，以后父進位上柱國，封翼國公。
manualTranslations.literal: first year, seventh month, as father of the empress he was advanced to Senior Pillar of State and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: first year, seventh month, as father of the empress he was advanced to Senior Pillar of State and enfeoffed as Duke of Yi State.

sourceRange.text: 靜帝司馬皇后名令姬，柱國、滎陽公消難之女。大象元年二月，宣帝傳位於帝，七月，為帝納為皇后。冊曰：「坤道成形，厚德於焉載物；陰精迭運，重光所以麗天。在昔皇王，膺乾御曆，內政為助，昭被圖篆。惟爾門積慶靈，家韜休烈，徽音令範，無背一時。是用命爾，作儷皇極。爾其克勵婉心，肅膺盛典，追皇、英之逸軌，庶任、姒之芳塵，褘翟有光，粢盛無怠，雖休勿休，以隆嘉祚。」二年九月，隋文帝以后父擁眾奔陳，廢后為庶人。後嫁為隋司（州）〔隸〕刺史李丹妻，于今尚存。

context.beforeSource: 隋開皇十五年，殂，年三十。
context.afterSource: 史臣曰：孔子稱「夷狄之有君，不如諸夏之亡也」。

manualTranslations.zh: 是用命爾，作儷皇極。

sourceRange.text: 其故吏儀同李充信等上表曰：:臣聞資孝成忠，生民高義；旌德樹善，有國常規。竊惟故豳國公臣廣，懿親令望，具瞻攸在，道冠羣后，功懋維城。受脤建斾，威行秦、隴；班條驅傳，化溢崤、函。比腠理舛和，奉詔還闕，藥石所及，沉痾漸愈。而災釁仍集，丁此窮憂，至性過人，遂增舊疾，因茲毀頓，以至薨殂。尋繹貫切，不能自已。

manualTranslations.literal: His former subordinate commissioner-equal Li Chongxin and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that nurturing filial piety completes loyalty, the highest duty among the people;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His former subordinate commissioner-equal Li Chongxin and others submitted a memorial, saying: "We have heard that nurturing filial piety completes loyalty, the highest duty among the people;

manualTranslations.literal: honoring virtue and fostering goodness is a constant rule of state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: honoring virtue and fostering goodness is a constant rule of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 竊惟故豳國公臣廣，懿親令望，具瞻攸在，道冠羣后，功懋維城。
manualTranslations.literal: We venture to consider the late Duke of Bin, subject Guang: an excellent kinsman of fine reputation, the focus of all eyes, whose conduct surpassed the feudal lords and whose merit fortified the realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We venture to consider the late Yuwen Guang, Duke of Bin: an excellent kinsman of fine reputation, the focus of all eyes, whose conduct surpassed the feudal lords and whose merit fortified the realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 受脤建斾，威行秦、隴；
manualTranslations.literal: Receiving the sacrificial flesh and raising his banner, his authority extended through Qin and Long;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Receiving the sacrificial flesh and raising his banner, his authority extended through Qin and Long;

manualTranslations.literal: Recently when his bodily harmony was disturbed, he obeyed an edict and returned to the capital; where medicine reached him, his grave illness gradually improved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently when his bodily harmony was disturbed, he obeyed an edict and returned to the capital; where medicine reached him, his grave illness gradually improved.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet calamities still gathered; meeting this extreme grief, his surpassing filial nature aggravated his old illness, and through this ruin and collapse he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋繹貫切，不能自已。
manualTranslations.literal: Reflecting on this, our grief is penetrating and we cannot restrain ourselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Reflecting on this, our grief is penetrating and we cannot restrain ourselves.

sourceRange.text: 導性寬明，善於撫御，凡所引接，人皆盡誠。臨事敬慎，常若弗及。太祖每出征討，導恆居守，深為吏民所附，朝廷亦以此重之。魏恭帝元年十二月，薨於上邽，年四十四。魏帝遣侍中、漁陽王繩監護喪事。贈本官，加尚書令、秦州刺史，諡曰孝。朝議以導撫和西戎，威恩顯著，欲令世鎮隴右，以彰厥德，乃葬於上邽城西無疆原。華戎會葬有萬餘人，奠祭於路，悲號滿野，皆曰「我君捨我乎」。大小相率，負土成墳，高五十餘尺，周迴八十餘步。為官司所止，然後泣辭而去。其遺愛見思如此。天和五年，重贈太師、柱國、豳國公。導五子，廣、亮、翼、椿、眾。亮、椿並出後於𣏌。廣字乾歸。少方嚴，好文學。初封永昌郡公。孝閔帝踐阼，改封天水郡公。世宗即位，授驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，出為秦州刺史。武成初，進位大將軍，遷梁州總管，進封蔡國公，增邑萬戶。保定初，入為小司寇。尋以本官鎮蒲州，兼知潼關等六防諸軍事。（三）〔二〕年，除秦州總管、十三州諸軍事、秦州刺史。廣性明察，善綏撫，民庶畏而悅之。時晉公護諸子及廣弟𣏌國公亮等，服玩侈靡，踰越制度，廣獨率由禮則，又折節待士，朝野以是稱焉。曾侍食於高祖，所食瓜美，持以奉進，高祖悅之。四年，進位柱國。廣以晉公護久擅威權，勸令挹損，護不能納。天和三年，除陝州總管，以病免。及孝公追封豳國公，詔廣襲爵。

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官，加尚書令、秦州刺史，諡曰孝。
manualTranslations.literal: He was granted his former office and additionally made Minister over the Masses and governor of Qin Province; his posthumous title was Xiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was granted his former office and additionally made Minister over the Masses and governor of Qin Province; his posthumous title was Xiao (Filial).

manualTranslations.zh: 朝議以導撫和西戎，威恩顯著，欲令世鎮隴右，以彰厥德，乃葬於上邽城西無疆原。
manualTranslations.literal: Court discussion held that because Dao had pacified the western Rong and his authority and kindness were prominent, they wished his line to command Longyou for generations to manifest his virtue; he was therefore buried on Wujiang plain west of Shanggui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court held that because Yuwen Dao had pacified the western Rong and his authority and kindness were conspicuous, they wished his line to command Longyou for generations to manifest his virtue; he was therefore buried on Wujiang plain west of Shanggui.

manualTranslations.zh: 華戎會葬有萬餘人，奠祭於路，悲號滿野，皆曰「我君捨我乎」。
manualTranslations.literal: More than ten thousand Chinese and frontier peoples attended the funeral; offerings lined the road and wailing filled the wilds; all cried, "Has our lord abandoned us?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: More than ten thousand Chinese and frontier peoples attended the funeral; offerings lined the road and wailing filled the wilds; all cried, "Has our lord abandoned us?"

manualTranslations.zh: 大小相率，負土成墳，高五十餘尺，周迴八十餘步。
manualTranslations.literal: Young and old together carried earth to form a tumulus more than fifty chi high and more than eighty paces around.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Young and old together carried earth to form a tumulus more than fifty chi high and more than eighty paces around.

manualTranslations.zh: 為官司所止，然後泣辭而去。
manualTranslations.literal: Government officers stopped them; only then did they weep and take their leave.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Government officers stopped them; only then did they weep and take their leave.

manualTranslations.zh: 其遺愛見思如此。
manualTranslations.literal: The affection he left behind and the longing for him were like this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The affection he left behind and the longing for him were like this.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和五年，重贈太師、柱國、豳國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhe (568), he was again posthumously granted Grand Preceptor, pillar-of-state, and Duke of Bin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianhe (568), he was again posthumously granted Grand Preceptor, pillar-of-state, and Duke of Bin.

manualTranslations.zh: 導五子，廣、亮、翼、椿、眾。
manualTranslations.literal: Dao had five sons: Guang, Liang, Yi, Chun, and Zhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Dao had five sons: Guang, Liang, Yi, Chun, and Zhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 亮、椿並出後於杞。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang and Chun were both given in adoption to the Qi line.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang and Chun were both given in adoption to the Qi line.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣字乾歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Guang, style name Qiangui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Guang, style name Qiangui.

manualTranslations.zh: 少方嚴，好文學。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he was stern and proper and loved literature.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he was stern and proper and loved literature.

manualTranslations.zh: 初封永昌郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yongchang commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yongchang commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，改封天水郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin acceded, his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Tianshui commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin Yuwen Jue acceded, his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Tianshui commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗即位，授驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，出為秦州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizong acceded, he was appointed flying-cavalry grand general and commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol, and sent out as governor of Qin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizong Yuwen Yu acceded, he was appointed flying-cavalry grand general and commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol, and sent out as governor of Qin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，進位大將軍，遷梁州總管，進封蔡國公，增邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the early Wucheng era (559), he was advanced to grand general, transferred to governor-general of Liang Province, advanced to Duke of Cai, and his fief was increased by ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the early Wucheng era (559), he was advanced to grand general, transferred to governor-general of Liang Province, advanced to Duke of Cai, and his fief was increased by ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定初，入為小司寇。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Baoding (561), he entered court service as junior minister of justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Baoding (561), he entered court service as junior minister of justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋以本官鎮蒲州，兼知潼關等六防諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon, retaining his office, he garrisoned Pu Province and concurrently directed military affairs at Tong Pass and the six garrisons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon, retaining his office, he garrisoned Pu Province and concurrently directed military affairs at Tong Pass and the six garrisons.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，除秦州總管、十三州諸軍事、秦州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year (562), he was appointed governor-general of Qin Province, commander of military affairs in thirteen provinces, and governor of Qin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year (562), he was appointed governor-general of Qin Province, commander of military affairs in thirteen provinces, and governor of Qin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣性明察，善綏撫，民庶畏而悅之。
manualTranslations.literal: Guang was clear-sighted and skilled at comforting and governing; the people revered and delighted in him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Guang was clear-sighted and skilled at comforting and governing; the people revered and delighted in him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時晉公護諸子及廣弟杞國公亮等，服玩侈靡，踰越制度，廣獨率由禮則，又折節待士，朝野以是稱焉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the sons of Duke of Jin Hu and Guang's younger brother Duke of Qi Liang and others were extravagant in dress and luxuries beyond regulations; Guang alone followed ritual propriety, humbled himself to treat scholars, and court and countryside praised him for it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the sons of Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu and Guang's younger brother Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang and others were extravagant in dress and luxuries beyond regulations; Guang alone followed ritual propriety, humbled himself to treat scholars, and court and countryside praised him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾侍食於高祖，所食瓜美，持以奉進，高祖悅之。
manualTranslations.literal: Once while attending a meal with High Ancestor, he found the melon delicious, held it out to present it, and High Ancestor was pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once while attending a meal with High Ancestor Yuwen Yong, he found the melon delicious, presented it to the emperor, and pleased him.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，進位柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he was advanced to pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, he was advanced to pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣以晉公護久擅威權，勸令挹損，護不能納。
manualTranslations.literal: Guang, because Duke of Jin Hu had long monopolized authority, urged him to restrain himself; Hu could not accept the advice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu had long monopolized authority, Guang urged him to restrain himself; Hu would not heed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和三年，除陝州總管，以病免。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tianhe (568), he was appointed governor-general of Shan Province and was dismissed because of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianhe (568), he was appointed governor-general of Shan Province and was dismissed because of illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 及孝公追封豳國公，詔廣襲爵。
manualTranslations.literal: When Duke Xiao was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Bin, an edict summoned Guang to inherit the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Duke Xiao was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Bin, an edict summoned Yuwen Guang to inherit the title.

items.sourceTextOverride: 導性寬明，善於撫御，凡所引接，人皆盡誠。臨事敬慎，常若弗及。太祖每出征討，導恆居守，深為吏民所附，朝廷亦以此重之。魏恭帝元年十二月，薨於上邽，年四十四。魏帝遣侍中、漁陽王繩監護喪事。贈本官，加尚書令、秦州刺史，諡曰孝。朝議以導撫和西戎，威恩顯著，欲令世鎮隴右，以彰厥德，乃葬於上邽城西無疆原。華戎會葬有萬餘人，奠祭於路，悲號滿野，皆曰「我君捨我乎」。大小相率，負土成墳，高五十餘尺，周迴八十餘步。為官司所止，然後泣辭而去。其遺愛見思如此。天和五年，重贈太師、柱國、豳國公。導五子，廣、亮、翼、椿、眾。亮、椿並出後於杞。廣字乾歸。少方嚴，好文學。初封永昌郡公。孝閔帝踐阼，改封天水郡公。世宗即位，授驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，出為秦州刺史。武成初，進位大將軍，遷梁州總管，進封蔡國公，增邑萬戶。保定初，入為小司寇。尋以本官鎮蒲州，兼知潼關等六防諸軍事。二年，除秦州總管、十三州諸軍事、秦州刺史。廣性明察，善綏撫，民庶畏而悅之。時晉公護諸子及廣弟杞國公亮等，服玩侈靡，踰越制度，廣獨率由禮則，又折節待士，朝野以是稱焉。曾侍食於高祖，所食瓜美，持以奉進，高祖悅之。四年，進位柱國。廣以晉公護久擅威權，勸令挹損，護不能納。天和三年，除陝州總管，以病免。及孝公追封豳國公，詔廣襲爵。

sourceRange.text: 興生，兵亂，與仲相失，年又冲幼，莫知其戚屬遠近。與太祖兄弟，初不相識。齊神武寇沙苑，興預在行間，軍敗被虜，隨例散配諸軍。興性弘厚，有志度，雖流離世故，而風範可觀。魏恭帝二年，舉賢良，除本郡丞，徙長𨻽縣令。保定二年，詔仲子興始附屬籍。高祖以興宗戚近屬，尊禮之甚厚，拜使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、都督，封大寧郡公。尋除宗師中大夫。四年，出為涇州刺史。五年，又徵拜宗師，加大將軍，襲爵虞國公。天和二年薨，高祖親臨，慟焉。詔大司空、申國公李穆監護喪事。贈使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、恆幽等六州諸軍事、恆州刺史，諡曰靖。子洛嗣。

context.afterSource: 洛字永洛。

manualTranslations.zh: 興生，兵亂，與仲相失，年又冲幼，莫知其戚屬遠近。
manualTranslations.literal: Xing was born amid military turmoil; he was separated from Zhong while still very young and did not know the nearness or distance of his kinship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xing was born amid military turmoil; he was separated from Zhong while still very young and did not know the nearness or distance of his kinship.

manualTranslations.zh: 與太祖兄弟，初不相識。
manualTranslations.literal: He and the Grand Progenitor's brothers at first did not know one another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He and Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai's brothers at first did not know one another.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武寇沙苑，興預在行間，軍敗被虜，隨例散配諸軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Duke of Qi Shenwu attacked Shayuan, Xing was among the ranks; the army was defeated and he was taken captive, and by precedent was dispersed and assigned to various armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan, Duke of Qi Shenwu, attacked Shayuan, Xing was among the ranks; the army was defeated and he was taken captive, and by precedent was dispersed and assigned to various armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 興性弘厚，有志度，雖流離世故，而風範可觀。
manualTranslations.literal: Xing's nature was broad and generous, with purpose and measure; though adrift through worldly vicissitudes, his bearing was admirable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xing was broad and generous by nature, with breadth of purpose; though adrift through worldly vicissitudes, his bearing was admirable.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝二年，舉賢良，除本郡丞，徙長𨻽縣令。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wei Emperor Gong (555), he was recommended as worthy and good, appointed assistant administrator of his home commandery, and transferred to magistrate of Changshi county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Western Wei Emperor Gong (555), he was recommended as worthy and good, appointed assistant administrator of his home commandery, and transferred to magistrate of Changshi county.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定二年，詔仲子興始附屬籍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Baoding (562), an edict had Zhong's son Xing entered on the clan register.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoding (562), an edict had Zhong's son Xing entered on the clan register.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖以興宗戚近屬，尊禮之甚厚，拜使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、都督，封大寧郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: High Ancestor, because Xing was a close imperial kinsman, honored and treated him very generously, appointing him bearer of staff of authority, flying-cavalry grand general, commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol, and commander, and enfeoffing him as Duke of Daning commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: High Ancestor Yuwen Yong, because Xing was a close imperial kinsman, honored and treated him very generously, appointing him bearer of staff of authority, flying-cavalry grand general, commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol, and commander, and enfeoffing him as Duke of Daning commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除宗師中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed master-of-clans middle grandee.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed master-of-clans middle grandee.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，出為涇州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he was sent out as governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (565), he was sent out as governor of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，又徵拜宗師，加大將軍，襲爵虞國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he was again summoned and appointed master-of-clans, advanced to grand general, and inherited the title Duke of Yuguo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (566), he was again summoned and appointed master-of-clans, advanced to grand general, and inherited the title Duke of Yuguo.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和二年薨，高祖親臨，慟焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianhe (567) he died; High Ancestor came in person and grieved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianhe (567) he died; High Ancestor Yuwen Yong came in person and grieved.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔大司空、申國公李穆監護喪事。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict appointed Li Mu, Duke of Shen and grand minister of works, to oversee the funeral.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Li Mu, Duke of Shen and grand minister of works, to oversee the funeral.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、恆幽等六州諸軍事、恆州刺史，諡曰靖。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted bearer of staff of authority, pillar-of-state grand general, chief commander, commander of military affairs in six provinces including Heng and You, and governor of Heng Province; his posthumous title was Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted bearer of staff of authority, pillar-of-state grand general, chief commander, commander of military affairs in six provinces including Heng and You, and governor of Heng Province; his posthumous title was Jing (Tranquil).

manualTranslations.zh: 子洛嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Luo succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Luo succeeded.

sourceRange.text: 椿字乾壽。初封永昌郡公。保定中，授開府儀同三司、宗師中大夫。建德初，加大將軍。尋除岐州刺史。四年，關中民饑，椿表陳其狀，璽書勞慰。因令所在開倉賑卹。四年，高祖東伐，椿與齊王憲攻拔武濟等五城。五年，高祖出晉州，椿率眾屯棲雞原。宣帝即位，拜大司寇。亮誅後，詔令紹烈公封。尋進位上柱國，轉大司徒。大定初，為隋文帝所害，并其五子西陽公道宗、本、仁隣、武子、禮獻。

context.beforeSource: 後坐亮反誅，國除。
context.afterSource: 眾字乾道。

manualTranslations.zh: 椿字乾壽。
manualTranslations.literal: Chun, style name Qianshou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Chun, style name Qianshou.

manualTranslations.zh: 初封永昌郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yongchang commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he was enfeoffed as Duke of Yongchang commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定中，授開府儀同三司、宗師中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: During Baoding, he was granted commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol and master-of-clans middle grandee.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Baoding (561–565), he was granted commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol and master-of-clans middle grandee.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德初，加大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Jiande (572), he was advanced to grand general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jiande (572), he was advanced to grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除岐州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed governor of Qi Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed governor of Qi Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，關中民饑，椿表陳其狀，璽書勞慰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, the people of Guanzhong suffered famine; Chun memorialized describing the situation, and an imperial letter commended and comforted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (575), the people of Guanzhong suffered famine; Chun memorialized describing the situation, and an imperial letter commended and comforted him.

manualTranslations.zh: 因令所在開倉賑卹。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon orders were issued to open granaries everywhere for relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon orders were issued to open granaries everywhere for relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，高祖東伐，椿與齊王憲攻拔武濟等五城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, when High Ancestor marched east, Chun together with Prince of Qi Xian captured Wuji and four other cities.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (575), when High Ancestor Yuwen Yong marched east, Chun together with Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian captured Wuji and four other cities.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，高祖出晉州，椿率眾屯棲雞原。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, when High Ancestor advanced from Jin Province, Chun led his forces to camp at Qijiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (576), when High Ancestor Yuwen Yong advanced from Jin Province, Chun led his forces to camp at Qijiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝即位，拜大司寇。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan acceded, he was appointed grand minister of justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan Yuwen Yun acceded, he was appointed grand minister of justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 亮誅後，詔令紹烈公封。
manualTranslations.literal: After Liang was executed, an edict ordered him to continue the enfeoffment of Duke Lie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Liang was executed, an edict ordered him to continue the enfeoffment of Duke Lie.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋進位上柱國，轉大司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was advanced to superior pillar-of-state and transferred to Grand Minister of Education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to superior pillar-of-state and transferred to Grand Minister of Education.

manualTranslations.zh: 大定初，為隋文帝所害，并其五子西陽公道宗、本、仁隣、武子、禮獻。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Dading (581), he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui, together with his five sons: Daozong, Duke of Xiyang; Ben; Renlin; Wuzi; and Lixian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dading (581), he was killed by Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, together with his five sons: Daozong, Duke of Xiyang; Ben; Renlin; Wuzi; and Lixian.

sourceRange.text: 自太祖為丞相，立左右十二軍，總屬相府。太祖崩後，皆受護處分，凡所徵發，非護書不行。護第屯兵禁衞，盛於宮闕。事無巨細，皆先斷後聞。保定元年，以護為都督中外諸軍事，令五府總於天官。或有希護旨，云周公德重，魯立文王之廟，以護功比周公，宜用此禮。於是詔於同州晉國第，立德皇帝別廟，使護祭焉。三年，詔曰：「大冢宰晉國公，智周萬物，道濟天下，所以克成我帝業，安養我蒼生。況親則懿昆，任當元輔，而可同班羣品，齊位眾臣！自今詔誥及百司文書，並不得稱公名，以彰殊禮。」護抗表固讓。

context.beforeSource: 護立高祖，百官總己以聽於護。

items.sourceTextOverride: 自太祖為丞相，立左右十二軍，總屬相府。太祖崩後，皆受護處分，凡所徵發，非護書不行。護第屯兵禁衞，盛於宮闕。事無巨細，皆先斷後聞。保定元年，以護為都督中外諸軍事，令五府總於天官。或有希護旨，云周公德重，魯立文王之廟，以護功比周公，宜用此禮。於是詔於同州晉國第，立德皇帝別廟，使護祭焉。三年，詔曰：「大冢宰晉國公，智周萬物，道濟天下，所以克成我帝業，安養我蒼生。況親則懿昆，任當元輔，而可同班羣品，齊位眾臣！自今詔誥及百司文書，並不得稱公名，以彰殊禮。」護抗表固讓。

manualTranslations.zh: 幼方正有志度，特為德皇帝所愛，異於諸兄。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he was upright and square, with ambition and measure; he was especially loved by Emperor De, unlike his elder brothers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he was upright and resolute, with ambition and breadth of mind; he was especially loved by Emperor De, unlike his elder brothers.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十一，惠公薨，隨諸父在葛榮軍中。
manualTranslations.literal: At age eleven Duke Hui died; he followed his uncles in Ge Rong's army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At age eleven Duke Hui died; he followed his uncles in Ge Rong's army.

manualTranslations.zh: 榮敗，遷晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: When Rong was defeated, they moved to Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Rong was defeated, they moved to Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖之入關也，護以年小不從。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor entered the pass, Hu because of his young age did not follow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai entered the pass, Yuwen Hu because of his young age did not follow.

manualTranslations.zh: 普泰初，自晉陽至平涼，時年十七。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, from Jinyang he reached Pingliang; at the time he was seventeen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Putai era, from Jinyang he reached Pingliang; at the time he was seventeen.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖諸子並幼，遂委護以家務，內外不嚴而肅。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor's sons were all young; he therefore entrusted Hu with household affairs, and inside and outside were not strict yet were dignified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai's sons were all young; he therefore entrusted Yuwen Hu with household affairs, and inside and outside the household were not strict yet were dignified.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嘗嘆曰：「此兒志度類我。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor once sighed and said: "This boy's ambition and measure are like mine."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai once sighed and said: "This boy's ambition and measure are like mine."

context.afterSource: 朝士有來請事者，輒云「汝不解，吾今教汝」，及其所言，多乖事衷。

sourceRange.text: 齊煬王憲字毗賀突，太祖第五子也。性通敏，有度量，雖在童齔，而神彩嶷然。初封涪城縣公。少與高祖俱受詩、傳，咸綜機要，得其指歸。太祖嘗賜諸子良馬，惟其所擇。憲獨取駁馬。太祖問之，對曰：「此馬色類既殊，或多駿逸。若從軍征伐，牧圉易分。」太祖喜曰：「此兒智識不凡，當成重器。」後從獵隴上，經官馬牧，太祖每見駁馬，輒曰：「此我兒馬也。」命左右取以賜之。魏恭帝元年，進封安城郡公。孝閔帝踐阼，拜驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。世宗即位，授大將軍。武成初，除益州總管、益寧巴瀘等二十四州諸軍事、益州刺史，進封齊國公，邑萬戶。初，平蜀之後，太祖以其形勝之地，不欲使宿將居之。諸子之中，欲有推擇。徧問高祖已下，誰能此行。並未及對，而憲先請。太祖曰：「刺史當撫眾治民，非爾所及。以年授者，當歸爾兄。」憲曰：「才用有殊，不關大小。試而無効，甘受面欺。」太祖大悅，以憲年尚幼，未之遣也。世宗追遵先旨，故有此授。憲時年十六，善於撫綏，留心政術，辭訟輻湊，聽受不疲。蜀人懷之，共立碑頌德。尋進位柱國。

context.afterSource: 保定中，徵還京，拜雍州牧。

manualTranslations.zh: 齊煬王憲字毗賀突，太祖第五子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Xian of Qiyang Yuwen Xian, styled Pihotu, was the fifth son of the Grand Progenitor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Xian, Prince of Qiyang the Flamboyant, styled Pihotu, was the fifth son of Yuwen Tai (the Grand Progenitor).

manualTranslations.zh: 性通敏，有度量，雖在童齔，而神彩嶷然。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he was quick and perceptive, with breadth of mind; though still in childhood, his spirit and bearing were striking.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature he was quick and perceptive, with breadth of mind; though still a child, his spirit and bearing were striking.

manualTranslations.zh: 初封涪城縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was first enfeoffed Duke of Fucheng county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed as Duke of Fucheng county.

manualTranslations.zh: 少與高祖俱受詩、傳，咸綜機要，得其指歸。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he studied the Odes and Documents together with the High Ancestor; both mastered essentials and grasped their guiding principles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he studied the Odes and Documents together with Yuwen Yong (the future Emperor Wu); both mastered essentials and grasped their guiding principles.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嘗賜諸子良馬，惟其所擇。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor once bestowed fine horses on his sons, each to choose as he wished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai once bestowed fine horses on his sons, each to choose as he wished.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲獨取駁馬。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian alone took a piebald horse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian alone took a piebald horse.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖問之，對曰：「此馬色類既殊，或多駿逸。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor asked him; he replied: "These horses differ in color and type; some may be exceptionally swift.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai asked him; he replied: "These horses differ in color and type; some may be exceptionally swift.

manualTranslations.zh: 若從軍征伐，牧圉易分。」
manualTranslations.literal: If we campaign in war, herdsmen can easily tell them apart."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If we campaign in war, herdsmen can easily tell them apart."

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖喜曰：「此兒智識不凡，當成重器。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor rejoiced and said: "This boy's insight is extraordinary; he will become a great vessel."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai rejoiced and said: "This boy's insight is extraordinary; he will become a pillar of the state."

manualTranslations.zh: 後從獵隴上，經官馬牧，太祖每見駁馬，輒曰：「此我兒馬也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Later, hunting on Longshang, he passed the government horse pasture; whenever the Grand Progenitor saw a piebald horse he would say: "That is my son's horse."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, while hunting on Longshang, he passed the government horse pasture; whenever Yuwen Tai saw a piebald horse he would say: "That is my son's horse."

manualTranslations.zh: 命左右取以賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: He ordered attendants to take it and bestow it on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He ordered attendants to take it and bestow it on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝元年，進封安城郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, he was advanced to Duke of Ancheng commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei (554), he was advanced to Duke of Ancheng commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，拜驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was appointed General-in-Chief of Agile Cavalry and Director with the privilege of an independent office with Threefold Parity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was appointed General-in-Chief of Agile Cavalry and Director with the privilege of an independent office with Threefold Parity.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗即位，授大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he was granted the post of Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne, he was granted the post of Grand General.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，除益州總管、益寧巴瀘等二十四州諸軍事、益州刺史，進封齊國公，邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng, he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province, with military authority over twenty-four provinces including Yi, Ning, Ba, and Lu, and as Governor of Yi Province; he was advanced to Duke of Qi state with a fief of ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wucheng (559), he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of Yi Province, with military authority over twenty-four provinces including Yi, Ning, Ba, and Lu, and as Governor of Yi Province; he was advanced to Duke of Qi with a fief of ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，平蜀之後，太祖以其形勝之地，不欲使宿將居之。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, after the pacification of Shu, the Grand Progenitor, because of the region's strategic terrain, did not wish veteran generals to hold it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, after the pacification of Shu, Yuwen Tai, because of the region's strategic terrain, did not wish veteran generals to hold it.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸子之中，欲有推擇。
manualTranslations.literal: Among his sons he wished to make a deliberate choice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among his sons he wished to make a deliberate choice.

manualTranslations.zh: 徧問高祖已下，誰能此行。
manualTranslations.literal: He asked all from the High Ancestor downward who could undertake this mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He asked all from Yuwen Yong downward who could undertake this mission.

manualTranslations.zh: 並未及對，而憲先請。
manualTranslations.literal: Before any had answered, Xian volunteered first.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before any had answered, Xian volunteered first.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖曰：「刺史當撫眾治民，非爾所及。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor said: "A provincial governor should comfort the masses and govern the people—that is not within your reach.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai said: "A provincial governor should comfort the masses and govern the people—that is not within your reach.

manualTranslations.zh: 以年授者，當歸爾兄。」
manualTranslations.literal: By seniority, it should go to your elder brother."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By seniority, it should go to your elder brother."

manualTranslations.zh: 憲曰：「才用有殊，不關大小。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian said: "Talent and ability differ; size of task is irrelevant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian said: "Talent and ability differ; the size of the task is irrelevant.

manualTranslations.zh: 試而無効，甘受面欺。」
manualTranslations.literal: If I try and fail, I willingly accept being deceived to my face."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If I try and fail, I willingly accept being deceived to my face."

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖大悅，以憲年尚幼，未之遣也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor was greatly pleased, but because Xian was still young he did not send him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai was greatly pleased, but because Xian was still young he did not send him.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗追遵先旨，故有此授。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizong later followed the earlier intent, and so this appointment was made.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong later followed the earlier intent, and so this appointment was made.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲時年十六，善於撫綏，留心政術，辭訟輻湊，聽受不疲。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian was then sixteen; he was skilled at comforting and pacifying, attentive to governance, and when lawsuits crowded in he heard cases without tiring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian was then sixteen; he was skilled at comforting and pacifying, attentive to governance, and when lawsuits crowded in he heard cases without tiring.

manualTranslations.zh: 蜀人懷之，共立碑頌德。
manualTranslations.literal: The people of Shu cherished him and jointly erected a stele praising his virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The people of Shu cherished him and jointly erected a stele praising his virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋進位柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was advanced to Pillar of State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to Pillar of State.

sourceRange.text: 宋獻公震，字彌俄突。幼而敏達，年十歲，誦孝經、論語、毛詩。後與世宗俱受禮記、尚書於盧誕。大統十六年，封武邑公，二千戶。尚魏文帝女，其年薨。保定元年，追贈使持節、柱國大將軍、少師、大司馬、大都督、青徐等十州諸軍事、青州刺史；進封宋國公，增邑并前一萬戶。無子，以世宗第三子寔為嗣。寔字乾辯，建德三年，進爵為王。大象中，為大前疑。尋為隋文帝所害，國除。

manualTranslations.zh: 宋獻公震，字彌俄突。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke of Song the Exalted Zhen, styled Mi'etu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke of Song the Exalted Yuwen Zhen, styled Mi'etu.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼而敏達，年十歲，誦孝經、論語、毛詩。
manualTranslations.literal: Clever and perceptive from childhood; at age ten he could recite the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, and the Mao version of the Odes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clever and perceptive from childhood, at ten he could recite the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, and the Mao Odes.

manualTranslations.zh: 後與世宗俱受禮記、尚書於盧誕。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he and Shizong together received instruction in the Record of Rites and the Venerated Documents from Lu Dan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he and Shizong together studied the Record of Rites and the Venerated Documents under Lu Dan.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統十六年，封武邑公，二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Datong, he was enfeoffed Duke of Wuyi, fief two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Datong (550), he was enfeoffed Duke of Wuyi with a fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尚魏文帝女，其年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He married a daughter of Emperor Wen of Wei and died that same year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He married a daughter of Emperor Wen of Wei and died that same year.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定元年，追贈使持節、柱國大將軍、少師、大司馬、大都督、青徐等十州諸軍事、青州刺史；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding, he was posthumously granted bearer of the staff of authority, pillar-of-state grand general, junior preceptor, grand marshal, grand governor, commander-in-chief of military affairs in ten provinces including Qing and Xu, and governor of Qing Province;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding (561), he was posthumously granted bearer of the staff of authority, pillar-of-state grand general, junior preceptor, grand marshal, grand governor, commander-in-chief of military affairs in ten provinces including Qing and Xu, and governor of Qing Province;

manualTranslations.zh: 進封宋國公，增邑并前一萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: He was advanced to Duke of Song state, the fief increased to ten thousand households in all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Duke of Song, the fief increased to ten thousand households in all.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子，以世宗第三子寔為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Having no son, Shizong's third son Shi was made his heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Having no son, Shizong's third son Shi was made his heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 寔字乾辯，建德三年，進爵為王。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi, styled Qianbian; in the third year of Jiande, he advanced in rank to prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shi, styled Qianbian; in the third year of Jiande (574), he was advanced to prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象中，為大前疑。
manualTranslations.literal: During Daxiang, he was grand front advisor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Daxiang (579–581), he was grand front advisor.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋為隋文帝所害，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was killed by Yang Jian; the fief was abolished.

items.acceptedSourceText: 宋獻公震，字彌俄突。幼而敏達，年十歲，誦孝經、論語、毛詩。後與世宗俱受禮記、尚書於盧誕。大統十六年，封武邑公，二千戶。尚魏文帝女，其年薨。保定元年，追贈使持節、柱國大將軍、少師、大司馬、大都督、青徐等十州諸軍事、青州刺史；進封宋國公，增邑并前一萬戶。無子，以世宗第三子寔為嗣。寔字乾辯，建德三年，進爵為王。大象中，為大前疑。尋為隋文帝所害，國除。

sourceRange.text: 尋而更有異志，遂誅之，及其子賀、貢、塞、響、賈、祕、津、乾理、乾璪、乾悰等十人，國除。趙僭王招，字豆盧突。幼聰趙，博涉羣書，好屬文。學庾信體，詞多輕豔。魏恭帝三年，封正平郡公，邑一千戶。武成初，進封趙國公，邑萬戶。保定中，拜為柱國，出為益州總管。建德元年，授大司空，轉大司馬。三年，進爵為王，除雍州牧。四年，大軍東討，招為後三軍總管。五年，又從高祖東伐，率步騎一萬出華谷，攻齊汾州。及幷州平，進位上柱國。東夏底定，又為行軍總管，與齊王討稽胡。招擒賊帥劉沒鐸，斬之，胡寇平。宣政中，拜太師。大象元年五月，詔以洺州襄國郡邑萬戶為趙。招出就國。二年，宣帝不豫，徵招及陳、越、代、滕五王赴闕。比招等至而帝已崩。

manualTranslations.zh: 尋而更有異志，遂誅之，及其子賀、貢、塞、響、賈、祕、津、乾理、乾璪、乾悰等十人，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he again harbored different intent; he was then executed, together with his sons He, Gong, Sai, Xiang, Jia, Mi, Jin, Qianli, Qianbao, Qiancong, and ten others in all; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he showed further treasonous intent; he was executed together with his sons He, Gong, Sai, Xiang, Jia, Mi, Jin, Qianli, Qianbao, Qiancong, and ten others in all; the fief was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 趙僭王招，字豆盧突。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Zhao the Presumptuous Zhao, styled Douluotu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhao the Presumptuous Yuwen Zhao, styled Douluotu.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼聰慧，博涉羣書，好屬文。
manualTranslations.literal: Clever from youth, widely read in many books, fond of literary composition.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Clever from youth, widely read, and fond of literary composition.

manualTranslations.zh: 學庾信體，詞多輕豔。
manualTranslations.literal: He studied the style of Yu Xin; his diction was often light and ornate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He studied the style of Yu Xin; his diction was often light and ornate.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝三年，封正平郡公，邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Emperor Gong of Wei, he was enfeoffed Duke of Zhengping commandery, fief one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Emperor Gong of Wei (556), he was enfeoffed Duke of Zhengping with a fief of one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，進封趙國公，邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng, he advanced to Duke of Zhao state, fief ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wucheng (559), he was advanced to Duke of Zhao with a fief of ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定中，拜為柱國，出為益州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: During Baoding, he was appointed pillar-of-state and went out as Yizhou commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Baoding (561–565), he was appointed pillar-of-state and went out as commander-in-chief of Yizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德元年，授大司空，轉大司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jiande, he was granted grand minister of works and transferred to grand marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiande (572), he was granted grand minister of works and transferred to grand marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，進爵為王，除雍州牧。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he advanced in rank to prince and was made governor of Yong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiande (574), he was advanced to prince and made governor of Yong Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，大軍東討，招為後三軍總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, when the great army marched east, Zhao was rear third army commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiande (575), when the great army marched east, Zhao served as rear third army commander-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，又從高祖東伐，率步騎一萬出華谷，攻齊汾州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, again following the High Ancestor east, he led ten thousand infantry and cavalry out through Huagu to attack Qi's Fen Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiande (576), again following Yuwen Yong east, he led ten thousand infantry and cavalry out through Huagu to attack Qi's Fen Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 及幷州平，進位上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: When Bingzhou was pacified, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Bingzhou was pacified, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 東夏底定，又為行軍總管，與齊王討稽胡。
manualTranslations.literal: When the eastern Xia was settled, he again became mobile commander-in-chief and, with Prince of Qi, suppressed the Ji Hu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the eastern regions were settled, he again became mobile commander-in-chief and, with Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian, suppressed the Ji Hu.

manualTranslations.zh: 招擒賊帥劉沒鐸，斬之，胡寇平。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao captured the bandit chief Liu Moduo and beheaded him; the Hu raiders were pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao captured the bandit chief Liu Moduo and beheaded him; the Hu raiders were pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政中，拜太師。
manualTranslations.literal: During Xuanzheng, he was appointed grand preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Xuanzheng (578), he was appointed grand preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年五月，詔以洺州襄國郡邑萬戶為趙。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Daxiang, an edict made Xiangguo commandery in Mozhou, ten thousand households, Zhao's fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Daxiang (579), an edict made Xiangguo commandery in Mozhou, with ten thousand households, Zhao's fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 招出就國。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao went out to take up his state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao went out to take up his fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，宣帝不豫，徵招及陳、越、代、滕五王赴闕。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, Emperor Xuan was indisposed; Zhao and the five princes of Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng were summoned to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daxiang (580), Emperor Xuan fell ill; Zhao and the princes of Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng were summoned to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 比招等至而帝已崩。
manualTranslations.literal: By the time Zhao and the others arrived, the emperor had already died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the time Zhao and the others arrived, the emperor had already died.

items.acceptedSourceText: 尋而更有異志，遂誅之，及其子賀、貢、塞、響、賈、祕、津、乾理、乾璪、乾悰等十人，國除。趙僭王招，字豆盧突。幼聰慧，博涉羣書，好屬文。學庾信體，詞多輕豔。魏恭帝三年，封正平郡公，邑一千戶。武成初，進封趙國公，邑萬戶。保定中，拜為柱國，出為益州總管。建德元年，授大司空，轉大司馬。三年，進爵為王，除雍州牧。四年，大軍東討，招為後三軍總管。五年，又從高祖東伐，率步騎一萬出華谷，攻齊汾州。及幷州平，進位上柱國。東夏底定，又為行軍總管，與齊王討稽胡。招擒賊帥劉沒鐸，斬之，胡寇平。宣政中，拜太師。大象元年五月，詔以洺州襄國郡邑萬戶為趙。招出就國。二年，宣帝不豫，徵招及陳、越、代、滕五王赴闕。比招等至而帝已崩。

sourceRange.text: 譙孝王儉，字侯幼突。武成初，封譙國公，邑萬戶。天和中，拜大將軍，尋遷柱國，出為益州總管。建德三年，進爵為王。五年，東伐，以本官為左一軍總管，攻永固城，拔之。進平并、鄴，拜大冢宰。是歲，稽胡反，詔儉為行軍總管，與齊王憲討之。有胡帥自號天柱者，據守河東，儉攻破之，斬首三千級。宣政元年二月，薨。子乾惲嗣。大定中，為隋文帝所害，國除。陳惑王純，字堙智突。武成初，封陳國公，邑萬戶。保定中，除岐州刺史，加開府儀同三司。使於突厥迎皇后，拜大將軍。尋進位柱國，出為秦州總管，轉陝州總管，督鴈門公田弘拔齊宜陽等九城。建德三年，進爵為王。四年，大軍東伐，純為前一軍總管。以帝寢疾，班師。五年，大軍復東討，詔純為前一軍，率步軍二萬守千里徑。幷州平，進位上柱國，即拜幷州總管。宣政中，除雍州牧，遷太傅。大象元年五月，以濟南郡邑萬戶為陳。純出就國。二年，朝京師。時隋文帝專政，翦落宗枝，遂害純，并世子謙及弟扈公讓、讓弟議等，國除。越野王盛，字立久突。武成初，封越國公，邑萬戶。天和中，進爵為王。四年，大軍伐齊，盛為後一軍總管。五年，大軍又東討，盛率所領，拔齊高顯等數城。幷州平，進位上柱國。從平鄴，拜相州總管。宣政元年，入為大冢宰。汾州稽胡帥劉（愛）〔受〕邏干反，詔盛率諸軍討平之。大象元年，遷大前疑，轉太保。其年，詔以豐州武當、安富二郡邑萬戶為越。盛出就國。二年，朝京師。其秋，為隋文帝所害，并其子忱、悰、恢、懫、忻等五人，國除。代奰王達，字度斤突。性果決，善騎射。武成初，封代國公，邑萬戶。天和元年，拜大將軍、右宮伯，拜左宗衞。建德初，進位柱國，出為荊淮等十四州十防諸軍事、荊州刺史。在州有政績，高祖手勑襃美之。所管灃州刺史蔡澤黷貨被訟，贓狀分明。以其世著勳庸，不可加戮；若曲法貸之，又非奉上之體。乃令所司，精加按劾，密表奏之。事竟得釋，終亦不言。其處事周慎如此。達雅好節儉，食無兼膳，侍姬不過數人，皆衣綈衣。又不營資產，國無儲積。左右嘗以為言，達從容應之曰：「君子憂道不憂貧，何煩於此。」三年，進爵為王。出為益州總管。高祖東伐，以為右一軍總管。齊淑妃馮氏，尤為齊後主所幸，齊平見獲，帝以達不邇聲色，特以馮氏賜之。宣帝即位，進位上柱國。大象元年，拜大右弼。其年，詔以潞州上黨郡邑萬戶為代。達出就國。二年，朝京。其年冬，為隋文帝所害，及其世子執、弟蕃國公轉等，國除。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: A Hu leader styling himself Heavenly Pillar held Hedong; Jian defeated him and took three thousand heads.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年二月，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Xuanzheng, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Xuanzheng (578), he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 子乾惲嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Qianyun succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Qianyun succeeded.

manualTranslations.zh: 大定中，為隋文帝所害，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: During Dading, he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Dading (581), he was killed by Yang Jian; the fief was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳惑王純，字堙智突。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Chen the Bewildered Chun, styled Yinzhitu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince of Chen the Bewildered Yuwen Chun, styled Yinzhitu.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，封陳國公，邑萬戶。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wucheng (559), he was enfeoffed Duke of Chen with a fief of ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定中，除岐州刺史，加開府儀同三司。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Baoding, he was made governor of Qi Province and granted the Three Excellencies of the Opening Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 使於突厥迎皇后，拜大將軍。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sent to the Turks to welcome the empress, he was appointed grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋進位柱國，出為秦州總管，轉陝州總管，督鴈門公田弘拔齊宜陽等九城。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon advanced to pillar-of-state; went out as Qinzhou commander-in-chief, transferred to Shanzhou commander-in-chief, and supervised Yannmen Duke Tian Hong in capturing nine Qi cities including Yiyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon advanced to pillar-of-state; he went out as commander-in-chief of Qinzhou, transferred to Shanzhou, and supervised Yannmen Duke Tian Hong in capturing nine Qi cities including Yiyang.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiande (574), he was advanced to prince.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiande (575), when the great army marched east, Chun was front first army commander-in-chief.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the emperor fell gravely ill, the army withdrew.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiande (576), when the great army again marched east, an edict made Chun front first army, leading twenty thousand infantry to hold Qianli Path.

manualTranslations.literal: During Tianhe, he advanced in rank to prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianhe (566–572), he was advanced to prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，大軍伐齊，盛為後一軍總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, when the great army attacked Qi, Sheng was rear first army commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiande (575), when the great army attacked Qi, Sheng was rear first army commander-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，大軍又東討，盛率所領，拔齊高顯等數城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, when the great army again marched east, Sheng led his command and captured several Qi cities including Gaoxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiande (576), when the great army again marched east, Sheng led his command and captured several Qi cities including Gaoxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 幷州平，進位上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: When Bingzhou was pacified, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Bingzhou was pacified, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 從平鄴，拜相州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the pacification of Ye, he was appointed Xiangzhou commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following the pacification of Ye, he was appointed commander-in-chief of Xiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年，入為大冢宰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xuanzheng, he entered office as grand minister of war.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanzheng (578), he entered office as grand minister of war.

manualTranslations.zh: 汾州稽胡帥劉受邏干反，詔盛率諸軍討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Shouluogan, Ji Hu leader in Fen Province, rebelled; an edict ordered Sheng to lead the armies and pacify him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Shouluogan, a Ji Hu leader in Fen Province, rebelled; an edict ordered Sheng to lead the armies and pacify him.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年，遷大前疑，轉太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daxiang, he was transferred to grand front advisor and then to grand guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daxiang (579), he was transferred to grand front advisor and then to grand guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，詔以豐州武當、安富二郡邑萬戶為越。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, an edict made Wudang and Anfu commanderies in Fengzhou, ten thousand households, Yue's fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, an edict made Wudang and Anfu commanderies in Fengzhou, with ten thousand households, Yue's fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 盛出就國。
manualTranslations.literal: Sheng went out to take up his state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sheng went out to take up his fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，朝京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he attended court in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daxiang (580), he attended court in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 其秋，為隋文帝所害，并其子忱、悰、恢、懫、忻等五人，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: That autumn he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui, together with his sons Chen, Cong, Hui, Man, and Xin, five in all; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That autumn he was killed by Yang Jian, together with his sons Chen, Cong, Hui, Man, and Xin, five in all; the fief was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 代奰王達，字度斤突。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Dai the Proud Da, styled Dujintu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince of Dai the Proud Yuwen Da, styled Dujintu.

manualTranslations.zh: 性果決，善騎射。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he was resolute and decisive, skilled in horsemanship and archery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By nature he was resolute and decisive, skilled in horsemanship and archery.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，封代國公，邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng, he was enfeoffed Duke of Dai state, fief ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wucheng (559), he was enfeoffed Duke of Dai with a fief of ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和元年，拜大將軍、右宮伯，拜左宗衞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianhe, he was appointed grand general and right palace elder, and left guard commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianhe (566), he was appointed grand general and right palace elder, and left guard commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德初，進位柱國，出為荊淮等十四州十防諸軍事、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Jiande, he advanced to pillar-of-state and went out as commander-in-chief of military affairs in fourteen provinces including Jing and Huai and ten defenses, and governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jiande (572), he advanced to pillar-of-state and went out as commander-in-chief of military affairs in fourteen provinces including Jing and Huai and ten defenses, and as governor of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州有政績，高祖手勑襃美之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the province he had administrative achievements; the High Ancestor personally wrote an edict praising him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the province he had administrative achievements; Yuwen Yong personally wrote an edict praising him.

manualTranslations.zh: 所管灃州刺史蔡澤黷貨被訟，贓狀分明。
manualTranslations.literal: Cai Ze, governor of Feng Province under his jurisdiction, was sued for corrupt taking; the evidence of bribery was clear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cai Ze, governor of Feng Province under his jurisdiction, was sued for corruption; the evidence was clear.

manualTranslations.zh: 以其世著勳庸，不可加戮；
manualTranslations.literal: Because his house was long distinguished in merit, he could not be put to death;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his house was long distinguished in merit, he could not be executed;

manualTranslations.zh: 若曲法貸之，又非奉上之體。
manualTranslations.literal: yet if the law were bent to pardon him, that would not accord with serving the court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet bending the law to pardon him would not accord with serving the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃令所司，精加按劾，密表奏之。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore ordered the responsible offices to investigate thoroughly and submitted a secret memorial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He therefore ordered the responsible offices to investigate thoroughly and submitted a secret memorial.

manualTranslations.zh: 事竟得釋，終亦不言。
manualTranslations.literal: The matter ended in release, yet in the end he never spoke of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The matter ended in release, yet he never spoke of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 其處事周慎如此。
manualTranslations.literal: In handling affairs he was this thorough and cautious.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He handled affairs with such thorough caution.

manualTranslations.zh: 達雅好節儉，食無兼膳，侍姬不過數人，皆衣綈衣。
manualTranslations.literal: Da by nature loved frugality: his meals had no double dishes, his serving women numbered no more than a few, and all wore plain silk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Da loved frugality: his meals had no double dishes, his serving women numbered only a few, and all wore plain silk.

manualTranslations.zh: 又不營資產，國無儲積。
manualTranslations.literal: He also did not accumulate property; his state had no stores.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also did not accumulate property; his fief had no stores.

manualTranslations.zh: 左右嘗以為言，達從容應之曰：「君子憂道不憂貧，何煩於此。」
manualTranslations.literal: Those around him once spoke of this; Da calmly replied: "The noble person worries about the Way, not poverty—why trouble over this?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those around him once spoke of this; Da calmly replied: "The noble person worries about the Way, not poverty—why trouble over this?"

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，進爵為王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he advanced in rank to prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiande (574), he was advanced to prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為益州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Yizhou commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went out as commander-in-chief of Yizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖東伐，以為右一軍總管。
manualTranslations.literal: When the High Ancestor marched east, he was made right first army commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuwen Yong marched east, he was made right first army commander-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊淑妃馮氏，尤為齊後主所幸，齊平見獲，帝以達不邇聲色，特以馮氏賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: Lady Feng, refined consort of Qi, was especially favored by the Later Lord of Qi; when Qi was pacified she was captured, and because Da did not draw near to music and beauty, the emperor specially bestowed Lady Feng upon him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lady Feng, refined consort of Qi, was especially favored by the Later Lord of Qi; when Qi fell she was captured, and because Da did not indulge in music and beauty, the emperor specially bestowed Lady Feng upon him.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝即位，進位上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年，拜大右弼。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daxiang, he was appointed grand right assistant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daxiang (579), he was appointed grand right assistant.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，詔以潞州上黨郡邑萬戶為代。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, an edict made Shangdang commandery in Luzhou, ten thousand households, Dai's fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, an edict made Shangdang commandery in Luzhou, with ten thousand households, Dai's fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 達出就國。
manualTranslations.literal: Da went out to take up his state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Da went out to take up his fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，朝京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he attended court in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daxiang (580), he attended court in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年冬，為隋文帝所害，及其世子執、弟蕃國公轉等，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui, together with his heir Zhi and younger brother Duke of Fan Zhuan; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he was killed by Yang Jian, together with his heir Zhi and younger brother Duke of Fan Zhuan; the fief was abolished.

items.acceptedSourceText: 譙孝王儉，字侯幼突。武成初，封譙國公，邑萬戶。天和中，拜大將軍，尋遷柱國，出為益州總管。建德三年，進爵為王。五年，東伐，以本官為左一軍總管，攻永固城，拔之。進平并、鄴，拜大冢宰。是歲，稽胡反，詔儉為行軍總管，與齊王憲討之。有胡帥自號天柱者，據守河東，儉攻破之，斬首三千級。宣政元年二月，薨。子乾惲嗣。大定中，為隋文帝所害，國除。陳惑王純，字堙智突。武成初，封陳國公，邑萬戶。保定中，除岐州刺史，加開府儀同三司。使於突厥迎皇后，拜大將軍。尋進位柱國，出為秦州總管，轉陝州總管，督鴈門公田弘拔齊宜陽等九城。建德三年，進爵為王。四年，大軍東伐，純為前一軍總管。以帝寢疾，班師。五年，大軍復東討，詔純為前一軍，率步軍二萬守千里徑。幷州平，進位上柱國，即拜幷州總管。宣政中，除雍州牧，遷太傅。大象元年五月，以濟南郡邑萬戶為陳。純出就國。二年，朝京師。時隋文帝專政，翦落宗枝，遂害純，并世子謙及弟扈公讓、讓弟議等，國除。越野王盛，字立久突。武成初，封越國公，邑萬戶。天和中，進爵為王。四年，大軍伐齊，盛為後一軍總管。五年，大軍又東討，盛率所領，拔齊高顯等數城。幷州平，進位上柱國。從平鄴，拜相州總管。宣政元年，入為大冢宰。汾州稽胡帥劉受邏干反，詔盛率諸軍討平之。大象元年，遷大前疑，轉太保。其年，詔以豐州武當、安富二郡邑萬戶為越。盛出就國。二年，朝京師。其秋，為隋文帝所害，并其子忱、悰、恢、懫、忻等五人，國除。代奰王達，字度斤突。性果決，善騎射。武成初，封代國公，邑萬戶。天和元年，拜大將軍、右宮伯，拜左宗衞。建德初，進位柱國，出為荊淮等十四州十防諸軍事、荊州刺史。在州有政績，高祖手勑襃美之。所管灃州刺史蔡澤黷貨被訟，贓狀分明。以其世著勳庸，不可加戮；若曲法貸之，又非奉上之體。乃令所司，精加按劾，密表奏之。事竟得釋，終亦不言。其處事周慎如此。達雅好節儉，食無兼膳，侍姬不過數人，皆衣綈衣。又不營資產，國無儲積。左右嘗以為言，達從容應之曰：「君子憂道不憂貧，何煩於此。」三年，進爵為王。出為益州總管。高祖東伐，以為右一軍總管。齊淑妃馮氏，尤為齊後主所幸，齊平見獲，帝以達不邇聲色，特以馮氏賜之。宣帝即位，進位上柱國。大象元年，拜大右弼。其年，詔以潞州上黨郡邑萬戶為代。達出就國。二年，朝京。其年冬，為隋文帝所害，及其世子執、弟蕃國公轉等，國除。

manualTranslations.zh: 滕聞王逌，字爾固突。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Teng the Cultivated You, styled Er'gutu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince of Teng the Cultivated Yuwen You, styled Er'gutu.

manualTranslations.zh: 少好經史，解屬文。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he loved the classics and histories and understood literary composition.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he loved the classics and histories and was skilled in literary composition.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，封滕國公，邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Wucheng, he was enfeoffed Duke of Teng state, fief ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wucheng (559), he was enfeoffed Duke of Teng with a fief of ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和末，拜大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tianhe, he was appointed grand general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianhe (572), he was appointed grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德初，進位柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Jiande, he advanced to pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jiande (572), he advanced to pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，進爵為王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he advanced in rank to prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiande (574), he was advanced to prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，為行軍總管，與齊王憲征稽胡。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, he was mobile commander-in-chief and, with Prince of Qi Xian, campaigned against the Ji Hu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiande (577), he was mobile commander-in-chief and, with Prince of Qi Yuwen Xian, campaigned against the Ji Hu.

manualTranslations.zh: 逌破其渠帥穆友等，斬首八千級。
manualTranslations.literal: You defeated their chieftains including Mu You and beheaded eight thousand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You defeated their chieftains including Mu You and took eight thousand heads.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，除河陽總管。
manualTranslations.literal: On return, he was made Heyang commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On return, he was made commander-in-chief of Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年，進位上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xuanzheng, he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanzheng (578), he advanced to senior pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，伐陳，詔逌為元帥，節度諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, on the campaign against Chen, an edict made You supreme commander directing all military affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, on the campaign against Chen, an edict made You supreme commander directing all military affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年五月，詔以荊州新野郡邑萬戶為滕。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Daxiang, an edict made Xinye commandery in Jingzhou, ten thousand households, Teng's fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Daxiang (579), an edict made Xinye commandery in Jingzhou, with ten thousand households, Teng's fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 逌出就國。
manualTranslations.literal: You went out to take up his state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You went out to take up his fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，朝京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, he attended court in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daxiang (580), he attended court in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 其年冬，為隋文帝所害，并子懷德公祐、祐弟箕國公裕、弟禮禧等，國除。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he was killed by Emperor Wen of Sui, together with his son Duke of Huaide You, You's younger brother Duke of Ji Yu, and younger brother Lixi; the state was abolished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he was killed by Yang Jian, together with his son Duke of Huaide You, You's younger brother Duke of Ji Yu, and younger brother Lixi; the fief was abolished.

manualTranslations.zh: 逌所著文章，頗行於世。
manualTranslations.literal: Writings composed by You circulated widely in the world.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You's writings circulated widely in his day.

manualTranslations.zh: 秦王贄，字乾信。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Qin Zan, styled Qianxin.

sourceRange.text: 弼每率兵征討，朝受令，夕便引路，不問私事，亦未嘗宿於家。其憂國忘身，類皆如此。兼復性沉雄，有深識，故能以功名終。元年十月，薨於位，年六十四。世宗即日舉哀，比葬，三臨其喪。發卒穿冢，給大輅、龍旂，陳軍至于墓所。諡曰武。尋追封魏國公，配食太祖廟庭。子（輝）〔耀〕。次子（耀）〔輝〕，尚太祖女義安長公主，遂以為嗣。輝大統中，起家員外散騎侍郎，賜爵義城郡公，歷撫軍將軍、大都督、鎮南將軍、散騎常侍。輝常臥疾朞年，太祖憂之，日賜錢一千，供其藥石之費。及魏廢帝有異謀，太祖乃授輝武衞將軍，總宿衞事。尋而帝廢，除車騎大將軍、儀同三司。魏恭帝二年，加驃騎大將軍、儀同三司，出為岐州刺史。從太祖西巡，率公卿子弟，別為一軍。孝閔帝踐阼，除荊州刺史。尋襲爵趙國公，改魏國公。保定中年，加將軍。天和六年，進位柱國。建德元年，出為總管梁洋等十州諸軍事、梁州刺史。時渠、蓬二州生獠，積年侵暴，輝至州綏撫，竝來歸附。璽書勞之。（輝）〔耀〕既不得為嗣，朝廷以弼功重，乃封（輝）〔耀〕邢國公，位至開府。

sourceRange.text: 孝昌元年，又隨廣陽王征鮮于脩禮。軍次白牛邏，會章武王為脩禮所害，遂停軍中山。侍中元晏宣言於靈太后曰：「廣陽王以宗室之重，受律專征，今乃盤桓不進，坐圖非望。又有于謹者，智略過人，為其謀主。風塵之隙，恐非陛下之純臣矣。」靈太后深納之。詔於尚書省門外立牓，募能獲謹者，許重賞。謹聞之，乃謂廣陽曰：「今女主臨朝，敢信讒佞，脫不明白殿下素心，便恐禍至無日。謹請束身詣闕，歸罪有司，披露腹心，自免殃禍。」廣陽許之。謹遂到牓下曰：「吾知此人。」眾人共詰之。謹曰：「我即是也。」有司以聞。靈太后引見之，大怒。謹備論廣陽忠款，兼陳停軍之狀。靈后意稍解，遂捨之。尋加別將。二年，梁將曹義宗據守穰城，數為邊患。乃令謹與行臺尚書辛纂率兵討之。相持累年，經數十戰。進拜都督、宣威將軍、冗從僕射。孝莊帝即位，除鎮遠將軍，尋轉直寢。又隨太宰元天穆討葛榮，平邢杲，拜征虜將軍。從爾朱天光破万俟醜奴，封石城縣伯，邑五百戶。普泰元年，除征北大將軍、金紫光祿大夫、散騎常侍。又隨天光平宿勤明達，別討夏州賊賀遂有伐等，平之，授大都督。從天光與齊神武戰於韓陵山，天光既敗，謹遂入關。賀拔岳表謹留鎮，除衞將軍、咸陽郡守。

sourceRange.text: 崇弟瓊，字世樂。年八歳喪父，養母至孝，善事諸兄，内外莫不敬之。以軍功封靈丘縣男，邑三百戸。從魏孝武入關，爲太祖直盪都督。大統二年，遷尚藥典御。三年，拜太子右衞率，進爵爲侯。從獨孤信-征-梁仚定。累遷北秦州刺史。十四年，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司。孝閔帝踐阼，進爵武安縣公，增邑并前二千戸。出爲郢州刺史。武成二年，遷金州總管、六州諸軍事、金州刺史。保定元年，拜大將軍。天和四年，轉荊州總管、十四州八防諸軍事、荊州刺史。尋進位柱國，進爵同昌郡公。建德二年，拜大宗伯，出爲秦州總管。四年，從髙祖東伐，爲後二軍總管。尋改封武威郡公。大象二年，加上柱國。瓊弟凱，字敬樂。性剛正，頗好經史。隨兄崇，以軍功賜爵下蔡縣男。大統元年，爲東宮侍書。從太祖擒竇泰，破沙苑陣，以功拜寧遠將軍。累遷羽林監、東宮洗馬、太子庶子，進授都督。十四年，兄崇以平原州功，賜爵靈武縣侯，詔聽轉授凱。累遷東宮武衞率、尚書右丞，轉左丞，進位車騎大將軍、儀同三司。六官建，授司門下大夫。孝閔帝踐阼，拜工部中大夫，進位開府儀同三司，轉司憲中大夫，進爵爲公，復除工部中大夫。世宗初，出爲宜州刺史。武成二年，入爲禮部中大夫。保定中，復爲陵州刺史，轉丹州刺史。所在頗有政績。天和中，入爲司會中大夫。建德二年，爲聘齊使主。

context.beforeSource: 仍從平鄴，拜大司馬。
context.afterSource: 史臣曰：蕭何文吏自愛，懼秦法誅戮，乃推奉漢髙；

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was advanced to duke of Wu'an county with a combined fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為郢州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was sent out as governor of Ying Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as governor of Ying Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成二年，遷金州總管、六州諸軍事、金州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng he was transferred to overall commander of Jin Province, commander of military affairs for six provinces, and governor of Jin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng 2 (560) he was transferred to overall commander of Jin Province, commander of military affairs for six provinces, and governor of Jin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定元年，拜大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding he was appointed Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Baoding 1 (561) he was appointed grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和四年，轉荊州總管、十四州八防諸軍事、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianhe he was transferred to overall commander of Jing Province, commander of military affairs for fourteen provinces and eight frontier posts, and governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianhe 4 (569) he was transferred to overall commander of Jing Province, commander of military affairs for fourteen provinces and eight frontier posts, and governor of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋進位柱國，進爵同昌郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon his rank was advanced to Pillar of State and he was promoted to Duke of Tongchang commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was advanced to pillar of state and promoted to duke of Tongchang commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德二年，拜大宗伯，出為秦州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jiande he was appointed Grand Clan Prefect and sent out as overall commander of Qin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiande 2 (573) he was appointed grand clan prefect and sent out as overall commander of Qin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，從高祖東伐，為後二軍總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the High Ancestor on the eastern campaign as overall commander of the rear second army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed High Ancestor Yuwen Yong on the eastern campaign as overall commander of the rear second army.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋改封武威郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon his title was changed to Duke of Wuwei commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon his title was changed to duke of Wuwei commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象二年，加上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Daxiang he was granted the added title Superior Pillar of State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daxiang 2 (580) he was granted the added title superior pillar of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 瓊弟凱，字敬樂。
manualTranslations.literal: Qiong's younger brother Kai, styled Jingle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qiong's younger brother Kai, styled Jingle.

manualTranslations.zh: 性剛正，頗好經史。
manualTranslations.literal: His nature was upright and firm; he was quite fond of the classics and histories.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Upright and firm by nature, he was quite fond of the classics and histories.

manualTranslations.zh: 隨兄崇，以軍功賜爵下蔡縣男。
manualTranslations.literal: Following his elder brother Chong, by military merit he was granted the title Baron of Xia'ai county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following his elder brother Chong, he was granted the title baron of Xia'ai county for military merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，為東宮侍書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong he served as Eastern Palace attendant scribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong 1 (535) he served as eastern palace attendant scribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太祖擒竇泰，破沙苑陣，以功拜寧遠將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the Grand Progenitor in capturing Dou Tai and breaking the Shayan battle line, by merit he was appointed General Pacifying the Distance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai in capturing Dou Tai and breaking the Shayan line, he was appointed general pacifying the distance for his merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷羽林監、東宮洗馬、太子庶子，進授都督。
manualTranslations.literal: Progressively transferred to Supervisor of the Feathered Forest, Eastern Palace horse groom, and crown prince's household child, he was advanced to commandant-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was progressively transferred to supervisor of the feathered forest, eastern palace horse groom, and crown prince's household child, and was advanced to commandant-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，兄崇以平原州功，賜爵靈武縣侯，詔聽轉授凱。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year, his elder brother Chong for merit in Pingyuan Province was granted Marquis of Lingwu county; an edict permitted transferring it to Kai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year his elder brother Chong was granted marquis of Lingwu county for merit in Pingyuan Province, and an edict permitted transferring the title to Kai.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷東宮武衞率、尚書右丞，轉左丞，進位車騎大將軍、儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: Progressively transferred to Commandant of the Eastern Palace Martial Guard, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and then Left Vice Director; his rank was advanced to General of Cavalry and Chariots and Matching Three Divisions of Court Equipage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was progressively transferred to commandant of the eastern palace martial guard, right vice director of the masters of writing, and then left vice director, and was advanced to general of cavalry and chariots with matching three-division court equipage.

manualTranslations.zh: 六官建，授司門下大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, he was appointed Lower Grand Master of the Gate Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established, he was appointed lower grand master of the gate office.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，拜工部中大夫，進位開府儀同三司，轉司憲中大夫，進爵為公，復除工部中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was appointed Middle Grand Master of the Works Ministry, advanced to Opening-the-Feudatory Three Divisions of Court Equipage, transferred to Middle Grand Master of the Ministry of Justice, advanced in rank to duke, and again appointed Middle Grand Master of the Works Ministry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was appointed middle grand master of the works ministry, advanced to opening-the-feudatory three-division court equipage, transferred to middle grand master of the ministry of justice, advanced to duke, and again appointed middle grand master of the works ministry.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗初，出為宜州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Shizong's reign he was sent out as governor of Yi Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Shizong's reign he was sent out as governor of Yi Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成二年，入為禮部中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng he entered service as Middle Grand Master of the Rites Ministry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng 2 (560) he entered service as middle grand master of the rites ministry.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定中，復為陵州刺史，轉丹州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: During Baoding he again served as governor of Ling Province and was transferred to governor of Dan Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Baoding he again served as governor of Ling Province and was transferred to governor of Dan Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 所在頗有政績。
manualTranslations.literal: Wherever he served he achieved considerable administrative merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wherever he served he achieved considerable administrative merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和中，入為司會中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianhe he entered service as Middle Grand Master of the Accounts Ministry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianhe he entered service as middle grand master of the accounts ministry.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德二年，為聘齊使主。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jiande he served as chief envoy on a mission to Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiande 2 (573) he headed the embassy to Northern Qi.
