items.sourceTextOverride: 子羅，先在東魏，乃以次子善為嗣。及齊平，羅至。善卒，又以羅為嗣。羅字羅仁。大象元年，除楚安郡守，授儀同大將軍。善（子）字伏陀，幼聰慧，善騎射，以父勳，封魏寧縣公。

manualTranslations.zh: 子羅，先在東魏，乃以次子善為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Luo was first in Eastern Wei; he therefore made his second son Shan his heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Luo was still in Eastern Wei, so he made his second son Shan his heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 及齊平，羅至。
manualTranslations.literal: When Qi was pacified, Luo arrived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Northern Qi was pacified, Luo arrived.

manualTranslations.zh: 善卒，又以羅為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shan died, Luo was again made heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shan died, Luo was again made heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 羅字羅仁。
manualTranslations.literal: Luo, styled Luoren.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Luo, styled Luoren.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象元年，除楚安郡守，授儀同大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daxiang he was appointed prefect of Chuan commandery and granted General of Matching Court Equipage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daxiang 1 (579) he was appointed prefect of Chuan commandery and granted general of matching court equipage.

manualTranslations.zh: 善（子）字伏陀，幼聰慧，善騎射，以父勳，封魏寧縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: Shan [variant: Zi], styled Futu, from youth clever and perceptive, skilled at mounted archery; on account of his father's merit he was enfeoffed Duke of Weining county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shan [variant: Zi], styled Futu, clever from childhood and skilled at riding and archery; for his father's merit he was enfeoffed duke of Weining county.

sourceRange.text: 及魏孝武西遷，以奉迎功，進封下博縣伯，邑五百戶，行東雍州事。在州未幾，百姓懷之。賜姓烏丸氏。大統元年，拜衞將軍、右光祿大夫，進爵為公，增邑一千戶，加車騎大將軍、儀同三司、北雍州刺史。其後常從太祖征伐，累有戰功。又從破齊神武於沙苑，加開府、侍中，進爵河間郡公，增邑通前二千七百戶。先是河、渭間種羌屢叛，以德有威名，為夷民所附，除河州刺史。德綏撫有方，羣羌率服。十三年，授大都督、原靈顯三州五原蒲川二鎮諸軍事。十四年，除涇州刺史。卒於州。諡曰獻。

context.beforeSource: 涇州所部五郡，而德常為最。
context.afterSource: 德性厚重廉慎，言行無擇。
context.beforeLocal: 涇州所部五郡，而德常為最。
context.afterLocal: 德性厚重廉慎，言行無擇。

manualTranslations.zh: 及魏孝武西遷，以奉迎功，進封下博縣伯，邑五百戶，行東雍州事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, for merit in welcoming the emperor he was advanced to Earl of Xiabo county with five hundred households and directed the affairs of East Yong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu fled west, Wang De was raised to Earl of Xiabo with five hundred households for welcoming the emperor and was put in charge of East Yong Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州未幾，百姓懷之。
manualTranslations.literal: Not long in the province, the common people cherished him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long the people of the province came to cherish him.

manualTranslations.zh: 賜姓烏丸氏。
manualTranslations.literal: He was granted the surname Wuhuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was granted the surname Wuhuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，拜衞將軍、右光祿大夫，進爵為公，增邑一千戶，加車騎大將軍、儀同三司、北雍州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong year one he was appointed guard general and right grand master of splendid happiness, advanced in rank to duke and his fief increased by one thousand households, with additional posts as grand general of chariots and cavalry, three-division court equipage, and governor of North Yong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one he became guard general and right grand master of splendid happiness, was raised to duke with one thousand more households, and was further given grand general of chariots and cavalry, three-division court equipage, and the governorship of North Yong Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後常從太祖征伐，累有戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereafter he often followed the Grand Progenitor on campaigns and repeatedly had battlefield merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereafter he often followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai on campaign and won repeated battlefield honors.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從破齊神武於沙苑，加開府、侍中，進爵河間郡公，增邑通前二千七百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Again following in defeating Gao Huan at Shaya, he was added opening office and palace attendant, advanced to Duke of Hejian commandery, and his fief together with the previous total reached two thousand seven hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also shared in defeating Gao Huan at Shaya, became opening-the-feudatory and palace attendant, was raised to Duke of Hejian, and his combined fief reached two thousand seven hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是河、渭間種羌屢叛，以德有威名，為夷民所附，除河州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier the tribal Qiang between the He and Wei rivers had repeatedly rebelled; because De had a fierce reputation and was followed by the frontier peoples, he was made governor of He Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier the tribal Qiang between the He and Wei had rebelled repeatedly; because Wang De had a fierce reputation and the frontier peoples followed him, he was made governor of He Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 德綏撫有方，羣羌率服。
manualTranslations.literal: De pacified them with proper methods and the Qiang for the most part submitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang De pacified them skillfully and the Qiang largely submitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，授大都督、原靈顯三州五原蒲川二鎮諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was granted grand commander and overall military affairs of the three provinces of Yuan, Ling, and Xian and the two garrisons of Wuyuan and Puchuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was made grand commander with overall military authority over the three provinces of Yuan, Ling, and Xian and the two garrisons of Wuyuan and Puchuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，除涇州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was made governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made governor of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒於州。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the province.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰獻。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Xian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous name was Xian, "Offering."

sourceRange.text: 及太祖置十二軍，簡諸將以將之，亮領一軍。每征討，常與怡峯俱為騎將。魏孝武西遷，以迎駕功，除使持節、右光祿大夫、左大都督、南秦州刺史。大統元年，以復潼關功，進位車騎大將軍、儀同三司，改封饒陽縣伯，邑五百戶。尋加侍中。從擒竇泰，復弘農及沙苑之役，亮竝力戰有功。遷開府儀同三司、大都督，進爵長廣郡公，邑通前二千戶。以母憂去職，居喪毀瘠。太祖嗟其至性，每愛惜之。俄起復本官。

context.beforeSource: 於是諸州羣賊，皆即歸款。
context.afterSource: 亮以勇敢見知，為時名將，兼屢陳謀策，多合機宜。
context.beforeLocal: 於是諸州群賊，皆即歸款。

manualTranslations.zh: 及太祖置十二軍，簡諸將以將之，亮領一軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor established the twelve armies and selected various generals to command them, Liang led one army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai formed the twelve armies and chose commanders for them, Liu Liang led one corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 每征討，常與怡峯俱為騎將。
manualTranslations.literal: On every campaign he usually served with Yi Feng together as cavalry generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On campaign he usually served as cavalry commander alongside Yi Feng.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝武西遷，以迎駕功，除使持節、右光祿大夫、左大都督、南秦州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, for merit in welcoming the imperial carriage he was made bearer of staff of authority, right grand master of splendid happiness, left grand commander, and governor of South Qin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu fled west, Liu Liang was rewarded for welcoming the imperial carriage with full credentials, right grand master of splendid happiness, left grand commander, and governor of South Qin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，以復潼關功，進位車騎大將軍、儀同三司，改封饒陽縣伯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong year one, for merit in recovering Tong Pass, his rank was advanced to grand general of chariots and cavalry and three-division court equipage, and he was re-enfeoffed Earl of Raoyang county with five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one, for recovering Tong Pass, he was raised to grand general of chariots and cavalry with three-division court equipage and re-enfeoffed Earl of Raoyang with five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was added palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon became palace attendant as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 從擒竇泰，復弘農及沙苑之役，亮竝力戰有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Following in capturing Dou Tai and the campaigns to recover Hongnong and at Shaya, Liang each time fought hard with merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He shared in capturing Dou Tai and the campaigns to recover Hongnong and at Shaya, fighting hard each time with merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷開府儀同三司、大都督，進爵長廣郡公，邑通前二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to opening-office three-division court equipage and grand commander, advanced in rank to Duke of Changguang commandery, with a combined fief totaling two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made opening-office three-division court equipage and grand commander, raised to Duke of Changguang, and his combined fief reached two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 以母憂去職，居喪毀瘠。
manualTranslations.literal: He left office on account of mourning for his mother and wore himself gaunt in bereavement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his mother and wasted away in grief.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嗟其至性，每愛惜之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor sighed at his utmost filial nature and always cherished him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai admired his deep filial devotion and always treated him with special regard.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄起復本官。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was recalled to restore his former office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to his former post.

sourceRange.text: 大統元年，轉右衞將軍，進爵信都縣公，邑一千戶。尋授尚書右僕射。從太祖復弘農，破沙苑，加侍中、開府儀同三司，進爵廣平郡公，增邑一千五百戶。出為東雍州刺史。為政舉大綱而已，民庶稱焉。四年，薨於州。臨終唯以國步未康為恨，言不及家。贈太尉、尚書令、雍州刺史，諡曰武昭。

manualTranslations.literal: In Datong year one he was transferred to right guard general, advanced in rank to Duke of Xindu county with a fief of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one Liang Yu became right guard general and was raised to Duke of Xindu with one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋授尚書右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed vice director of the Masters of Writing on the right.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon made vice director of the Masters of Writing on the right.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太祖復弘農，破沙苑，加侍中、開府儀同三司，進爵廣平郡公，增邑一千五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the Grand Progenitor in recovering Hongnong and breaking Shaya, he was added palace attendant and opening-office three-division court equipage, advanced in rank to Duke of Guangping commandery, and his fief was increased by one thousand five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai in recovering Hongnong and breaking Shaya, became palace attendant and opening-office three-division court equipage, was raised to Duke of Guangping, and gained one thousand five hundred more households.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為東雍州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as governor of East Yong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as governor of East Yong Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 為政舉大綱而已，民庶稱焉。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance held only to the broad outlines, and the common people praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In office he kept to the broad outlines of governance, and the people praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，薨於州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he died in the province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died in the province.

manualTranslations.zh: 臨終唯以國步未康為恨，言不及家。
manualTranslations.literal: At his end he regretted only that the state was not yet secure and spoke not of family.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On his deathbed he regretted only that the realm was not yet secure and said nothing of his household.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太尉、尚書令、雍州刺史，諡曰武昭。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was given grand commandant, director of the Masters of Writing, and governor of Yong Province; his posthumous title was Wuzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand commandant, director of the Masters of Writing, and governor of Yong Province with the posthumous name Wuzhao, "Martial and Illustrious."

sourceRange.text: 尋拜秦州刺史，未及之部，遷司空。惠性剛質，有勇力，容貌魁岸。善於撫御，將士莫不懷恩，人思効節。十二年，東魏將侯景侵襄州，惠率兵擊走之。明年，景請內附，朝議欲收輯河南，令惠以本官鎮魯陽，以為聲援。遇疾，薨於軍。惠於諸將年最少。早喪父，事母以孝聞。太祖嘗造射堂新成，與諸將宴射。惠竊歎曰：「親老矣，何時辦此乎？」太祖聞之，即日徙堂於惠宅。其見重如此。及薨，太祖為之流涕者久之。惠喪至，又臨撫焉。贈本官，加秦州刺史，諡曰武烈。子鳳嗣。

context.beforeSource: 太祖壯之。
context.afterSource: 鳳字達摩，少沉深，有識度。

manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed governor of Qin Province; before he could reach his post he was transferred to minister of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed governor of Qin Province, but before he could take up the post he was transferred to minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠性剛質，有勇力，容貌魁岸。
manualTranslations.literal: Hui's nature was firm and plain; he had courage and strength and a towering appearance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gan Hui was forthright by nature, brave and strong, with a towering build.

manualTranslations.zh: 善於撫御，將士莫不懷恩，人思効節。
manualTranslations.literal: Skilled at comforting and commanding, officers and soldiers all cherished his kindness and men wished to devote their loyalty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Skilled at winning men, he earned the gratitude of officers and soldiers alike, and his men were eager to serve him faithfully.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，東魏將侯景侵襄州，惠率兵擊走之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year Eastern Wei general Hou Jing invaded Xiang Province; Hui led troops and drove him off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Eastern Wei general Hou Jing invaded Xiang Province; Gan Hui led troops and drove him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，景請內附，朝議欲收輯河南，令惠以本官鎮魯陽，以為聲援。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year Jing requested to come over within the borders; court deliberation wished to gather and consolidate Henan, and ordered Hui to garrison Luyang in his former office as supporting force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year Hou Jing asked to defect; the court planned to recover Henan and ordered Gan Hui to garrison Luyang in his existing office as a supporting force.

manualTranslations.zh: 遇疾，薨於軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He encountered illness and died in the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He fell ill and died in camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠於諸將年最少。
manualTranslations.literal: Among the generals Hui was the youngest in years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Among the generals Gan Hui was the youngest.

manualTranslations.zh: 早喪父，事母以孝聞。
manualTranslations.literal: He lost his father early and was famed for serving his mother with filial piety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He lost his father early and was known for filial devotion to his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嘗造射堂新成，與諸將宴射。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor once built a new archery hall and feasted and shot with the generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai once completed a new archery hall and feasted and shot with his generals.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠竊歎曰：「親老矣，何時辦此乎？」
manualTranslations.literal: Hui secretly sighed and said: "My parents are old—when could I provide such a thing for them?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gan Hui sighed to himself: "My parents are old—when will I be able to give them something like this?"

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖聞之，即日徙堂於惠宅。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor heard this he that very day moved the hall to Hui's residence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai heard this he moved the hall to Gan Hui's home that very day.

manualTranslations.zh: 其見重如此。
manualTranslations.literal: Such was the esteem in which he was held.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Such was the esteem in which he was held.

manualTranslations.zh: 及薨，太祖為之流涕者久之。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died the Grand Progenitor wept for him a long while.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai wept for him a long while.

manualTranslations.zh: 惠喪至，又臨撫焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hui's coffin arrived he again came in person to comfort them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the funeral procession arrived he came in person again to comfort the family.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官，加秦州刺史，諡曰武烈。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted his former office with addition of governor of Qin Province; his posthumous title was Wulie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted his former offices plus governor of Qin Province, with the posthumous name Wulie, "Martial and Fierce."

manualTranslations.zh: 子鳳嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Feng inherited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Feng succeeded him.

sourceRange.text: 侯莫陳順，太保、梁國公崇之兄也。少豪俠，有志度。初事爾朱榮為統軍，後從賀拔勝鎮井陘。武泰初，討葛榮，平邢杲，征韓婁，皆有功。拜輕車將軍、羽林監。又從破元顥，進寧朔將軍、越騎校尉。普泰元年，除持節、征西將軍，封木門縣子，邑三百戶。尋加散騎常侍、千牛備身、衞將軍、閤內大都督。從魏孝武入關。順與太祖同里閈，素相友善，且其弟崇先在關中，太祖見之甚歡。乃進爵彭城郡公，邑一千戶。大統元年，拜衞尉卿，授儀同三司。及梁仚定圍逼河州，以順為大都督，與趙貴討破之，即行河州事。後從太祖破沙苑，以功增邑千戶。

context.beforeSource: 尋敗，被誅。
context.afterSource: 四年，魏文帝東討，與太尉王盟、僕射周惠達等留鎮長安。

context.afterLocal: 四年，魏文帝東討，與太尉王盟、僕射周惠達等留鎮長安。

manualTranslations.zh: 武泰初，討葛榮，平邢杲，征韓婁，皆有功。
manualTranslations.literal: At the start of Wutai he campaigned against Ge Rong, pacified Xing Gao, and attacked Han Lou, all with merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Wutai era he fought Ge Rong, put down Xing Gao, and campaigned against Han Lou, winning merit in each.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜輕車將軍、羽林監。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed general of light chariots and overseer of the Feathered Forest guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made general of light chariots and overseer of the Feathered Forest guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從破元顥，進寧朔將軍、越騎校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Again following in the defeat of Yuan Hao, he was advanced to general who pacifies the north and colonel of cross-country cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also took part in defeating Yuan Hao and was promoted to general who pacifies the north and colonel of cross-country cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 普泰元年，除持節、征西將軍，封木門縣子，邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In Putai year one he was made bearer of staff, general who campaigns west, and enfeoffed Viscount of Mumen county with a fief of three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Putai year one he received full credentials as general who campaigns west and was enfeoffed Viscount of Mumen with three hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋加散騎常侍、千牛備身、衞將軍、閤內大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was given the added posts of attendant gentleman of scattered cavalry, thousand-ox bodyguard, guard general, and grand commander within the gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon received the added titles attendant gentleman of scattered cavalry, thousand-ox bodyguard, guard general, and grand commander within the gate.

manualTranslations.zh: 從魏孝武入關。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei in entering the passes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei west into the passes.

manualTranslations.zh: 順與太祖同里閈，素相友善，且其弟崇先在關中，太祖見之甚歡。
manualTranslations.literal: Shun and the Grand Progenitor were from the same lane and quarter, long friendly with each other; moreover his younger brother Chong was already in Guanzhong, and when the Grand Progenitor saw Shun he was greatly pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shun and Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai came from the same neighborhood and had long been friends; his brother Chong was already in Guanzhong, and the Grand Progenitor was delighted to see him.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃進爵彭城郡公，邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon his nobility was advanced to Duke of Pengcheng commandery with a fief of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then raised to Duke of Pengcheng with one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，拜衞尉卿，授儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: In Datong year one he was appointed commandant of the guard and granted three-division court equipage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one he became commandant of the guard and received three-division court equipage.

manualTranslations.zh: 及梁仚定圍逼河州，以順為大都督，與趙貴討破之，即行河州事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liang Chaoding besieged and pressed He Province, Shun was made grand commander; together with Zhao Gui he campaigned and defeated him, and thereupon acted in He Province affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liang Chaoding besieged He Province, Shun was made grand commander; with Zhao Gui he defeated the rebels and then administered He Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 後從太祖破沙苑，以功增邑千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he followed the Grand Progenitor in breaking Shaya; for merit his fief was increased by one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai in the victory at Shaya and gained one thousand more households for his fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 武性貪恡，其為大司寇也，在庫有萬釘金帶，當時寶之，武因入庫，乃取以歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Wu by nature was greedy and stingy; when he was grand minister of justice, in the treasury there was a gold belt with ten thousand studs, treasured at the time; Wu entered the treasury and took it home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Da Xiwu was greedy by nature. While serving as grand minister of justice he entered the treasury and took home a gold belt studded with ten thousand nails that was kept there as a treasure.

manualTranslations.zh: 主者白晉公護，以武勳，不彰其過，因而賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: The keeper reported it to Duke of Jin Hu; on account of Wu's merit, his fault was not exposed, and Hu thereupon granted it to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The keeper reported the theft to Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu, who, because of Da Xiwu's merit, kept the matter quiet and formally granted him the belt.

manualTranslations.zh: 時論深鄙焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Opinion of the time deeply despised this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Contemporary opinion despised him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年十月，薨，年六十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year he died, aged sixty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year he died, aged sixty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太傅、十五州諸軍事、同州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was given grand tutor, military affairs of fifteen provinces, and governor of Tong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made grand tutor, commander of military affairs in fifteen provinces, and governor of Tong.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰桓。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Huan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Huan.

manualTranslations.zh: 子震嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Zhen succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Zi Zhen succeeded him.

sourceRange.text: 父崙以雄（傑）著勳，追贈柱國大將軍、少傅、安康郡公。雄儀貌魁梧，少有謀畧。永安末，從賀拔岳入關，除征西將軍、金紫光祿大夫。魏孝武西遷，授都督，封臨貞縣伯，邑五百戶。大統初，進爵為公，增邑二百戶。拜武衞將軍，加驃騎將軍，增邑八百戶，進大都督。尋拜儀同三司，增邑三百戶。遷開府儀同三司，加侍中，出為岐州刺史。進爵武威郡公，進位大將軍，行同州事。十七年，雄率軍出子午谷，圍梁上津、魏興。明年，克之，以其地為東梁州。尋而復叛，又令雄討之。魏恭帝元年，賜姓可頻氏。孝閔帝踐阼，授少傅，增邑二千戶，進位柱國大將軍。武成初，進封庸國公，邑萬戶。尋出為涇州總管諸軍事、涇州刺史。保定四年，從晉公護東征。雄在塗遇病，乃自力而進。至邙山，與齊將斛律明月接戰。雄馳馬衝之，殺三人，明月退走，雄追之。明月左右皆散，矢又盡，惟餘一奴一矢在焉。雄按矟不及明月者丈餘，曰：「惜爾不殺得，但任爾見天子。」明月乃射雄，中額，抱馬退走，至營而薨。時年五十八。贈使持節、太保、同華等二十州諸軍事、同州刺史，諡曰忠。子謙嗣，自有傳。

manualTranslations.zh: 父崙以雄（傑）著勳，追贈柱國大將軍、少傅、安康郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Lun, on account of Xiong's outstanding merit, was posthumously awarded pillar of state and grand general, junior tutor, and Duke of Ankang commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Lun, on account of Wang Xiong's outstanding merit, was posthumously made pillar of state and grand general, junior tutor, and Duke of Ankang.

manualTranslations.zh: 雄儀貌魁梧，少有謀畧。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong was imposing in bearing and stature; from youth he had stratagem and plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong was imposing in stature and showed strategic talent even in youth.

manualTranslations.zh: 永安末，從賀拔岳入關，除征西將軍、金紫光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Yong'an he followed He Ba Yue in entering the passes and was made general who campaigns west and grand master with golden seal and purple ribbon.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Yong'an he entered the passes with He Ba Yue and was made general who campaigns west and grand master with golden seal and purple ribbon.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝武西遷，授都督，封臨貞縣伯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, he was granted commander, enfeoffed Baron of Linzhen county with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu fled west, he was made a commander and enfeoffed Baron of Linzhen with five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統初，進爵為公，增邑二百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, his nobility was advanced to duke and his fief increased by two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Datong era he was raised to duke and gained two hundred more households.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜武衞將軍，加驃騎將軍，增邑八百戶，進大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed martial guard general, given the added rank of grand general of swift cavalry, his fief increased by eight hundred households, and advanced to grand commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He became martial guard general, received the added title grand general of swift cavalry, gained eight hundred more households, and was made grand commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋拜儀同三司，增邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was granted three-division court equipage and his fief increased by three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon received three-division court equipage and three hundred more households.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷開府儀同三司，加侍中，出為岐州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to opening-office three-division court equipage, given the added rank of palace attendant, and sent out as governor of Qi Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made opening-office three-division court equipage and palace attendant, then sent out as governor of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 進爵武威郡公，進位大將軍，行同州事。
manualTranslations.literal: His nobility was advanced to Duke of Wuwei commandery, his rank advanced to grand general, and he directed Tong Province affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was raised to Duke of Wuwei and grand general and put in charge of Tong Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年，雄率軍出子午谷，圍梁上津、魏興。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Xiong led troops out through Ziwu Valley and besieged Liang's Shangjin and Weixing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Wang Xiong marched through Ziwu Valley and besieged Liang's Shangjin and Weixing.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，克之，以其地為東梁州。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he took them and made the territory East Liang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he captured both places and organized the region as East Liang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋而復叛，又令雄討之。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon they rebelled again, and Xiong was again ordered to campaign against them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They soon rebelled again, and Wang Xiong was sent to put them down once more.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝元年，賜姓可頻氏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, he was granted the surname Kebin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei he was granted the surname Kebin.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，授少傅，增邑二千戶，進位柱國大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was granted junior tutor, his fief increased by two thousand households, and his rank advanced to pillar-of-state grand general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin acceded he was made junior tutor, gained two thousand more households, and was raised to pillar-of-state grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成初，進封庸國公，邑萬戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the start of Wucheng, he was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Yong state with a fief of ten thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the start of the Wucheng reign he was raised to Duke of Yong with ten thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋出為涇州總管諸軍事、涇州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he went out as area commander of all military affairs of Jing Province and governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon sent out as area commander of Jing and governor of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定四年，從晉公護東征。
manualTranslations.literal: In Baoding year four, he followed Duke of Jin Hu in the eastern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Baoding year four he joined Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu on the eastern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 雄在塗遇病，乃自力而進。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong fell ill on the road, yet forced himself onward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong fell ill on the march but forced himself onward.

manualTranslations.zh: 至邙山，與齊將斛律明月接戰。
manualTranslations.literal: Reaching Mount Mang, he joined battle with Qi general Hulu Mingyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Mount Mang he fought Qi general Hulu Mingyue.

manualTranslations.zh: 雄馳馬衝之，殺三人，明月退走，雄追之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong charged on horseback, killed three men; Mingyue retreated and fled, and Xiong pursued him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong charged on horseback, killed three men, and drove Mingyue back; he pursued him.

manualTranslations.zh: 明月左右皆散，矢又盡，惟餘一奴一矢在焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Mingyue's attendants had all scattered; his arrows were again exhausted; only one servant and one arrow remained.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mingyue's escort had scattered, his arrows were spent, and only one servant and one arrow remained.

manualTranslations.zh: 雄按矟不及明月者丈餘，曰：「惜爾不殺得，但任爾見天子。」
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong pressed his spear and was not more than ten feet from reaching Mingyue, and said: "A pity I could not kill you—only go and see the Son of Heaven for me."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong leveled his spear within ten feet of Mingyue and cried: "A pity I could not kill you—go see the Son of Heaven for me."

manualTranslations.zh: 明月乃射雄，中額，抱馬退走，至營而薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Mingyue then shot Xiong, struck his forehead; clutching his horse he retreated and fled, and died on reaching camp.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mingyue shot back, struck Wang Xiong in the forehead, and fled clinging to his horse; Wang Xiong died after reaching camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 時年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time he was fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈使持節、太保、同華等二十州諸軍事、同州刺史，諡曰忠。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was given bearer of staff, grand guardian, military affairs of twenty provinces including Tong and Hua, and governor of Tong Province; his posthumous title was Zhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made bearer of staff, grand guardian, commander of twenty provinces including Tong and Hua, and governor of Tong, with the posthumous title Zhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 子謙嗣，自有傳。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Qian succeeded; he has his own biography.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Qian succeeded him; Qian has his own biography.

sourceRange.text: 晉公護母，慶之姑也。護雖擅朝，而慶未嘗阿附。及護誅，高祖以此重之。乃詔慶第十二子毗尚帝女清都公主。慶雖位望隆重，婚連帝室，常以謙慎自守，時人以此稱之。建德二年，抗表致仕，優詔許焉。慶既衰老，恆嬰沉痼。宣帝以其先朝耆舊，特異常倫，乃詔靜帝至第問疾。賜布帛千段。醫藥所須，令有司供給。大象二年，拜上柱國。隋文帝踐極，又令皇太子就第問疾，仍供醫藥之費。開皇二年薨，時年七十七。贈司空、荊譙淅湖灃廣蒙七州諸軍事、荊州刺史。諡曰成。

context.beforeSource: 天和六年，進位柱國。
context.afterSource: 長子常，先慶卒。
context.beforeLocal: 天和六年，進位柱國。
context.afterLocal: 長子常，先慶卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 晉公護母，慶之姑也。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu's mother was Qing's paternal aunt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu's mother was Yan Qing's paternal aunt.

manualTranslations.zh: 護雖擅朝，而慶未嘗阿附。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Hu monopolized the court, Qing never curried favor with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Yuwen Hu monopolized the court, Yan Qing never curried favor with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及護誅，高祖以此重之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hu was executed, the High Ancestor highly valued him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuwen Hu was executed, High Ancestor Yuwen Yong highly valued him for this.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃詔慶第十二子毗尚帝女清都公主。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict then had Qing's twelfth son Pi marry the emperor's daughter, Princess Qingdu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict then had Yan Qing's twelfth son Pi marry the emperor's daughter, Princess Qingdu.

manualTranslations.zh: 慶雖位望隆重，婚連帝室，常以謙慎自守，時人以此稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: Though Qing's rank and stature were weighty and his marriage tied him to the imperial house, he always kept himself with humility and caution, and people praised him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Yan Qing's rank and stature were weighty and his marriage tied him to the imperial house, he always kept himself humble and cautious, and people praised him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德二年，抗表致仕，優詔許焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jiande he submitted a memorial resisting further service and requesting retirement; a gracious edict granted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiande 2 (573) he submitted a memorial requesting retirement; a gracious edict granted it.

manualTranslations.zh: 慶既衰老，恆嬰沉痼。
manualTranslations.literal: Qing had grown old and was constantly afflicted with lingering illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan Qing had grown old and was constantly afflicted with lingering illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝以其先朝耆舊，特異常倫，乃詔靜帝至第問疾。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xuan, because he was an elder of the former reign, treated him with exceptional regard beyond ordinary custom, and issued an edict for Emperor Jing to visit his residence to inquire after his health.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan, because he was an elder of the former reign, treated him with exceptional regard and issued an edict for Emperor Jing to visit his residence to inquire after his health.

manualTranslations.zh: 賜布帛千段。
manualTranslations.literal: He was granted one thousand segments of cloth and silk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was granted one thousand segments of cloth and silk.

manualTranslations.zh: 醫藥所須，令有司供給。
manualTranslations.literal: Whatever medicine was needed was ordered supplied by the relevant offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whatever medicine was needed was ordered supplied by the relevant offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象二年，拜上柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Daxiang he was made upper pillar of state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daxiang 2 (580) he was made upper pillar of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋文帝踐極，又令皇太子就第問疾，仍供醫藥之費。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui took the throne, he again ordered the crown prince to visit his residence to inquire after his health and continued to supply medical expenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui took the throne, he again ordered the crown prince to visit his residence to inquire after his health and continued to supply medical expenses.

manualTranslations.zh: 開皇二年薨，時年七十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Kaihuang he died, at age seventy-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Kaihuang 2 (582), at age seventy-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈司空、荊譙淅湖灃廣蒙七州諸軍事、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously given minister of works, command over military affairs of the seven provinces of Jing, Qiao, Xi, Hu, Feng, Guang, and Meng, and governor of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made minister of works, commander over military affairs of Jing, Qiao, Xi, Hu, Feng, Guang, and Meng provinces, and governor of Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰成。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumous title: Cheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Cheng.

sourceRange.text: 尉遲綱字婆羅，蜀國公迥之弟也。少孤，與兄迥依託舅氏。太祖西討關隴，迥、綱與母昌樂大長公主留于晉陽，後方入關。從太祖征伐，常陪侍帷幄，出入臥內。後以迎魏孝武功，拜殿中將軍。大統元年，授帳內都督，從儀同李虎討曹泥，破之。又從破竇泰。以功封廣宗縣伯，邑五百戶。仍從復弘農，克河北郡，戰沙苑，皆有功。

context.afterSource: 綱驍果有膂力，善騎射。

manualTranslations.literal: Wei Chigang, styled Bala, was younger brother of Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei Chigang, styled Bala, was the younger brother of Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 少孤，與兄迥依託舅氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Orphaned young, he and his elder brother Jiong relied on their maternal kin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Orphaned in youth, he and his elder brother Jiong relied on their maternal kin.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖西討關隴，迥、綱與母昌樂大長公主留于晉陽，後方入關。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor campaigned west against Guanlong, Jiong and Gang with their mother, the Grand Princess of Changle, remained at Jinyang, only later entering Guanzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai campaigned west against Guanlong, Jiong and Gang with their mother, the Grand Princess of Changle, remained at Jinyang and only later entered Guanzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太祖征伐，常陪侍帷幄，出入臥內。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the Grand Progenitor on campaigns, constantly attending within the command tent and entering and leaving the inner quarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai on campaigns, constantly attending within the command tent and passing in and out of the inner quarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以迎魏孝武功，拜殿中將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Later for merit in welcoming Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, he was appointed general of the palace interior.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, for merit in welcoming Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, he was appointed general of the palace interior.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，授帳內都督，從儀同李虎討曹泥，破之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong he was granted commander of the inner guard, followed Equal-in-Protocol Li Hu to attack Cao Ni, and defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong he was made commander of the inner guard, followed Equal-in-Protocol Li Hu against Cao Ni, and defeated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從破竇泰。
manualTranslations.literal: He also followed in defeating Dou Tai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also took part in defeating Dou Tai.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功封廣宗縣伯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Guangzong with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his service he was enfeoffed baron of Guangzong with a fief of five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍從復弘農，克河北郡，戰沙苑，皆有功。
manualTranslations.literal: He again followed in recovering Hongnong, capturing Hebei commandery, and fighting at Shayuan, all with merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again followed in recovering Hongnong, capturing Hebei commandery, and fighting at Shayuan, distinguishing himself in each.

sourceRange.text: 勵弟懋，字小興。盟之西征，以懋尚幼，留在山東。永安中，始入關，與盟相見，遂從征伐。大統初，賜爵安平縣子，授揚烈將軍。從盟迎魏悼后還，拜城門校尉。魏文帝東征，以撫軍將軍兼太子左率，留守。俄轉右率。歷尚食典御、領左右、武衞將軍。錄前後功，進爵為公，增邑千戶，遷右衞將軍。于時疆埸交兵，未申喪紀，服齊斬者，並墨縗從事。及盟薨，懋上表辭位，乞終喪制。魏文帝不許。累遷大都督、散騎常侍、使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、侍中、左衞將軍、領軍將軍。

context.afterSource: 懋性溫和，小心敬慎。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Li's younger brother Wang Mao, styled Xiaoxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 盟之西征，以懋尚幼，留在山東。
manualTranslations.literal: When Meng campaigned west, because Mao was still young, he was left behind in Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wang Meng campaigned west, Mao was still young and was left behind in Shandong.

manualTranslations.zh: 永安中，始入關，與盟相見，遂從征伐。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Yongan era he first entered Guanzhong, met Meng, and then followed on campaigns.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Yongan era he first entered Guanzhong, was reunited with Wang Meng, and then followed him on campaigns.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統初，賜爵安平縣子，授揚烈將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Datong he was enfeoffed Viscount of Anping and appointed general who displays martial ardor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Datong era he was enfeoffed viscount of Anping and made general who displays martial ardor.

manualTranslations.zh: 從盟迎魏悼后還，拜城門校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Meng in escorting Empress Dowager Dao of Wei back and was appointed commandant of the city gates.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Wang Meng in escorting Empress Dowager Dao of Wei back and was appointed commandant of the city gates.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏文帝東征，以撫軍將軍兼太子左率，留守。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Wei campaigned east, he was made general who pacifies the army and concurrent left commander of the crown prince guard, remaining to hold the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Wei campaigned east, he was made general who pacifies the army and concurrent left commander of the crown prince guard, remaining behind to hold the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄轉右率。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was transferred to right commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to right commander of the crown prince guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷尚食典御、領左右、武衞將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively held chief steward of imperial food, commander of the left and right guard, and martial guard general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He successively served as chief steward of imperial food, commander of the left and right guard, and martial guard general.

manualTranslations.zh: 錄前後功，進爵為公，增邑千戶，遷右衞將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: His earlier and later achievements were recorded; he was advanced to duke, his fief increased by one thousand households, and he was transferred to right martial guard general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His earlier and later service was recorded; he was raised to duke, his fief increased by one thousand households, and he was made right martial guard general.

manualTranslations.zh: 于時疆埸交兵，未申喪紀，服齊斬者，並墨縗從事。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the border was active with warfare; mourning rites could not be fully observed, and those wearing the full hemp mourning of qi-dun rank all wore undyed mourning bands while on duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the frontier was at war; mourning observances could not be fully carried out, and those in the full hemp mourning of qi-dun rank all wore undyed mourning bands while serving.

manualTranslations.zh: 及盟薨，懋上表辭位，乞終喪制。
manualTranslations.literal: When Meng died, Mao submitted a memorial resigning his post and begging to complete the full mourning period.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wang Meng died, Mao submitted a memorial resigning his post and begging to observe the full mourning period.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏文帝不許。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wen of Wei did not permit it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Wei refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷大都督、散騎常侍、使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、侍中、左衞將軍、領軍將軍。

sourceRange.text: 先是，慶兄檜為魏興郡守，為賊黃寶所害。檜子三人，皆幼弱，慶撫養甚篤。後寶率眾歸朝，朝廷待以優禮。居數年，檜次子雄亮白日手刃寶於長安城中。晉公護聞而大怒，執慶及諸子姪皆囚之。讓慶曰：「國家憲綱，皆君等所為。雖有私怨，寧得擅殺人也！」對曰：「慶聞父母之讐不同天，昆弟之讐不同國。明公以孝治天下，何乃責於此乎。」護愈怒，慶辭色無所屈，卒以此免。天和元年十二月薨。時年五十，贈鄜綏丹三州刺史，諡曰景。子機嗣。

context.beforeSource: 保定三年，又入為司會。
context.afterSource: 機字匡時，少有令譽，風儀辭令，為當世所推。

manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, Qing's elder brother Gui was governor of Weixing commandery and was killed by the bandit Huang Bao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Liu Qing's elder brother Gui had been governor of Weixing commandery and was killed by the bandit Huang Bao.

manualTranslations.zh: 檜子三人，皆幼弱，慶撫養甚篤。
manualTranslations.literal: Gui had three sons, all young and weak; Qing raised them with great devotion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui had three sons, all still young; Liu Qing raised them with great devotion.

manualTranslations.zh: 後寶率眾歸朝，朝廷待以優禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Bao led his followers to submit to the court, and the court treated him with exceptional courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Huang Bao led his followers to submit to the court, and the court treated him with exceptional courtesy.

manualTranslations.zh: 居數年，檜次子雄亮白日手刃寶於長安城中。
manualTranslations.literal: After several years, Gui's second son Xiongliang by daylight personally slew Bao in Chang'an city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After several years, Gui's second son Xiongliang personally slew Huang Bao in broad daylight in Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉公護聞而大怒，執慶及諸子姪皆囚之。
manualTranslations.literal: Duke of Jin Hu heard of this and was greatly enraged; he seized Qing and all his sons and nephews and imprisoned them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu heard of this and was greatly enraged; he seized Liu Qing and all his sons and nephews and imprisoned them.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He reproached Liu Qing, saying: "The laws of the state are all your doing.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖有私怨，寧得擅殺人也！

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, he went out as magistrate of Jie county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei he was posted as magistrate of Jie county.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，加授驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was additionally granted grand general of fast cavalry and left grand master of splendorous virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was additionally granted grand general of fast cavalry and left grand master of splendorous virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，轉汾陰令。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was transferred as magistrate of Fenyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to serve as magistrate of Fenyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 發摘姦伏，百姓畏而懷之。
manualTranslations.literal: He exposed and rooted out hidden wrongdoing; the common people feared him yet cherished him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He exposed and rooted out hidden wrongdoing; the common people feared him yet cherished him.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗初，入為地官上士。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Shizong's reign, he entered court as upper gentleman of the terrestrial office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Shizong's reign he entered court as upper gentleman of the terrestrial office.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年，授帥都督、治御伯下大夫，遷武藏下大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng, he was granted commander-in-chief, lower grand master of the imperial guard bureau, and transferred to lower grand master of the military storehouse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng 1 he was granted commander-in-chief, lower grand master of the imperial guard bureau, and transferred to lower grand master of the military storehouse.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定三年，授大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Baoding, he was granted great commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Baoding 3 he was granted great commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，加儀同三司、中外府掾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was additionally granted equal-in-three-departments and staff officer of the central and external offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was additionally granted equal-in-three-departments and made staff officer of the central and external offices.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和二年，封康城縣男，邑五百戶，轉職方中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianhe, he was enfeoffed as baron of Kangcheng county with a fief of five hundred households, and transferred to grand master of the directorate of posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianhe 2 he was enfeoffed as baron of Kangcheng county with a fief of five hundred households and transferred to grand master of the directorate of posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，授兵部中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was granted grand master of the ministry of war.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was granted grand master of the ministry of war.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖頻徙職，仍領武藏。
manualTranslations.literal: Although he was frequently transferred in office, he still concurrently headed the military storehouse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although he was frequently transferred in office, he still concurrently headed the military storehouse.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋丁母憂。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward he entered mourning for his mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he entered mourning for his mother.

manualTranslations.zh: 起為職方中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: Recalled from mourning, he was made grand master of the directorate of posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recalled from mourning, he was made grand master of the directorate of posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，轉武藏中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to grand master of the military storehouse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to grand master of the military storehouse.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄遷驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was promoted to grand general of fast cavalry and opening-office equal-to-three-division commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to grand general of fast cavalry and opening-office equal-to-three-division commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡居劇職，十有餘年，處斷無滯，官曹清肅。
manualTranslations.literal: In all he held taxing offices for more than ten years; his decisions were never delayed, and the bureaus under him were clear and orderly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In all he held taxing offices for more than ten years; his decisions were never delayed, and the bureaus under him were clear and orderly.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定元年，出為岷州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding, sent out as governor of Min Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding he was sent out as governor of Min Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 弘雖武將，而動遵法式，百姓頗安之。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Hong was a military man, his conduct followed law and regulation, and the people lived in considerable peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Tian Hong was a military man, his conduct followed law and regulation, and the people lived in considerable peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，從隨公楊忠伐齊，拜大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, followed Duke of Sui Yang Zhong against Qi and was appointed grand general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Duke of Sui Yang Zhong against Qi and was made grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，又從忠東伐。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year, again followed Yang Zhong on the eastern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he again followed Yang Zhong on the eastern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 師還，乃旋所鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army returned, he returned to his command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army returned he went back to his command.

manualTranslations.zh: 吐谷渾寇西邊，宕昌羌濳相應接，詔弘討之，獲其二十五王，拔其七十六柵，遂破平之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tuyuhun raided the western frontier and the Dangchang Qiang secretly supported them; an edict ordered Hong to suppress them; he captured twenty-five of their kings, took seventy-six stockades, and utterly defeated and pacified them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun raided the western frontier and the Dangchang Qiang secretly supported them; an edict ordered Tian Hong to suppress them; he captured twenty-five of their kings, took seventy-six stockades, and utterly defeated and pacified them.

items.acceptedSourceText: 保定元年，出為岷州刺史。弘雖武將，而動遵法式，百姓頗安之。三年，從隨公楊忠伐齊，拜大將軍。明年，又從忠東伐。師還，乃旋所鎮。吐谷渾寇西邊，宕昌羌濳相應接，詔弘討之，獲其二十五王，拔其七十六柵，遂破平之。

sourceRange.text: 魏廢帝元年，復除涼甘瓜三州諸軍事、涼州刺史。初茹茹與魏和親，後更離叛。尋為突厥所破，殺其主阿那瓌。部落逃逸者，仍奉瓌之子孫，抄掠河右。寧率兵邀擊，獲瓌子孫二人，并其種落酋長。自是每戰破之，前後獲數萬人。進爵安政郡公。三年，吐谷渾通使於齊，寧擊獲之，就拜大將軍。寧後遣使詣太祖請事，太祖即以所服冠履衣被及弓箭甲矟等賜寧。謂其使人曰：「為我謝涼州，孤解衣以衣公，推心以委公，公其善始令終，無損功名也。

context.beforeSource: 寧先在涼州，戎夷服其威惠，遷鎮之後，邊民並思慕之。
context.afterSource: 」時突厥木汗可汗假道涼州，將襲吐渾，太祖令寧率騎隨之。

manualTranslations.zh: 魏廢帝元年，復除涼甘瓜三州諸軍事、涼州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wei Emperor Fei he was again appointed commander over military affairs in Liang, Gan, and Gua provinces and Inspector of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wei Emperor Fei, Ning was again made commander over Liang, Gan, and Gua and inspector of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 初茹茹與魏和親，後更離叛。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Rouran made peace with Wei through marriage, but later turned to rebellion again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rouran had first made peace with Wei by marriage, but later broke away in rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋為突厥所破，殺其主阿那瓌。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon they were broken by the Türks, who killed their ruler Anagui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Türks soon defeated them and killed their khan Anagui.

manualTranslations.zh: 部落逃逸者，仍奉瓌之子孫，抄掠河右。
manualTranslations.literal: Fugitive clans still upheld Anagui's descendants and raided the lands west of the Yellow River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fugitive tribes still rallied to Anagui's descendants and raided the Hexi region.

manualTranslations.zh: 寧率兵邀擊，獲瓌子孫二人，并其種落酋長。
manualTranslations.literal: Ning led troops to intercept them, capturing two of Anagui's descendants together with chiefs of their clans.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ning intercepted them in the field, seizing two of Anagui's descendants and several tribal chiefs.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是每戰破之，前後獲數萬人。
manualTranslations.literal: From then on he defeated them in every battle and in all took tens of thousands captive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After that he defeated them in battle after battle and took tens of thousands captive.

manualTranslations.zh: 進爵安政郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was advanced in rank to Duke of Anzheng commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was raised to Duke of Anzheng commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，吐谷渾通使於齊，寧擊獲之，就拜大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year Tuyuhun sent envoys to Qi; Ning intercepted and captured them and was thereupon appointed Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3, when Tuyuhun sent envoys to Qi, Ning seized them and was made grand general on the spot.

manualTranslations.zh: 寧後遣使詣太祖請事，太祖即以所服冠履衣被及弓箭甲矟等賜寧。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Ning sent envoys to the Grand Progenitor to report his affairs, and the Grand Progenitor at once gave Ning the cap, shoes, robes, bow, arrows, armor, and spear that he himself wore.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ning later sent envoys to Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai; the Grand Progenitor gave him his own cap, shoes, robes, bow, arrows, armor, and spear.

manualTranslations.zh: 謂其使人曰：「為我謝涼州，孤解衣以衣公，推心以委公，公其善始令終，無損功名也。
manualTranslations.literal: He told the envoy: "Convey my thanks to Liang Province. I have stripped off my own garments to clothe you and entrusted you my inmost heart. See that you begin and end well and do not harm your fame and merit."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He told the envoy, "Thank Liang Province for me. I have given him my own clothes and entrusted him my whole heart. Let him finish as he began and not lose his standing."

sourceRange.text: 大統二年，齊神武襲陷夏州。太祖慮其南下，與朝臣議之。賢進曰：「高歡兵士雖眾，智勇已竭，策其舉措，必不敢遠來。昔賀拔公初薨，關中振駭，而歡不能因利乘便，進取雍州，是其無智。及鑾駕西遷，六軍寡弱，毛鴻賓喪敗，關門不守，又不能乘此危機，以要一戰，是其無勇。今上下同心，士民戮力，歡志沮喪，寧敢送死。且豳夏荒阻，千里無烟，縱欲南侵，資糧莫繼。以此而言，不來必矣。」齊神武後果退，如賢所策。

context.beforeSource: 以征討有功，授都督。
context.afterSource: 尋加伏波將軍，從王思政鎮弘農。

manualTranslations.zh: 大統二年，齊神武襲陷夏州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Datong, Qi Shenwu stormed and took Xia Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year 2, Gao Huan of Eastern Wei stormed and captured Xia Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖慮其南下，與朝臣議之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor feared a southern advance and discussed it with court ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai feared a southern thrust and took counsel with his ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 賢進曰：「高歡兵士雖眾，智勇已竭，策其舉措，必不敢遠來。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian advanced and said: "Gao Huan's soldiers are many, but his wit and courage are spent; judging his conduct, he surely will not dare come far.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Xian spoke up: "Gao Huan has many soldiers, but his wit and courage are spent; he will not dare march far.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔賀拔公初薨，關中振駭，而歡不能因利乘便，進取雍州，是其無智。
manualTranslations.literal: When Duke Heba first died, Guanzhong was shaken with alarm, yet Huan could not seize the advantage and take Yong Province—that shows his lack of wisdom.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Duke Heba died, Guanzhong was terrified, yet Huan failed to seize Yong—that shows no wisdom.

manualTranslations.zh: 及鑾駕西遷，六軍寡弱，毛鴻賓喪敗，關門不守，又不能乘此危機，以要一戰，是其無勇。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage moved west, the Six Armies were few and weak, Mao Hongbin was defeated, and Tong Pass was left undefended, yet he still could not use that crisis to force a decisive battle—that shows his lack of courage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor fled west, our armies were weak, Mao Hongbin was beaten, and Tong Pass lay open, yet Huan would not risk a decisive battle—that shows no courage.

manualTranslations.zh: 今上下同心，士民戮力，歡志沮喪，寧敢送死。
manualTranslations.literal: Now above and below are of one mind and officers and people strive together; Huan's will is broken—how would he dare court death?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now court and people are united and Huan's spirit is broken; how would he throw his life away?

manualTranslations.zh: 且豳夏荒阻，千里無烟，縱欲南侵，資糧莫繼。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover Bin and Xia are desolate and blocked, with no smoke for a thousand li; even if he wished to invade south, supplies could not follow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bin and Xia are barren wastes a thousand li wide—he cannot march south without supplies.

manualTranslations.zh: 以此而言，不來必矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: On this reckoning, he certainly will not come."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He will not come."

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武後果退，如賢所策。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi Shenwu afterward did withdraw, as Xian had forecast.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Huan did withdraw, just as Xian predicted.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年，詔徵騰入朝，世宗面勑之曰：「益州險遠，非親勿居，故令齊公作鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng an edict summoned Teng to court; Emperor Shizong personally charged him, saying: "Yi Province is perilous and remote; none but kin should hold it, so I have set Duke of Qi to garrison it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng year 1 Teng was summoned to court, and Emperor Shizong told him in person, "Shu is remote and dangerous and should be held only by kin, so Duke of Qi is posted there.

manualTranslations.zh: 卿之武略，已著遐邇，兵馬鎮防，皆當委卿統攝。」
manualTranslations.literal: Your martial prowess is already famed far and near; troops, horses, and frontier defense should all be entrusted to your command."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your martial fame is known everywhere; I entrust all troops and frontier defense to you."

manualTranslations.zh: 於是徙隆州刺史，隨憲入蜀。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then made inspector of Long and entered Shu with Yuwen Xian.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Duke Zhao replaced Xian in Shu, he again asked to keep Teng there.

sourceRange.text: 武成元年，入為軍司馬。自江陵平後，巴、湘之地並內屬，每遣梁人守之。至是陳將侯瑱、侯安都等圍逼湘州，遏絕糧援。乃令敦率步騎六千，度江赴救。瑱等以敦孤軍深入，規欲取之。敦每設奇伏，連戰破瑱，乘勝徑進，遂次湘州。因此輕敵，不以為虞。俄而霖雨不已，秋水汎溢，陳人濟師，江路遂斷。糧援既絕，人懷危懼。敦於是分兵抄掠，以充資費。恐瑱等知其糧少，乃於營內多為土聚，覆之以米，集諸營軍士，人各持囊，遣官司部分，若欲給糧者。因召側近村民，陽有所訪問，令於營外遙見，隨即遣之。瑱等聞之，良以為實。乃據守要險，欲曠日以老敦師。敦又增修營壘，造廬舍，示以持久。湘、羅之間，遂廢農業。瑱等無如之何。

context.beforeSource: 復令敦與開府潘招討之，擒子榮，并虜其眾。
context.afterSource: 初，土人亟乘輕船，載米粟及籠鷄鴨以餉瑱軍。

context.afterLocal: 初，土人亟乘輕船，載米粟及籠雞鴨以餉瑱軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年，入為軍司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng he entered the capital as Army Vice-Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng year 1 he was recalled to court as army vice-marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 自江陵平後，巴、湘之地並內屬，每遣梁人守之。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jiangling was pacified, the lands of Ba and Xiang all submitted within the realm, and Liang men were regularly sent to garrison them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jiangling fell, Ba and Xiang submitted and Liang men were posted to hold them.

manualTranslations.zh: 至是陳將侯瑱、侯安都等圍逼湘州，遏絕糧援。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Chen generals Hou Tian and Hou Andrui and others pressed and besieged Xiang Province, cutting off grain and relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then Chen generals Hou Tian and Hou Andrui besieged Xiang Province and cut off its supplies.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃令敦率步騎六千，度江赴救。
manualTranslations.literal: Dun was therefore ordered to lead six thousand infantry and cavalry to cross the river in relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He Ruodun was ordered to cross the Yangzi with six thousand foot and horse to relieve the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑱等以敦孤軍深入，規欲取之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tian and the others, seeing Dun's isolated army deep in enemy territory, planned to take him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Tian, seeing a lone army deep in Chen territory, meant to destroy it.

manualTranslations.zh: 敦每設奇伏，連戰破瑱，乘勝徑進，遂次湘州。
manualTranslations.literal: Dun repeatedly set ambushes, defeated Tian in successive battles, pressed the victory straight forward, and encamped at Xiang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He Ruodun laid ambush after ambush, beat Hou Tian in a series of fights, and pressed on to encamp at Xiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 因此輕敵，不以為虞。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of this he held the enemy lightly and was not on guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emboldened by victory, he took the enemy lightly and relaxed his guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄而霖雨不已，秋水汎溢，陳人濟師，江路遂斷。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long unending rains fell; autumn waters overflowed; Chen troops crossed the river, and the river route was cut off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then endless rains swelled the autumn floods; Chen forces crossed the rivers and severed his water route.

manualTranslations.zh: 糧援既絕，人懷危懼。
manualTranslations.literal: Grain and relief having been cut off, men harbored fear and dread.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With supplies cut off, his men grew fearful.

manualTranslations.zh: 敦於是分兵抄掠，以充資費。
manualTranslations.literal: Dun therefore divided troops to raid and plunder to fill his expenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He Ruodun sent detachments to raid for provisions.

manualTranslations.zh: 恐瑱等知其糧少，乃於營內多為土聚，覆之以米，集諸營軍士，人各持囊，遣官司部分，若欲給糧者。
manualTranslations.literal: Fearing Tian and the others would learn his grain was scarce, he made many earthen heaps in camp and covered them with rice; he gathered soldiers of all camps, each holding a sack, and had officials assign them as if grain were to be issued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fearing Hou Tian would learn how little grain remained, he piled earthen mounds in camp, spread rice over them, and had soldiers carry sacks about as if rations were being issued.

manualTranslations.zh: 因召側近村民，陽有所訪問，令於營外遙見，隨即遣之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then summoned nearby villagers, openly made inquiries of them, had them seen from afar outside camp, and immediately sent them away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He summoned local villagers, questioned them ostentatiously within sight of the enemy camp, and sent them away at once.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑱等聞之，良以為實。
manualTranslations.literal: Tian and the others heard of it and truly took it as fact.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Tian and his officers took the deception for truth.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃據守要險，欲曠日以老敦師。
manualTranslations.literal: They therefore held vital passes and intended to wear down Dun's army over many days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They held the defiles and meant to wear his army down by delay.

manualTranslations.zh: 敦又增修營壘，造廬舍，示以持久。
manualTranslations.literal: Dun again strengthened the camps and fortifications, built huts, and showed intent to endure long.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He Ruodun strengthened his fortifications and built shelters to show he meant to stay.

manualTranslations.zh: 湘、羅之間，遂廢農業。
manualTranslations.literal: Between Xiang and Luo agriculture was thereby abandoned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Farming between the Xiang and Luo rivers came to a halt.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑱等無如之何。
manualTranslations.literal: Tian and the others could do nothing about it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Tian could do nothing to break the stalemate.

context.beforeSource: 今若拔其本根，餘種自然離散，此上策也。
context.afterSource: 木汗從北道向賀真，寧趣樹敦。

sourceRange.text: 及齊神武逼洛陽，植從魏孝武西遷。大統元年，授驃騎將軍、都督，賜姓侯伏侯氏。從太祖破沙苑，戰河橋，進大都督，加左光祿大夫。涼州刺史宇文仲和據州作逆，植從開府獨孤信討擒之，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司，封肥城縣公，邑一千戶。又賜姓賀屯。魏恭帝元年，從于謹平江陵，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，賜奴婢一百口，別封一子汧源縣伯。六官建，拜司倉下大夫。孝閔帝踐阼，進爵郡公，增邑通前二千戶。時帝幼冲，晉公護執政，植從兄龍恩為護所親任。

localRange.text: 時帝幼沖，晉公護執政，植從兄龍恩為護所親任。

context.beforeSource: 在州甚有政績，為夷夏所懷。
context.afterSource: 及護誅趙貴，而諸宿將等多不自安。

manualTranslations.zh: 及齊神武逼洛陽，植從魏孝武西遷。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gao Huan pressed on Luoyang, Zhi followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei in the westward migration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gao Huan pressed on Luoyang, Hou Zhi followed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei in the flight west.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，授驃騎將軍、都督，賜姓侯伏侯氏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong, he was appointed Grand General of the Flying Cavalry and area commander, and granted the surname Houfuhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one he was made Grand General of the Flying Cavalry and area commander, and granted the surname Houfuhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 從太祖破沙苑，戰河橋，進大都督，加左光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the Grand Progenitor he broke the enemy at Shaye, fought at Heqiao, was promoted to grand area commander, and given Left Grand Master of the Honorific Seal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai at Shaye and Heqiao, rose to grand area commander, and was given Left Grand Master of the Honorific Seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 涼州刺史宇文仲和據州作逆，植從開府獨孤信討擒之，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司，封肥城縣公，邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Inspector of Liang Province Yuwen Zhonghe held the province in rebellion; Zhi followed grand master Dugu Xin in suppressing and capturing him, was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry with honors equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and enfeoffed Duke of Feicheng County with a fief of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liang inspector Yuwen Zhonghe rebelled and held the province, Hou Zhi followed grand master Dugu Xin in capturing him, was made General of Chariots and Cavalry with honors equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and enfeoffed Duke of Feicheng with one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 又賜姓賀屯。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again granted the surname Hetun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again granted the surname Hetun.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝元年，從于謹平江陵，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，賜奴婢一百口，別封一子汧源縣伯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, he followed Yu Jin in pacifying Jiangling, was promoted to Grand General of the Flying Cavalry and grand master with a grand prefecture equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, was granted one hundred male and female servants, and a son was separately enfeoffed Baron of Qianyuan County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei he followed Yu Jin in pacifying Jiangling, rose to Grand General of the Flying Cavalry and grand master with a grand prefecture matching the Three Ducal Ministers, received one hundred servants, and one son was separately enfeoffed Baron of Qianyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 六官建，拜司倉下大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, he was appointed lower grand master of the Office of Granaries.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established, he was made lower grand master of the Office of Granaries.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進爵郡公，增邑通前二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was advanced to commandery duke, and his fief was increased to two thousand households in all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was raised to commandery duke with two thousand households in all.

context.beforeSource: 後以疾卒。
context.afterSource: 宇文盛字保興，代人也。
context.beforeLocal: 後以疾卒。
context.afterLocal: 宇文盛字保興，代人也。

sourceRange.text: 天和五年，入為大宗伯。六年，與柱國王傑從齊公憲東討。時汾州被圍日久，憲遣盛運粟以給之。仍赴姚襄城，受憲節度。齊將段孝先率兵大至，盛力戰拒之。孝先退，乃築大寧城而還。建德二年，授少師。五年，從高祖東伐，率步騎一萬，守汾水關。宣帝即位，拜上柱國，增邑通前四千六百戶。大象中，薨。子述嗣。大象末，上柱國、濮陽公。盛弟丘。

context.afterSource: 丘字胡奴，起家襄威將軍、奉朝請、都督，賜爵臨邑縣子。

manualTranslations.zh: 天和五年，入為大宗伯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhe, he entered court as grand director of ritual.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year five he entered court as grand director of ritual.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，與柱國王傑從齊公憲東討。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, together with pillar-of-state Wang Jie, he followed Duke of Qi Xian on the eastern punitive campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Duke of Qi Yuwen Xian on the eastern campaign with pillar-of-state Wang Jie.

manualTranslations.zh: 時汾州被圍日久，憲遣盛運粟以給之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Fen Province had long been besieged; Xian sent Sheng to transport grain to supply it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fen Province had been under siege for a long time, and Xian sent Sheng to haul grain to relieve it.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍赴姚襄城，受憲節度。
manualTranslations.literal: He then went to Yaoxiang city and came under Xian's command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then went to Yaoxiang and served under Xian's command.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊將段孝先率兵大至，盛力戰拒之。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi general Duan Xiaoxian led a large force up; Sheng fought hard to repel him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Qi general Duan Xiaoxian advanced in force, Sheng fought hard to hold him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝先退，乃築大寧城而還。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaoxian withdrew, Sheng thereupon built Daning city and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Xiaoxian withdrew, Sheng built Daning city and returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德二年，授少師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jiande, he was appointed Junior Mentor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiande year two he was made Junior Mentor.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，從高祖東伐，率步騎一萬，守汾水關。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, following Emperor Gaozu on the eastern campaign, he led ten thousand foot and horse and guarded Fen River Pass.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Emperor Gaozu on the eastern campaign, led ten thousand infantry and cavalry, and held Fen River Pass.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝即位，拜上柱國，增邑通前四千六百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, he was appointed pillar-of-state, and his fief was increased to four thousand six hundred households in all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, he was made pillar-of-state with four thousand six hundred households in all.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象中，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Daxiang era he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died during the Daxiang era.

manualTranslations.zh: 子述嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Shu succeeded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Shu succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象末，上柱國、濮陽公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Daxiang, pillar-of-state and Duke of Puyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Daxiang era he held the ranks of pillar-of-state and Duke of Puyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 盛弟丘。
manualTranslations.literal: Sheng's younger brother Qiu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Younger Brother Qiu

sourceRange.text: 魏孝武初，遷衞將軍、右光祿大夫，進爵冠軍縣伯，邑百戶。大統元年，進爵為公，增邑六百戶。累遷車騎將軍、通直散騎常侍、驍衞將軍、左光祿大夫。四年，出為鄜城郡守。紹性恕直，兼有威惠，百姓安之。稽胡恃眾與險，屢為抄竊。紹率郡兵從侯莫陳崇討之，疋馬先登，破之於默泉之上。加帥都督、驃騎、常侍、朔州大中正。十三年，錄前後功，增邑通前二千二百戶，除燕州刺史。累遷大都督、車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

context.beforeSource: 普泰初，封平鄉男，邑一百戶，加征西將軍，金紫光祿大夫。
context.afterSource: 復從大將軍達奚武征漢中。

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝武初，遷衞將軍、右光祿大夫，進爵冠軍縣伯，邑百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Xiaowu of Wei's reign, he was transferred to Guard General and Right Grand Master of the Honorific Seal, advanced to Baron of Guanjun County with a fief of one hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei came to the throne, Yang Shao was made Guard General and Right Grand Master of the Honorific Seal, and raised to Baron of Guanjun with one hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，進爵為公，增邑六百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong, he was advanced to duke and his fief increased by six hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one he was raised to duke and given six hundred more households.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷車騎將軍、通直散騎常侍、驍衞將軍、左光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: Through repeated promotion he rose to General of Chariots and Cavalry, Regular Attendant of Unimpeded Access, Valiant Guard General, and Left Grand Master of the Honorific Seal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose through General of Chariots and Cavalry, regular attendant of unimpeded access, Valiant Guard General, and Left Grand Master of the Honorific Seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，出為鄜城郡守。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was sent out as administrator of Fucheng commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was posted as administrator of Fucheng commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 紹性恕直，兼有威惠，百姓安之。
manualTranslations.literal: Shao by nature was forgiving and upright, combining authority and kindness; the common people were settled by him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Forgiving and upright by nature, he combined sternness with kindness, and the people lived at ease under him.

manualTranslations.zh: 稽胡恃眾與險，屢為抄竊。
manualTranslations.literal: The Ji barbarians relied on their numbers and rugged terrain and repeatedly raided and plundered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Ji barbarians, trusting in their numbers and rugged terrain, raided again and again.

manualTranslations.zh: 紹率郡兵從侯莫陳崇討之，疋馬先登，破之於默泉之上。
manualTranslations.literal: Shao led the commandery troops following Houmochen Chong to suppress them, on a single horse charged first up the height, and broke them above Moyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao led the commandery troops with Houmochen Chong against them, charged first up the height on a single horse, and routed them above Moyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 加帥都督、驃騎、常侍、朔州大中正。
manualTranslations.literal: He was given the added titles commander-in-chief, Grand General of the Flying Cavalry, regular attendant, and chief rectifier of Shuo Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He received the added titles commander-in-chief, Grand General of the Flying Cavalry, regular attendant, and chief rectifier of Shuo Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，錄前後功，增邑通前二千二百戶，除燕州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year his earlier and later merits were recorded, his fief was increased to two thousand two hundred households in all, and he was appointed Inspector of Yan Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year his service was reviewed, his fief reached two thousand two hundred households in all, and he was made inspector of Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷大都督、車騎大將軍、儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: Through repeated promotion he rose to grand area commander, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and honors equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose to grand area commander, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and honors equal to the Three Ducal Ministers.
