manualTranslations.zh: 保定初，授梁州總管、十州諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Baoding, he was appointed overall commander of Liang Province and military affairs over ten provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the start of Baoding he was made overall commander of Liang Province with authority over military affairs in ten provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和二年，徙丹州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianhe, he was transferred to Inspector of Dan Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year two he was transferred to inspector of Dan Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，遷江陵〔副〕總管。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to deputy overall commander of Jiangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made deputy overall commander of Jiangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 時陳將吳明徹來寇，總管田弘與梁主蕭巋出保紀南城，唯琳與梁僕射王操固守江陵三城以抗之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Chen general Wu Mingche came to raid; overall commander Tian Hong and Liang sovereign Xiao Kui went out to hold Jicheng South City, while only Lin and Liang's chief minister Wang Cao firmly held the three cities of Jiangling to resist.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chen general Wu Mingche attacked, overall commander Tian Hong and Liang sovereign Xiao Kui withdrew to hold Jicheng South City, while Gao Lin and Liang chief minister Wang Cao alone held the three cities of Jiangling in defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 晝夜拒戰，凡經十旬，明徹退去。
manualTranslations.literal: Day and night they resisted in battle; after ten ten-day periods in all, Mingche withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They fought day and night for a hundred days until Mingche withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 巋表言其狀，帝乃優詔追琳入朝，親加勞問。
manualTranslations.literal: Kui memorialized reporting the situation; the emperor thereupon issued a gracious edict summoning Lin to court and personally added words of consolation and inquiry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Kui reported what had happened, and the emperor issued a gracious edict recalling Lin to court and personally received him with praise and inquiry.

manualTranslations.zh: 進授大將軍，仍副衞公直鎮襄州。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to grand general and again served as deputy to Duke of Wei Zhi in garrisoning Xiang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand general and again served as deputy to Duke of Wei Yuwen Zhi in garrisoning Xiang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，進位柱國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, he was advanced to pillar-of-state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was advanced to pillar-of-state.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德元年，薨，時年七十六。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jiande he died, aged seventy-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Jiande year one, aged seventy-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官，加冀定齊滄州五州諸軍事、冀州刺史，諡曰襄。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously awarded his former offices, given military affairs over the five provinces of Ji, Ding, Qi, and Cang, and Inspector of Ji Province; posthumous title Xiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously confirmed in his former offices, given military authority over Ji, Ding, Qi, and Cang provinces, and made inspector of Ji; his posthumous title was Xiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 子儒，少以父勳賜爵許昌（郡）〔縣〕公，拜左侍上士。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Ru, while young through his father's merit was granted noble rank as Duke of Xuchang county, and appointed Left Attendant Upper Gentleman.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Ru, while still young, was enfeoffed Duke of Xuchang county for his father's merit and made Left Attendant Upper Gentleman.

sourceRange.text: 世宗崩，翼與晉公護同受遺詔，立高祖。保定元年，徙軍司馬。三年，改封常山（縣）〔郡〕公，邑二千九百戶。天和初，遷司會中大夫，增邑通前三千七百戶。三年，皇后阿史那氏至自突厥，高祖行親迎之禮，命翼總司儀制。狄人雖蹲踞無節，然咸憚翼之禮法，莫敢違犯。遭父憂去職，居喪過禮，為時輩所稱。尋有詔，起令視事。高祖又以翼有人倫之鑒，皇太子及諸王等相傅以下，竝委翼選置。其所擢用，皆民譽也，時論僉謂得人。遷大將軍，總中外宿衞兵事。

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗崩，翼與晉公護同受遺詔，立高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizong died, Yi and Duke of Jin Hu together received the testamentary edict and enthroned Emperor Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong died, Yu Yi and Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu together received the testamentary edict and enthroned Emperor Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定元年，徙軍司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding, he was transferred to army commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding he was made army commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，改封常山郡公，邑二千九百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he was re-enfeoffed Duke of Changshan commandery with a fief of two thousand nine hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was re-enfeoffed Duke of Changshan with two thousand nine hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和初，遷司會中大夫，增邑通前三千七百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianhe, he was moved to middle grand master in the Office of Accounting; his fief, counting earlier grants, reached three thousand seven hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tianhe he was made middle grand master in the Office of Accounting, bringing his total fief to three thousand seven hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，皇后阿史那氏至自突厥，高祖行親迎之禮，命翼總司儀制。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, when Empress Ashina arrived from the Turks, Emperor Gaozu performed the ceremony of greeting her in person and ordered Yi to oversee all ritual arrangements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, when Empress Ashina arrived from the Turks, Emperor Gaozu went out to greet her in person and put Yu Yi in charge of all ceremonial arrangements.

manualTranslations.zh: 狄人雖蹲踞無節，然咸憚翼之禮法，莫敢違犯。
manualTranslations.literal: Though the Di tribesmen squatted without decorum, all feared Yi's ritual discipline and none dared violate it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though the northern tribesmen squatted without ceremony, all feared Yu Yi's ritual discipline and none dared break it.

manualTranslations.zh: 遭父憂去職，居喪過禮，為時輩所稱。
manualTranslations.literal: When his father died he left office; in mourning he exceeded the rites and was praised by men of the time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his father's death he left office and observed mourning beyond the prescribed rites, winning praise from his contemporaries.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋有詔，起令視事。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon an edict recalled him and ordered him to resume duties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled by edict and ordered back to office.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖又以翼有人倫之鑒，皇太子及諸王等相傅以下，竝委翼選置。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Gaozu, because Yi had discernment in human relations, entrusted to him the selection and appointment of the crown prince, the princes, their tutors, and all below them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu, trusting Yu Yi's judgment of men, entrusted him to choose and appoint the crown prince, the princes, their tutors, and all below them.

manualTranslations.zh: 其所擢用，皆民譽也，時論僉謂得人。
manualTranslations.literal: Those he promoted were all men of popular repute; opinion of the time unanimously said he had found the right men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those he promoted all enjoyed public esteem, and contemporaries agreed he had chosen well.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷大將軍，總中外宿衞兵事。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to grand general and put in overall charge of palace guard forces at court and in the provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made grand general and given overall command of the palace guard forces at court and in the provinces.

sourceRange.text: 保定元年，進封鄧國公，邑一萬戶，別食資陽縣一千戶，收其租賦。四年，授大宗伯，隨晉公護東征。天和五年，出為宜州刺史。先是，太祖田於渭北，令熾與晉公護分射走兔，熾一日獲十七頭，護獲十一頭。護恥其不及，因以為嫌。至是，熾又以高祖年長，有勸護歸政之議，護惡之，故左遷焉。及護誅，徵太傅。

context.beforeSource: 尋而帝崩，事方得寢。
context.afterSource: 熾既朝之元老，名位素隆，至於軍國大謀，常與參議。
context.beforeLocal: 尋而帝崩，事方得寢。
context.afterLocal: 熾旣朝之元老，名位素隆，至於軍國大謀，常與參議。

manualTranslations.zh: 保定元年，進封鄧國公，邑一萬戶，別食資陽縣一千戶，收其租賦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding, he was advanced to Duke of Deng with a fief of ten thousand households; he was separately granted one thousand households in Ziyang county and collected its rents and levies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding he was raised to Duke of Deng with ten thousand households, with a separate maintenance fief of one thousand households in Ziyang county whose rents he was allowed to collect.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，授大宗伯，隨晉公護東征。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, he was appointed Grand Director of Ritual and followed Duke of Jin Hu on the eastern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made grand director of ritual and followed Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu on the eastern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和五年，出為宜州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhe, he was sent out as Inspector of Yi Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianhe he was sent out as inspector of Yi.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，太祖田於渭北，令熾與晉公護分射走兔，熾一日獲十七頭，護獲十一頭。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Grand Progenitor hunted fields north of the Wei, he had Chi and Duke of Jin Hu compete in shooting running hares; in one day Chi took seventeen head and Hu eleven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai hunted north of the Wei, he had Chi and Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu compete at shooting running hares; in one day Chi took seventeen and Hu eleven.

manualTranslations.zh: 護恥其不及，因以為嫌。
manualTranslations.literal: Hu was shamed that he could not match him and therefore bore a grudge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hu was ashamed of being outdone and took a grudge from it.

manualTranslations.zh: 至是，熾又以高祖年長，有勸護歸政之議，護惡之，故左遷焉。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Chi also, because Emperor Gaozu was older, was party to talk urging Hu to return government; Hu hated this and therefore demoted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By then Chi, mindful that Emperor Gaozu was the elder, had joined talk urging Hu to yield power; Hu resented this and had him demoted.

manualTranslations.zh: 及護誅，徵太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hu was executed, Chi was summoned as Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Hu was killed, Chi was recalled as grand tutor.

sourceRange.text: 開皇初，拜太尉。或有告翼，云往在幽州欲同尉遲迥者，隋文召致（凊）〔清〕室，遣理官按驗。尋以無實見原，仍復本位。三年五月，薨。贈本官、加蒲晉懷絳邵汾六州諸軍事、蒲州刺史，諡曰穆。

context.beforeSource: 隋文帝許之。
context.afterSource: 翼性恭儉，與物無競，常以滿盈自戒，故能以功名終。

manualTranslations.zh: 開皇初，拜太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang, he was appointed Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Kaihuang era he was made grand commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 或有告翼，云往在幽州欲同尉遲迥者，隋文召致清室，遣理官按驗。
manualTranslations.literal: Someone reported Yi, saying that formerly in You Province he had wished to join Yuchi Jiong; Emperor Wen of Sui summoned him to the clear chamber and sent judicial officers to investigate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Someone accused Yu Yi of having once intended to join Yuchi Jiong while in You Province; Emperor Wen of Sui had him brought to the clear chamber and sent judicial officers to investigate.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋以無實見原，仍復本位。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon, because there was no substance to the charge, he was pardoned and restored to his former post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The charge proved baseless, he was pardoned, and he returned to his former post.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年五月，薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the fifth month of the third year.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官、加蒲晉懷絳邵汾六州諸軍事、蒲州刺史，諡曰穆。
manualTranslations.literal: He was granted his former office posthumously and additionally made commander of military affairs in the six provinces Pu, Jin, Huai, Jiang, Shao, and Fen, and Inspector of Pu; his posthumous title was Mu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Posthumously he kept his former rank and was made commander of military affairs for Pu, Jin, Huai, Jiang, Shao, and Fen and inspector of Pu; his posthumous name was Mu.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dou Yi's second daughter became Empress Taimu of Tang.

manualTranslations.zh: 武德元年，詔贈司空、穆總管荊郢硤夔復沔岳沅澧鄂十州諸軍事、荊州刺史，封杞國公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wude, an edict posthumously granted Minister of Works, supreme commander of military affairs in the ten provinces Jing, Ying, Xia, Kui, Fu, Mian, Yue, Yuan, Li, and E, and Inspector of Jing, and enfeoffed him Duke of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wude an edict posthumously made him minister of works and supreme commander of military affairs for Jing, Ying, Xia, Kui, Fu, Mian, Yue, Yuan, Li, and E and inspector of Jing, and enfeoffed him Duke of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 并追贈賢，金遷房直均五州諸軍事、金州刺史，襲杞國公。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian was also posthumously granted commander of military affairs in the five provinces Jin, Qian, Fang, Zhi, and Jun, and Inspector of Jin, and inherited the dukedom of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian was also posthumously made commander of military affairs for Jin, Qian, Fang, Zhi, and Jun and inspector of Jin, and inherited the dukedom of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 又追贈賢子紹宣秦州刺史，并襲賢爵。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian's son Shaoxuan was also posthumously granted Inspector of Qin and inherited Xian's enfeoffment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xian's son Shaoxuan was also posthumously made inspector of Qin and inherited his father's title.

manualTranslations.zh: 紹宣無子，仍以紹宣兄孝宣子德藏為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: Shaoxuan had no son; therefore Xiaoxuan's son Dezang was made heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shaoxuan had no son, so Dezang, son of his elder brother Xiaoxuan, was made heir.

sourceRange.text: 大統元年，以從駕功，別封真定縣公，除東豫州刺史，加衞將軍。從擒竇泰，復弘農，破沙苑，皆有功，增邑八百戶。河橋之戰，諸將退走。熾時獨從兩騎為敵人所追，至邙山，熾乃下馬背山抗之。俄而敵眾漸多，三面攻圍，矢下如雨。熾騎士所執弓，竝為敵人所射破，熾乃總收其箭以射之，所中人馬皆應弦而倒。敵以殺傷既多，乃相謂曰：「得此人未足為功。」乃稍引退。熾因其怠，遂突圍得出。又從太保李弼討白額稽胡，破之，除車騎將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，以從駕功，別封真定縣公，除東豫州刺史，加衞將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong, for merit in following the imperial progress, he was separately enfeoffed Duke of Zhending county, appointed Inspector of Eastern Yu Province, and made General of the Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong, for service on the imperial progress, he was separately enfeoffed Duke of Zhending, made inspector of Eastern Yu, and promoted to general of the guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 從擒竇泰，復弘農，破沙苑，皆有功，增邑八百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Following in the capture of Dou Tai, recovery of Hongnong, and defeat at Shaya — all counted as merit; fief increased by eight hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He shared in the capture of Dou Tai, the recovery of Hongnong, and the victory at Shaya, and his fief was increased by eight hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 河橋之戰，諸將退走。
manualTranslations.literal: At the battle of Heqiao, the generals retreated and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the battle of Heqiao the generals broke and fled.

manualTranslations.zh: 熾時獨從兩騎為敵人所追，至邙山，熾乃下馬背山抗之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chi at the time followed with only two horsemen and was pursued by the enemy; reaching Mount Mang, Chi dismounted and, with the mountain at his back, resisted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chi was pursued with only two riders as far as Mount Mang, where he dismounted and, with the slope at his back, made a stand.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄而敵眾漸多，三面攻圍，矢下如雨。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon the enemy grew numerous, attacked from three sides, and arrows fell like rain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The enemy soon swelled in number, closed in on three sides, and arrows fell like rain.

manualTranslations.zh: 熾騎士所執弓，竝為敵人所射破，熾乃總收其箭以射之，所中人馬皆應弦而倒。
manualTranslations.literal: The bows Chi and his horsemen held were all shot through by the enemy; Chi then gathered their arrows together and shot them back, and every man and horse struck fell at the twang of the string.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The enemy shot through every bow Chi and his men carried; Chi gathered the spent arrows and shot them back, and every man or horse hit fell at the twang of the string.

manualTranslations.zh: 敵以殺傷既多，乃相謂曰：「得此人未足為功。
manualTranslations.literal: Seeing so many killed and wounded, the enemy said to one another: "Taking this man is not enough to count as merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With so many dead and wounded, the enemy said to one another, "Taking this man is not enough to count as merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 」乃稍引退。
manualTranslations.literal: " They then gradually withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " They then gradually withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 熾因其怠，遂突圍得出。
manualTranslations.literal: Chi, taking advantage of their slackness, broke through the encirclement and escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chi seized their slackness and broke through the encirclement to escape.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從太保李弼討白額稽胡，破之，除車騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He again followed Grand Protector Li Bi in attacking the White Forehead Ji Hu, defeated them, and was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again followed Grand Protector Li Bi against the White Forehead Ji Hu, defeated them, and was made general of chariots and cavalry.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wen of Sui took the throne, Chi was made grand tutor, granted special honors, and allowed the praise-and-bow without his name being spoken.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈本官、冀滄瀛趙衞貝魏洛八州諸軍事、冀州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously granted his former office and made commander of military affairs in the eight provinces Ji, Cang, Ying, Zhao, Wei, Bei, Wei, and Luo, and Inspector of Ji.

sourceRange.text: 後以熊州刺史從武帝拔晉州，進位大將軍，除晉州刺史。及帝還，齊後主親攻圍之，樓堞皆盡，短兵相接。士彥慷慨自若，謂將士曰：「死在今日，吾為爾先。」於是勇猛齊奮，號聲動天，無不一當百。齊兵少卻，乃令妻及軍人子女晝夜修城，三日而就。武帝大軍亦至，齊師圍解。士彥見帝，捋帝鬚泣，帝亦為之流涕。時帝欲班師，士彥叩馬諫，帝從之。執其手曰：「朕有晉州，為平齊之基，宜善守之。」及齊平，封郕國公，位上柱國、雍州總管。宣帝即位，除徐州總管。與烏丸軌禽陳將吳明徹、裴忌於呂梁，略定淮南地。

context.beforeSource: 齊人甚憚之。
context.afterSource: 隋文帝作相，轉亳州總管。
context.beforeLocal: 齊人甚憚之。
context.afterLocal: 隋文帝作相，轉亳州總管。

manualTranslations.zh: 後以熊州刺史從武帝拔晉州，進位大將軍，除晉州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, as governor of Xiongzhou, he followed Emperor Wu in capturing Jin Province, was advanced to grand general, and appointed Inspector of Jin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, as governor of Xiongzhou, he followed Emperor Wu in the capture of Jin Province, was raised to grand general, and made inspector of Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 及帝還，齊後主親攻圍之，樓堞皆盡，短兵相接。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor returned, the lord of Qi personally came to attack and besiege it; parapets were all destroyed and close combat ensued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor marched away, the lord of Qi came in person to besiege the city; the walls were battered down and fighting closed to hand strokes.

manualTranslations.zh: 士彥慷慨自若，謂將士曰：「死在今日，吾為爾先。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shiyan was ardent and self-possessed; he told his officers and soldiers: "If we die, we die today — I will go before you."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shiyan was resolute and unshaken; he told his officers and men, "If we die, we die today — I will go before you."

manualTranslations.zh: 於是勇猛齊奮，號聲動天，無不一當百。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon with equal valor they charged; their shouts shook heaven, and none failed to match a hundred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They charged with one fury; their shouts shook the sky, and each man fought as if worth a hundred.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊兵少卻，乃令妻及軍人子女晝夜修城，三日而就。
manualTranslations.literal: The Qi troops fell back a little; he then ordered his wife and the wives and children of the soldiers to repair the walls day and night, and in three days it was done.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi troops fell back slightly; he then set his wife and the soldiers' wives and children to repair the walls day and night, and in three days the work was done.

manualTranslations.zh: 武帝大軍亦至，齊師圍解。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wu's great army also arrived, and the Qi siege was lifted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu's main army also arrived, and the Qi siege was broken.

manualTranslations.zh: 士彥見帝，捋帝鬚泣，帝亦為之流涕。
manualTranslations.literal: Shiyan saw the emperor, seized his beard, and wept; the emperor also shed tears for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shiyan met the emperor he seized his beard and wept, and the emperor wept as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 時帝欲班師，士彥叩馬諫，帝從之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the emperor wished to withdraw the army; Shiyan seized his horse's bridle and remonstrated, and the emperor followed his advice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor then wished to withdraw the army; Shiyan seized his horse's bridle and remonstrated, and the emperor took his counsel.

manualTranslations.zh: 執其手曰：「朕有晉州，為平齊之基，宜善守之。」
manualTranslations.literal: He took his hand and said: "I hold Jin Province as the foundation for pacifying Qi — you should guard it well."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He took his hand and said, "I hold Jin Province as the foundation for pacifying Qi — guard it well."

manualTranslations.zh: 及齊平，封郕國公，位上柱國、雍州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: When Qi was pacified, he was enfeoffed Duke of Cheng, and held the posts of upper pillar-of-state and area commander of Yong Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Qi was pacified he was enfeoffed Duke of Cheng and made upper pillar-of-state and area commander of Yong.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣帝即位，除徐州總管。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xuan came to the throne, he was made area commander of Xu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan came to the throne, he was made area commander of Xu.

manualTranslations.zh: 與烏丸軌禽陳將吳明徹、裴忌於呂梁，略定淮南地。
manualTranslations.literal: With Wuhuan Gui he captured Chen generals Wu Mingche and Pei Ji at Lüliang and broadly pacified the Huainan region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Wang Gui he captured the Chen generals Wu Mingche and Pei Ji at Lüliang and largely pacified Huainan.

sourceRange.text: 明帝即位，禮敬逾厚。乃為詩以貽之曰：「六爻貞遯世，三辰光少微。潁陽讓逾遠，滄州去不歸。香動秋蘭佩，風飄蓮葉衣。坐石窺仙洞，乘槎下釣磯。嶺松千仞直，巖泉百丈飛。聊登平樂觀，遠望首陽薇。詎能同四隱，來參余萬機。」敻答帝詩，願時朝謁。帝大悅，敕有司日給河東酒一斗，號之曰逍遙公。時晉公護執政，廣營第宅。嘗召敻至宅，訪以政事。敻仰視其堂，徐而歎曰：「酣酒嗜音，峻宇雕牆，有一於此，未或弗亡。」護不悅。有識者以為知言。

context.beforeSource: 至有慕其閑素者，或載酒從之，敻亦為之盡歡，接對忘倦。
context.afterSource: 陳遣其尚書周弘正來聘，素聞敻名，請與相見。

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝即位，禮敬逾厚。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming came to the throne, courtesy and respect toward him grew ever greater.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming came to the throne, his courtesy toward Wei Xiong grew still deeper.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃為詩以貽之曰：「六爻貞遯世，三辰光少微。
manualTranslations.literal: He thereupon composed a poem and sent it to him, saying: "In the six lines he steadfastly withdraws from the world; the three luminaries shine upon Lesser Apex.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then composed a poem and sent it to him, saying, "In the six lines he steadfastly withdraws from the world; the three luminaries shine upon Lesser Apex.

manualTranslations.zh: 潁陽讓逾遠，滄州去不歸。
manualTranslations.literal: Yielding Yingyang grows ever more remote; from Cangzhou he will not return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yielding Yingyang grows ever more remote; from Cangzhou he will not return.

manualTranslations.zh: 香動秋蘭佩，風飄蓮葉衣。
manualTranslations.literal: Fragrance stirs the autumn orchid pendant; wind drifts the lotus-leaf robe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fragrance stirs the autumn orchid on his girdle; wind drifts his lotus-leaf robe.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐石窺仙洞，乘槎下釣磯。
manualTranslations.literal: Sitting on rock he peers into immortal caves; riding a raft he descends to the fishing rocks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sits on stone and peers into immortal caves; he rides a raft down to the fishing rocks.

manualTranslations.zh: 嶺松千仞直，巖泉百丈飛。
manualTranslations.literal: Ridge pines stand a thousand ren straight; cliff springs fly a hundred zhang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ridge pines rise a thousand ren straight; cliff springs plunge a hundred zhang.

manualTranslations.zh: 聊登平樂觀，遠望首陽薇。
manualTranslations.literal: For a time he ascends Pingle Terrace, gazing afar at the ferns of Shouyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For a time he climbs Pingle Terrace and gazes afar at the ferns of Shouyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 詎能同四隱，來參余萬機。」
manualTranslations.literal: How could he be like the four recluses, coming to share my myriad affairs?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How could he be like the four recluses, coming to share my myriad affairs?"

manualTranslations.zh: 敻答帝詩，願時朝謁。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong replied to the emperor's poem, expressing a wish to attend court from time to time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei Xiong replied to the emperor's poem and said he wished to attend court from time to time.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝大悅，敕有司日給河東酒一斗，號之曰逍遙公。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased and ordered the relevant offices to supply one dou of Hedong wine daily, styling him Duke Free Roamer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted and ordered the relevant offices to give him one dou of Hedong wine each day, styling him Duke Free Roamer.

manualTranslations.zh: 時晉公護執政，廣營第宅。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power and widely built mansions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power and built mansions on a grand scale.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘗召敻至宅，訪以政事。
manualTranslations.literal: He once summoned Xiong to his residence and consulted him on government affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He once summoned Wei Xiong to his residence and asked his views on government.

manualTranslations.zh: 敻仰視其堂，徐而歎曰：「酣酒嗜音，峻宇雕牆，有一於此，未或弗亡。」
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong looked up at his hall, slowly sighed, and said: "Indulgence in wine and love of music, lofty halls and carved walls — if there is one of these, ruin has rarely been absent."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei Xiong looked up at his hall, sighed slowly, and said, "Indulgence in wine and love of music, lofty halls and carved walls — if there is one of these, ruin has rarely been absent."

manualTranslations.zh: 護不悅。
manualTranslations.literal: Hu was displeased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Hu was displeased.

manualTranslations.zh: 有識者以為知言。
manualTranslations.literal: Men of discernment held that this was words of insight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Men of judgment took this for words of real insight.

sourceRange.text: 大象元年，除徐兗等十一州十五鎮諸軍事、徐州總管。又為行軍元帥，狥地淮南。乃分遣杞公宇文亮攻黃城，郕公梁士彥攻廣陵，孝寬率眾攻壽陽，竝拔之。初孝寬到淮南，所在皆密送誠款。然彼五門，尤為險要，陳人若開塘放水，即津濟路絕。孝寬遽令分兵據守之。陳刺史吳文育果遣決堰，已無及。於是陳人退走，江北悉平。

context.beforeSource: 拜大司空，出為延州總管，進位上柱國。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Daxiang he was appointed to overall military affairs of eleven provinces and fifteen garrisons including Xu and Yan, and made area commander of Xu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daxiang he was made commander of military affairs for Xu, Yan, and nine other provinces with fifteen garrisons, and area commander of Xu.

manualTranslations.zh: 又為行軍元帥，狥地淮南。
manualTranslations.literal: He was also made campaigning marshal and marched through Huainan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was also made campaigning marshal and cleared the Huainan region.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃分遣杞公宇文亮攻黃城，郕公梁士彥攻廣陵，孝寬率眾攻壽陽，竝拔之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then separately dispatched Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang to attack Huangcheng, Duke of Cheng Liang Shiyan to attack Guangling, and Xiaokuan himself led the host against Shouyang; all were taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then sent Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang against Huangcheng, Duke of Cheng Liang Shiyan against Guangling, and led his own force against Shouyang; all fell.

manualTranslations.zh: 初孝寬到淮南，所在皆密送誠款。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiaokuan first reached Huainan, everywhere people secretly sent pledges of loyalty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xiaokuan first reached Huainan, local communities everywhere sent secret pledges of submission.

manualTranslations.zh: 然彼五門，尤為險要，陳人若開塘放水，即津濟路絕。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet those Five Gates were especially perilous; if the men of Chen opened the embankments and released the water, the crossing routes would be cut off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But the Five Gates there were especially critical: if Chen opened the dikes and released the water, every crossing would be cut off.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝寬遽令分兵據守之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiaokuan promptly ordered troops divided to seize and hold them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiaokuan at once sent detachments to seize and hold them.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳刺史吳文育果遣決堰，已無及。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen's Inspector Wu Wenyü indeed sent men to breach the dikes, but it was already too late.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen inspector Wu Wenyü did send men to breach the dikes, but it was already too late.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是陳人退走，江北悉平。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon the men of Chen withdrew and fled, and all north of the river was pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen forces then withdrew, and the whole north bank of the Yangzi was pacified.

context.beforeSource: 然兩國爭之，勞師數載。
context.afterSource: 若棄崤東，來圖汾北，我之疆界，必見侵擾。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi has no shortage of able men and stratagems.

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, as grand general he joined Duke of Yan Yu Jin in campaigning against Jiangling; they pacified it, and for merit he was enfeoffed Duke of Rang county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei he served as grand general under Duke of Yan Yu Jin in the campaign against Jiangling; after its pacification he was enfeoffed Duke of Rang for his merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，拜尚書右僕射，賜姓宇文氏。
manualTranslations.literal: On return he was appointed Right Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing and granted the surname Yuwen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On his return he was made right vice minister of the masters of writing and granted the surname Yuwen.

manualTranslations.literal: (second)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (second)

manualTranslations.zh: 〔三〕年，周文北巡，命孝寬還鎮玉壁。
manualTranslations.literal: [emended: third] year, Yuwen Wen made a northern inspection tour and ordered Xiaokuan back to garrison Yubi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the [emended: third] year Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai toured the north and ordered Xiaokuan back to hold Yubi.

manualTranslations.zh: 周孝閔帝踐阼，拜小司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was appointed Lesser Minister of Reckoning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was made lesser minister of reckoning.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝初，參麟趾殿學士，考校圖籍。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of Emperor Ming's reign he served among the Linzhi Hall scholars collating books and records.

sourceRange.text: 通少敦敏好學，有志節。幼從在河西，遂逢寇難，與政相失。通乃自拔東歸，從爾朱榮。榮死，又從爾朱兆。及爾朱氏滅，乃入關。文帝時在夏州，引為帳內督。頃之，賀拔岳為侯莫陳悅所害，時有傳（兵）〔岳〕軍府已亡散者，文帝憂之，通以為不然。居數日，問至，果如所策。自是愈見親禮，遂晝夜陪侍，家人罕見其面。通雖處機密，愈自恭謹，文帝以此重之。後以迎孝武功，封都昌縣伯。大統元年，進爵為侯。從禽竇泰，復弘農。沙苑之役，力戰有功。

context.beforeSource: 大統中，卒。
context.afterSource: 又從解洛陽圍。
context.beforeLocal: 大統中，卒。
context.afterLocal: 又從解洛陽圍。

manualTranslations.zh: 通少敦敏好學，有志節。
manualTranslations.literal: Tong from youth was sincere, quick, and fond of learning, with will and integrity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Tong was earnest, quick-witted, and devoted to learning, and he possessed strong moral resolve.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼從在河西，遂逢寇難，與政相失。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he followed [his father] in Hexi; he then encountered bandit troubles and was separated from Zheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a boy he followed his father west of the Yellow River; when bandits struck, he was separated from Zheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 通乃自拔東歸，從爾朱榮。
manualTranslations.literal: Tong then extricated himself and returned east, following Erzhu Rong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tong made his own escape back east and entered Erzhu Rong's service.

manualTranslations.zh: 榮死，又從爾朱兆。
manualTranslations.literal: When Rong died, he followed Erzhu Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Rong died he followed Erzhu Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 及爾朱氏滅，乃入關。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Erzhu clan was destroyed, he then entered the Pass.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Erzhu clan fell, he entered Guanzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝時在夏州，引為帳內督。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wen was at Xia Province, he brought him in as supervisor within the headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While Yuwen Tai was stationed at Xia Province, he took Tong on as a supervisor in his personal staff.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，賀拔岳為侯莫陳悅所害，時有傳岳軍府已亡散者，文帝憂之，通以為不然。
manualTranslations.literal: Shortly thereafter Heba Yue was killed by Houmochen Yue; at the time there were reports that Yue's army headquarters had already been scattered and lost, and Emperor Wen worried; Tong thought it was not so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Heba Yue was killed by Houmochen Yue; word spread that Yue's headquarters had already fallen apart, and Yuwen Tai grew anxious, but Tong did not believe it.

manualTranslations.zh: 居數日，問至，果如所策。
manualTranslations.literal: After several days inquiries arrived, and it was exactly as he had judged.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within days messengers came in, and events proved exactly as he had predicted.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是愈見親禮，遂晝夜陪侍，家人罕見其面。
manualTranslations.literal: From then on he was ever more favored with intimate courtesy; he then attended day and night, and his family seldom saw his face.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From then on he was treated with ever greater intimacy and favor; he attended Yuwen Tai day and night, and his family seldom saw him.

manualTranslations.zh: 通雖處機密，愈自恭謹，文帝以此重之。
manualTranslations.literal: Though Tong was privy to secrets, he became ever more deferential and careful, and Emperor Wen therefore valued him highly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though he held confidential matters, he grew only more respectful and cautious, and Yuwen Tai esteemed him all the more for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以迎孝武功，封都昌縣伯。
manualTranslations.literal: Later for merit in welcoming Emperor Xiaowu he was enfeoffed Baron of Duchang county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, for service in welcoming Emperor Xiaowu, he was enfeoffed baron of Duchang county.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，進爵為侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong, his enfeoffment was advanced to marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong he was raised to marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 從禽竇泰，復弘農。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed [them] in capturing Dou Tai and recovering Hongnong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He took part in capturing Dou Tai and recovering Hongnong.

manualTranslations.zh: 沙苑之役，力戰有功。
manualTranslations.literal: At the battle of Shachuan he fought fiercely and had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the battle of Shachuan he fought with great force and distinguished himself.

sourceRange.text: 太祖初定關、隴，悅率募鄉里從軍，屢有戰功。大統元年，除平東將軍、相府刑獄參軍，封藍田縣伯，邑六百戶。四年，東魏將侯景攻圍洛陽，太祖赴援。悅又率鄉里千餘人，從軍至洛陽。將戰之夕，悅磬其行資，市牛饗戰士。乃戰，悅所部盡力，斬獲居多。六年，加通直散騎常侍，遷大行臺右丞。十年，轉左丞。久居管轄，頗獲時譽。十二年，齊神武親率諸軍圍玉壁，大都督韋孝寬拒守累旬，敵方引退。朝廷以寬勳重，遣尚書長孫紹遠為大使，悅為副使，勞問寬等，并校定勳人。

context.beforeSource: 魏永安中，爾朱天光西討，引悅為其府騎兵參軍，除石安令。
context.afterSource: 十三年，侯景據河南來附，仍請兵為援。

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖初定關、隴，悅率募鄉里從軍，屢有戰功。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor first secured Guan and Long, Yue led men he had recruited from his home district into the army and repeatedly had military achievement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai first secured Guan and Long, Wang Yue mustered neighbors and joined the army, winning distinction again and again in battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年，除平東將軍、相府刑獄參軍，封藍田縣伯，邑六百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Datong he was made General Who Pacifies the East and Criminal Punishments Aide in the chancellor's headquarters, enfeoffed as Baron of Lantian county with a fief of six hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year one he became General Who Pacifies the East and Criminal Punishments Aide in the chancellor's headquarters, and was created Baron of Lantian with six hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，東魏將侯景攻圍洛陽，太祖赴援。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year the Eastern Wei general Hou Jing besieged Luoyang; the Grand Progenitor went to relieve it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year four, when Hou Jing of Eastern Wei besieged Luoyang, Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai marched to relieve the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 悅又率鄉里千餘人，從軍至洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Yue again led more than a thousand men of his home district in the army to Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yue again brought more than a thousand local men to the front at Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 將戰之夕，悅磬其行資，市牛饗戰士。
manualTranslations.literal: On the eve of battle Yue spent all his traveling funds to buy oxen and feast the warriors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the eve of battle he spent his entire travel purse buying oxen to feast his troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃戰，悅所部盡力，斬獲居多。
manualTranslations.literal: Then they fought; the troops under Yue exerted their utmost, and beheadings and captures were mostly his.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fighting the men under his command fought with everything they had, and most of the kills and captures fell to his unit.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，加通直散騎常侍，遷大行臺右丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he was added Regular Attendant through direct connection and transferred to right assistant director of the great mobile headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year six he was made Regular Attendant through direct connection and promoted to right assistant director of the great mobile headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，轉左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to left assistant director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year ten he was transferred to left assistant director.

manualTranslations.zh: 久居管轄，頗獲時譽。
manualTranslations.literal: Long holding supervisory office, he gained considerable contemporary reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Long in high administrative posts, he earned a solid reputation at court.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，齊神武親率諸軍圍玉壁，大都督韋孝寬拒守累旬，敵方引退。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year Gao Huan personally led all armies to besiege Yubi; great commander Wei Xiaokuan held out for many tens of days, and the enemy withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year twelve Gao Huan personally led all his forces to besiege Yubi; great commander Wei Xiaokuan held out for many days until the enemy withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 朝廷以寬勳重，遣尚書長孫紹遠為大使，悅為副使，勞問寬等，并校定勳人。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the court regarded Xiaokuan's merit as weighty, it sent Palace Secretary Changsun Shaoyuan as chief envoy and Yue as deputy envoy to console Xiaokuan and the others and also review and verify the roster of men of merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court, honoring Xiaokuan's service, sent palace secretary Changsun Shaoyuan as chief envoy and Wang Yue as deputy to console Xiaokuan and his men and to review the roster of meritorious officers.

sourceRange.text: 慶少開悟，有才略。初從文帝征伐，復弘農，破沙苑，竝有戰功，每獲殊賞。大統十年，授殿中將軍。孝閔帝踐阼，晉公護引為典籤。慶樞機明辨，漸見親待。授大都督。武成元年，以前後功，賜爵始安縣男。二年，行小賓部。保定二年，使吐谷渾，與共分疆，仍論和好之事，渾主悅服，遣所親隨慶貢獻。

manualTranslations.zh: 慶少開悟，有才略。
manualTranslations.literal: Qing from youth was quick to understand and had talent and strategy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Qing was quick-witted and resourceful.

manualTranslations.zh: 初從文帝征伐，復弘農，破沙苑，竝有戰功，每獲殊賞。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he followed the Grand Progenitor on campaigns, recovered Hongnong, broke Shaya, and had military merit in each; he repeatedly received exceptional rewards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai on campaign, helped recover Hongnong and break Shaya, and won repeated special rewards for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統十年，授殿中將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year of Datong he was appointed palace guard general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Datong he was made palace guard general.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，晉公護引為典籤。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu brought him in as chief clerk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin came to the throne, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu made him a chief clerk.

manualTranslations.zh: 慶樞機明辨，漸見親待。
manualTranslations.literal: Qing was clear and sharp in counsel on vital affairs and gradually came to be treated with favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qing proved sharp in counsel on vital affairs and gradually won favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 授大都督。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed great commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made great commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年，以前後功，賜爵始安縣男。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng, for his cumulative merit he was granted the title Baron of Shian county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wucheng his accumulated service earned him the barony of Shian.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，行小賓部。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he acted as head of the Junior Guest Department.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he served as acting head of the junior guest department.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定二年，使吐谷渾，與共分疆，仍論和好之事，渾主悅服，遣所親隨慶貢獻。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Baoding he was sent on mission to the Tuyuhun; with them he demarcated borders and also discussed matters of peace and alliance; the Tuyuhun ruler was pleased and submitted, and sent his close kin to follow Qing with tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoding he was sent to the Tuyuhun, demarcated borders with them, and discussed peace and alliance; the Tuyuhun ruler was won over and sent close kin back with Qing bearing tribute.

sourceRange.text: 十六年，遷河南郡守，仍鎮孔城。尋加撫軍、大都督、通直散騎常侍。魏廢帝元年，進使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。孝閔帝踐阼，進爵為子。寬在孔城十三年，與齊洛州刺史獨孤永業相對。永業有計謀，多譎詐，或聲言春發，秋乃出兵，掩蔽消息，倐忽而至。寬每揣知其情，用兵邀擊，無不克之。永業常戒其所部曰：「但好鎮孔城，自外無足慮。」其見憚如此。齊伊川郡守梁鮓，常在境首抄掠。太祖患之，命寬經略焉。鮓行過妻家，椎牛宴飲，既醉之後，不復自防。寬密知之，遣兵往襲，遂斬之。太祖嘉焉，賜奴婢、金帶、粟帛等。武成二年，徵拜司（士）〔土〕中大夫。保定元年，出為（汾）〔沔〕州刺史。

localRange.text: 保定元年，出為（汾）沔州刺史。

context.afterSource: 尋轉魯山防主。

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，遷河南郡守，仍鎮孔城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was transferred to governor of Henan commandery and still commanded Kongcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made governor of Henan commandery while continuing to command Kongcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋加撫軍、大都督、通直散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was given the added ranks of pacifying-army commander, area commander-in-chief, and regular attendant-in-ordinary at leisure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he received the added titles of pacifying-army commander, area commander-in-chief, and regular attendant-in-ordinary at leisure.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏廢帝元年，進使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, he was advanced to bearer of the staff, grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in three departments, and attendant-in-ordinary at leisure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei he was promoted to bearer of the staff, grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in three departments, and attendant-in-ordinary at leisure.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進爵為子。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was advanced in rank to viscount.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, Kuan was raised to viscount.

manualTranslations.zh: 寬在孔城十三年，與齊洛州刺史獨孤永業相對。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuan was at Kongcheng for thirteen years, facing Dugu Yongye, Qi's governor of Luo Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuan held Kongcheng for thirteen years, facing Dugu Yongye, Northern Qi's governor of Luo Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 永業有計謀，多譎詐，或聲言春發，秋乃出兵，掩蔽消息，倐忽而至。
manualTranslations.literal: Yongye had stratagems and was much given to deceit; sometimes he announced a spring campaign but did not move troops until autumn, concealed his movements, and arrived suddenly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongye was cunning and much given to deception; he might announce a spring campaign but not move until autumn, conceal his movements, and arrive without warning.

manualTranslations.zh: 寬每揣知其情，用兵邀擊，無不克之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuan each time divined his intentions and used troops to intercept and strike; there was none he did not overcome.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuan repeatedly anticipated his moves and ambushed him in battle, always with success.

manualTranslations.zh: 永業常戒其所部曰：「但好鎮孔城，自外無足慮。」
manualTranslations.literal: Yongye often warned his subordinates, saying: "Just hold Kongcheng well; beyond that there is nothing to worry about."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongye often warned his troops, "Just hold Kongcheng well; beyond that there is nothing to worry about."

manualTranslations.zh: 其見憚如此。
manualTranslations.literal: Such was the fear in which he was held.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Such was the fear he inspired.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊伊川郡守梁鮓，常在境首抄掠。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang Zha, Qi governor of Yichuan commandery, often raided at the border.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang Zha, Northern Qi governor of Yichuan commandery, often raided along the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖患之，命寬經略焉。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Ancestor was troubled by this and ordered Kuan to deal with it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai was troubled by this and ordered Kuan to handle the matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 鮓行過妻家，椎牛宴飲，既醉之後，不復自防。
manualTranslations.literal: Zha was passing his wife's family home, slaughtered an ox for a feast and drank; after he was drunk, he no longer guarded himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zha was passing his wife's family home, slaughtered an ox for a feast, and after getting drunk no longer kept watch.

manualTranslations.zh: 寬密知之，遣兵往襲，遂斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kuan secretly learned of it, sent troops to raid him, and thereupon beheaded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kuan learned of it in secret, sent troops to raid him, and beheaded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嘉焉，賜奴婢、金帶、粟帛等。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Ancestor praised this and bestowed slaves and maidservants, a gold belt, grain, and silks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai praised him and rewarded him with slaves, a gold belt, grain, and silks.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成二年，徵拜司（士）〔土〕中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng, he was summoned and appointed middle grand master of the Directorate of Land.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wucheng he was summoned and appointed middle grand master of the Directorate of Land.

manualTranslations.zh: 武成二年，徵拜司
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng, he was summoned and appointed

sourceRange.text: 漢少有宿疾，恆帶虛羸，劇職煩官，非其好也。時晉公護擅權，搢紳等多諂附之，以圖仕進。唯漢直道固守，八年不徙職。性不飲酒，而雅好賓遊。每良辰美景，必招引時彥，宴賞留連，間以篇什。當時人物，以此重之。自寬沒後，遂斷絕遊從，不聽琴瑟，歲時伏臘，哀慟而已。撫養兄弟子，情甚篤至。借人異書，必躬自錄本。至于疹疾彌年，亦未嘗釋卷。建德元年卒，時年五十九。贈晉州刺史。

manualTranslations.zh: 漢少有宿疾，恆帶虛羸，劇職煩官，非其好也。
manualTranslations.literal: Han from youth had a chronic illness and was always frail and weak; strenuous offices and troublesome posts were not to his liking.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han had suffered from chronic illness since youth and was always frail; strenuous offices and burdensome posts did not suit him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時晉公護擅權，搢紳等多諂附之，以圖仕進。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu monopolized power, and many gentry flattered and attached themselves to him to seek advancement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power unchecked, and many officials flattered him to advance their careers.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯漢直道固守，八年不徙職。
manualTranslations.literal: Only Han held to the straight path and stood firm, not changing office for eight years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only Han held to the straight path and stood firm, not changing office for eight years.

manualTranslations.zh: 性不飲酒，而雅好賓遊。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature he did not drink wine, yet he elegantly delighted in entertaining guests and travel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He did not drink, but he loved entertaining guests and travel.

manualTranslations.zh: 每良辰美景，必招引時彥，宴賞留連，間以篇什。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the season and scenery were fine, he would surely invite leading men of the age, feast and linger in enjoyment, and intersperse poetry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On fine days he would invite leading men of the age, feast and linger in enjoyment, and share poetry.

manualTranslations.zh: 當時人物，以此重之。
manualTranslations.literal: Men of the time for this reason greatly esteemed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Men of the time greatly esteemed him for this.

manualTranslations.zh: 自寬沒後，遂斷絕遊從，不聽琴瑟，歲時伏臘，哀慟而已。
manualTranslations.literal: After Kuan died, he then cut off social gatherings, would not listen to zithers and lutes, and at the seasonal observances of summer and winter only mourned in grief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Kuan died he cut off social gatherings, would not listen to music, and at the seasonal observances only mourned in grief.

manualTranslations.zh: 撫養兄弟子，情甚篤至。
manualTranslations.literal: He raised his brothers' sons with feelings very deep and devoted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He raised his brothers' sons with deep devotion.

manualTranslations.zh: 借人異書，必躬自錄本。
manualTranslations.literal: When he borrowed unusual books from others, he always personally copied them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he borrowed unusual books from others, he always copied them by hand.

manualTranslations.zh: 至于疹疾彌年，亦未嘗釋卷。
manualTranslations.literal: Even when rash illness lasted for years, he never put down his scrolls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even when illness lasted for years, he never put down his books.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德元年卒，時年五十九。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the first year of Jiande, at the age of fifty-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Jiande at the age of fifty-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈晉州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously granted Governor of Jin Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made governor of Jin Prefecture.

sourceRange.text: 魏恭帝元年，太祖欲開梁漢舊路，乃命猷督儀同劉道通、陸騰等五人，率眾開通車路，鑿山堙谷五百餘里，至于梁州。即以猷為都督梁利等十二州白馬儻城二防諸軍事、梁州刺史。及太祖崩，始利沙興等諸州，阻兵為逆，信合開楚四州亦叛，唯梁州境內，民無貳心。利州刺史崔謙請援，猷遣兵六千赴之。信州糧盡，猷又送米四千斛。二鎮獲全，猷之力也。進爵固安縣公，邑二千戶。猷深為晉公護所重，護乃養猷第三女為己女，封富平公主。

sourceRange.text: 天和元年，授江陵總管。三年，遷荊州總管、荊淅等十四州南陽平陽等八防諸軍事、荊州刺史。州既統攝遐長，俗兼夷夏，又南接陳境，東隣齊寇。謙外禦彊敵，內撫軍民，風化大行，號稱良牧。每年考績，常為天下最，屢有詔襃美焉。謙隨賀拔勝之在荊州也，雖被親遇，而名位未顯。及踐其位，朝野以為榮。四年，卒於州。闔境痛惜之，乃共立祠堂，四時祭饗。子曠嗣。

sourceRange.text: 世宗崩，遺詔立高祖。晉公護謂猷曰：「魯國公稟性寬仁，太祖諸子之中，年又居長。今奉遵遺旨，翊戴為主，君以為何如？」猷對曰：「殷道尊尊，周道親親，今朝廷既遵周禮，無容輒違此義。」護曰：「天下事大，但恐畢公冲幼耳。」猷曰：「昔周公輔成王以朝諸侯，況明公親賢莫二，若行周公之事，方為不負顧託。」事雖不行，當時稱其守正。保定元年，重授總管梁利開等十四州白馬儻（成）〔城〕二防諸軍事、梁州刺史。尋復為司會。

sourceRange.text: 保定四年，晉公護東伐，權景宣以山南兵圍豫州，士良舉城降。授大將軍、小司徒，賜爵廣昌郡公。尋除荊州總管，行荊州刺史。復入為小司徒。俄除鄜州刺史，轉金州總管、七州諸軍事、金州刺史。建德六年，授幷州刺史。士良去鄉既久，忽臨本州，耆舊故人，猶有存者。遠近咸以為榮。加授上大將軍。以老疾乞骸骨，優詔許之。隋開皇元年卒，時年八十二。子德衡，大象末，儀同大將軍。

context.beforeSource: 齊武成初，除太子少傅、少師，復除侍中，轉太常卿，尋加開府儀同三司，出為豫州道行臺，豫州刺史。
context.afterSource: 崔彥穆字彥穆，清河東武城人也，魏司空、安陽侯林之九世孫。

manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Baoding, Duke Jin Hu launched an eastern campaign; Quan Jingxuan with the armies south of the mountains besieged Yu Province, and Shiliang surrendered the city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Baoding, Duke Jin Hu launched an eastern campaign; Quan Jingxuan led the armies south of the mountains to besiege Yu Province, and Shiliang surrendered the city.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made grand general and junior minister of education and enfeoffed as Duke of Guangchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除荊州總管，行荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed headquarters commissioner of Jing Province and acted as inspector of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed headquarters commissioner of Jing Province and acted as inspector of Jing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 復入為小司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: He again entered court as junior minister of education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He returned to court as junior minister of education.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄除鄜州刺史，轉金州總管、七州諸軍事、金州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed inspector of Fu Province, then transferred to headquarters commissioner of Jin Province, overseer of military affairs for seven provinces, and inspector of Jin Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was made inspector of Fu Province, then transferred to headquarters commissioner of Jin Province, commander of military affairs for seven provinces, and inspector of Jin Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 建德六年，授幷州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Jiande he was appointed inspector of Bing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Jiande he was appointed inspector of Bing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 士良去鄉既久，忽臨本州，耆舊故人，猶有存者。
manualTranslations.literal: Shiliang had been away from his home district for a long time; when he suddenly arrived to govern his native province, there were still elders and old acquaintances who survived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shiliang had been away from home for many years; when he suddenly returned to govern his native province, some elders and old friends were still alive.

manualTranslations.zh: 遠近咸以為榮。
manualTranslations.literal: Near and far all regarded it as an honor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People near and far all regarded it as an honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 加授上大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was additionally given the rank of supreme grand general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was additionally made supreme grand general.

manualTranslations.zh: 以老疾乞骸骨，優詔許之。
manualTranslations.literal: Citing age and illness he requested dismissal and return of his bones; a favorable edict granted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Citing age and illness he asked to retire; a gracious edict granted his request.

manualTranslations.zh: 隋開皇元年卒，時年八十二。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the first year of Kaihuang of Sui, at age eighty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Kaihuang of Sui, at age eighty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 子德衡，大象末，儀同大將軍。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Deheng, at the end of Daxiang, held the rank of grand general with equal protocol.

sourceRange.text: 文舉以選與諸公子遊，雅相欽敬，未嘗戲狎。遷威烈將軍、著作郎、中外府參軍事。魏恭帝二年，賜姓賀蘭氏。孝閔帝踐阼，襲爵澄城縣子。齊公憲初開幕府，以文舉為司錄。世宗初，累遷帥都督、寧遠將軍、大都督。及憲出鎮劍南，復以文舉為益州總管府中郎。武成二年，就加使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司。蜀土沃饒，商販百倍。或有勸文舉以利者，文舉答之曰：「利之為貴，莫若安身。身安則道隆，非貨之謂。是以不為，非惡財也。」憲矜其貧窶，每欲資給之。文舉恆自謙遜，辭多受少。保定三年，遷絳州刺史。邃之往正平也，以廉約自守，每行春省俗，單車而已。及文舉臨州，一遵其法。百姓美而化之。總管韋孝寬特相欽重，每與談論，不覺膝前於席。天和初，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。尋為孝寬柱國府司馬。六年，入為司憲中大夫，進爵為公，增邑通前一千戶。俄轉軍司馬。建德二年，又增邑七百戶。文舉少喪父，其兄又在山東，唯與弟璣幼相訓養，友愛甚篤。璣又早亡，文舉撫視遺孤，逾於己子。時人以此稱之。初，文舉叔父季和為曲沃令，卒於聞喜川，而叔母韋氏卒於正平縣。屬東西分隔，韋氏墳壠在齊境。及文舉在本州，每加賞募。齊人感其孝義，潛相要結，以韋氏柩西歸，竟得合葬。六年，除南青州刺史。宣政元年，卒於位。子冑嗣。官至大都督，早卒。父邃，性方嚴，為州里所推挹。解褐散騎常侍、奉車都尉，累遷諫議大夫、司空從事中郎。大統三年，東魏來寇，邃乃糾合鄉人，分據險要以自固。時東魏以正平為東雍州，遣其將司馬恭鎮之。每遣間人，扇動百姓。邃密遣都督韓僧明入城，喻其將士，即有五百餘人，許為內應。期日未至，恭知之，乃棄城夜走。因是東雍遂內屬。及李弼略地東境，邃為之鄉導，多所降下。太祖嘉之，特賞衣物，封澄城縣子，邑三百戶，進安東將軍、銀青光祿大夫，加散騎常侍、太尉府司馬，除正平郡守。尋卒官。贈儀同三司、定州刺史。文舉少忠謹，涉獵經史。大統十年，起家奉朝請，遷丞相府墨曹參軍。時太祖諸子年幼，盛簡賓友。文舉以選與諸公子遊，雅相欽敬，未嘗戲狎。

sourceRange.text: 武成元年，除御正下大夫，兼小載師，出為益州總管府長史。保定初，徵拜計部中大夫，治中外府從事中郎，賜爵武陽縣伯。賓敏於從政，果敢決斷，案牘雖繁，綽有餘裕。轉太府中大夫、齊公憲府長史。天和二年，除鄀州諸軍事、鄀州刺史，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，治襄州總管府司錄。六年，卒於州。時年六十八。子熲，為隋文帝佐命。開皇中，贈賓禮部尚書、武陽公。諡曰簡。

context.beforeSource: 加使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍，賜姓獨孤氏。
context.afterSource: 又有安定尞允，本姓牛氏，亦有器幹，知名於時。

manualTranslations.zh: 武成元年，除御正下大夫，兼小載師，出為益州總管府長史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wucheng he was appointed lower grand master of the Imperial Rectification Bureau, concurrently junior master of records, and sent out as chief administrator of Yi Province overall headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wucheng year 1 he was appointed lower grand master of the Imperial Rectification Bureau and junior master of records, and was sent out as chief administrator of Yi Province overall headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定初，徵拜計部中大夫，治中外府從事中郎，賜爵武陽縣伯。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Baoding he was summoned and appointed middle grand master of the Accounts Bureau, administering staff officer in the inner and outer headquarters, and granted the title Earl of Wuyang county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of Baoding he was summoned as middle grand master of the Accounts Bureau and staff officer in the inner and outer headquarters, and was enfeoffed as earl of Wuyang county.

manualTranslations.zh: 賓敏於從政，果敢決斷，案牘雖繁，綽有餘裕。
manualTranslations.literal: Bin was quick in government affairs, bold and decisive in judgment; though documents were numerous he had ample surplus capacity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gao Bin was quick in government, bold and decisive; though the paperwork was heavy he handled it with ease.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉太府中大夫、齊公憲府長史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to middle grand master of the Grand Treasury and chief administrator of Duke of Qi Yuwen Xian's headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to middle grand master of the Grand Treasury and chief administrator of Duke of Qi Yuwen Xian's headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和二年，除鄀州諸軍事、鄀州刺史，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，治襄州總管府司錄。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tianhe he was appointed to all military affairs of E Province and Inspector of E Province; advanced to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the three excellencies; and administered registrar of Xiang Province overall headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year 2 he was appointed to all military affairs of E Province and inspector of E Province, promoted to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers, and made registrar of Xiang Province overall headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，卒於州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he died in the province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 6 he died in office in the province.

manualTranslations.zh: 時年六十八。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time he was sixty-eight years old.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sixty-eight years old.

manualTranslations.zh: 子熲，為隋文帝佐命。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Jiong aided Emperor Wen of Sui at the founding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Gao Jiong was a founding minister of Emperor Wen of Sui.

manualTranslations.zh: 開皇中，贈賓禮部尚書、武陽公。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kaihuang, Bin was posthumously given Minister of Rites and Duke of Wuyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Kaihuang reign he was posthumously made minister of rites and duke of Wuyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰簡。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous title was Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Jian.

sourceRange.text: 彥少知名，太祖臨雍州，辟為西曹書佐。尋除開府儀同主簿，轉司空記室、太尉府屬，遷虞部郎中。大統十二年，初選當州首望，統領鄉兵，除帥都督、持節、平東將軍。以居郎官著稱，封龍門縣子，邑三百戶，進大都督，遷車騎大將軍、儀同三司、司農卿。是時，岷州羌酋傍乞鐵怱與鄭五醜等寇擾西服。彥從大將軍宇文貴討平之。魏恭帝元年，除兵部尚書。仍以本兵從柱國于謹南伐江陵。進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，增邑五百戶，進爵為伯。六官建，拜民部中大夫。

manualTranslations.zh: 彥少知名，太祖臨雍州，辟為西曹書佐。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan from youth was known; when Grand Progenitor took up Yong Province he summoned him as western bureau secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan was known from youth; when Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai took charge of Yong Province he summoned him as western bureau secretary.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除開府儀同主簿，轉司空記室、太尉府屬，遷虞部郎中。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed opening-office equal-in-protocol chief clerk, transferred to recorder in the Ministry of Works and staff member of the Grand Commandant's headquarters, and promoted to director in the Ministry of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was made opening-office equal-in-protocol chief clerk, then recorder in the Ministry of Works and staff member of the grand commandant's headquarters, and was promoted to director in the Ministry of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統十二年，初選當州首望，統領鄉兵，除帥都督、持節、平東將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year of Datong he was first chosen as the leading family of the province, commanded local militia, and appointed command leader, bearer of the staff, and general who pacifies the east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Datong year 12 he was first chosen as the leading family of the province, took command of local militia, and was appointed command leader, bearer of the staff, and general who pacifies the east.

manualTranslations.zh: 以居郎官著稱，封龍門縣子，邑三百戶，進大都督，遷車騎大將軍、儀同三司、司農卿。
manualTranslations.literal: He was famed for his service as a bureau director; enfeoffed as Viscount of Longmen county with a fief of three hundred households; promoted to grand area commander; transferred to grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in protocol to the three excellencies, and minister of agriculture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He won fame as a bureau director, was enfeoffed as viscount of Longmen county with a fief of three hundred households, rose to grand area commander, and was transferred to grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers, and minister of agriculture.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，岷州羌酋傍乞鐵怱與鄭五醜等寇擾西服。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the Qiang chieftain of Min Province, Bangqi Tiecong, together with Zheng Wuchou and others, raided and disturbed the western commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the Min Province Qiang chieftain Bangqi Tiecong, together with Zheng Wuchou and others, raided the western commanderies.

manualTranslations.zh: 彥從大將軍宇文貴討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan followed Grand General Yuwen Gui in campaigning to pacify them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yan followed Grand General Yuwen Gui in putting them down.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝元年，除兵部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei he was appointed Minister of War.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei he was appointed minister of war.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍以本兵從柱國于謹南伐江陵。
manualTranslations.literal: Still with his existing military office he followed Pillar-of-State Yu Jin in the southern campaign against Jiangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Still holding his military post he followed Pillar-of-State Yu Jin in the southern campaign against Jiangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，增邑五百戶，進爵為伯。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the three excellencies; his fief was increased by five hundred households and his rank advanced to earl.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers, his fief was increased by five hundred households, and his rank was raised to earl.

manualTranslations.zh: 六官建，拜民部中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Six Offices were established he was appointed middle grand master of the Ministry of Population.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established he was appointed middle grand master of the Ministry of Population.

sourceRange.text: 孝閔帝踐祚，除晉公護府司錄。世宗初，拜師氏中大夫。受詔於麟趾殿刊正經籍。尋除隴右總管府長史，加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。保定二年，遷成州刺史。偉政尚清靜，百姓悅附，流民復業者三千餘口。天和元年，入為匠師中大夫，轉司宗中大夫。六年，出為隨州刺史。偉辭以母老，不拜。還為司宗。尋以母憂去職。建德二年，復為司宗，轉司會中大夫，兼民部中大夫，遷小司寇。四年，以偉為使主，報聘于齊。是秋，高祖親戎東討，偉遂為齊人所執。六年，齊平，偉方見釋。高祖以其久被幽縶，加授上開府。大象二年，除襄州刺史，進位大將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝閔帝踐祚，除晉公護府司錄。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was appointed recorder in Duke of Jin Hu's headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, Wei was appointed recorder in Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu's headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗初，拜師氏中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Shizong's reign he was made middle grand master in the Office of Masters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the start of Shizong's reign he was made middle grand master in the Office of Masters.

manualTranslations.zh: 受詔於麟趾殿刊正經籍。
manualTranslations.literal: He received an edict to collate the classics in Linzhi Hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He received an edict to collate the classics in Linzhi Hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除隴右總管府長史，加驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was made chief clerk of the Longyou headquarters, with the added ranks of grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the Three Ducal Ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was made chief clerk of the Longyou headquarters, with the added ranks of grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the three ducal ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 保定二年，遷成州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Baoding he was transferred to inspector of Cheng Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoding he was transferred to inspector of Cheng Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 偉政尚清靜，百姓悅附，流民復業者三千餘口。
manualTranslations.literal: Wei's governance valued quiet and purity; the common people gladly attached themselves to him, and more than three thousand displaced persons returned to their occupations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei's government valued quiet and purity; the people gladly attached themselves to him, and more than three thousand displaced persons returned to their occupations.

manualTranslations.zh: 天和元年，入為匠師中大夫，轉司宗中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianhe he entered the capital as middle grand master in the Office of Craft Masters and was transferred to middle grand master in the Directorate of the Imperial Clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianhe he entered the capital as middle grand master in the Office of Craft Masters and was transferred to middle grand master in the Directorate of the Imperial Clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，出為隨州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he went out as inspector of Sui Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was posted as inspector of Sui Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 偉辭以母老，不拜。
manualTranslations.literal: Wei declined on the grounds that his mother was aged and did not accept the post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei declined on the grounds that his mother was aged and did not accept the appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 還為司宗。
manualTranslations.literal: He returned to serve in the Directorate of the Imperial Clan.

sourceRange.text: 從帝入關。至溱水，太祖素聞其善射而未之見也。俄而水傍有一小鳥，顯和射而中之。太祖笑曰：「我知卿工矣。」其後，引為帳內大都督。俄出為持節、衞將軍、東夏州刺史。以疾去職，深為吏民所懷。尋進位車騎大將軍、儀同三司，加散騎常侍。魏恭帝元年，卒，時年五十七。太祖親臨之，哀動左右。建德二年，追贈使持節、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、延丹綏三州諸軍事、延州刺史。神舉早歲而孤，有夙成之量。族兄安化公深器異之。及長，神情倜儻，志略英贍，眉目疏朗，儀貌魁梧。有識欽之，莫不許以遠大。世宗初，起家中侍上士。世宗留意翰林，而神舉雅好篇什。帝每有遊幸，神舉恆得侍從。保定元年，襲爵長廣縣公，邑二千三百戶。尋授帥都督，遷大都督、使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司，拜右大夫。四年，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，治小宮伯。天和元年，遷右宮伯中大夫，進爵清河郡公，增邑一千戶。高祖將誅晉公護也，神舉得預其謀。建德元年，遷京兆尹。三年，出為熊州刺史。神舉威名素重，齊人甚憚之。五年，攻拔齊陸渾等五城。

sourceRange.text: 宣政元年，轉司武上大夫。高祖親戎北伐，令神舉與原國公（如）〔姬〕願等率兵五道俱入。高祖至雲陽，疾甚，乃班師。幽州人盧昌期、祖英伯等聚眾據范陽反，詔神舉率兵擒之。齊黃門侍郎盧思道亦在反中，賊平見獲，解衣將伏法。神舉素欽其才名，乃釋而禮之，即令草露布。其待士禮賢如此。屬稽胡反叛，入寇西河。神舉又率眾與越王盛討平。時突厥與稽胡連和，遣騎赴救。神舉以奇兵擊之，突厥敗走，稽胡於是款服。即授并潞肆石等四州十二鎮諸軍〔事〕、幷州總管。

sourceRange.text: __NOCC__尉遲運，大司空、吳國公綱之子也。少彊濟，志在立功。魏大統十六年，以父勳封安喜縣侯，邑一千戶。孝閔帝踐阼，授使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司。俄而帝廢，朝議欲尊立世宗，乃令運奉迎於岐州。以預定策勳，進爵周城縣公，增邑五百戶。保定元年，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。三年，從楊忠攻齊之幷州，以功別封第二子端保城縣侯，邑一千戶。四年，出為隴州刺史。地帶汧、渭，民俗難治。運垂情撫納，甚得時譽。天和五年，入為小右武伯。六年，遷左武伯中大夫。尋加軍司馬，武伯如故。運既職兼文武，甚見委任。齊將斛律明月寇汾北，運從齊公憲禦之，攻拔其伏龍城。進爵廣業郡公，增邑八百戶。建德元年，授右侍伯，轉右司衞。時宣帝在東宮，親狎諂佞，數有罪失。高祖於朝臣內選忠諒鯁正者以匡弼之。於是以運為右宮正。（二）〔三〕年，帝幸雲陽宮，又令運以本官兼司武，與長孫覽輔皇太子居守。俄而衞剌王直作亂，率其黨襲肅章門。覽懼，走行在所。運時偶在門中，直兵奄至，不暇命左右，乃手自闔門。直黨與運爭門，斫傷運手指，僅而得閉。直既不得入，乃縱火燒門。運懼火盡，直黨得進，乃取宮中材木及牀等以益火，更以膏油灌之，火勢轉熾。久之，直不得進，乃退。運率留守兵，因其退以擊之，直大敗而走。是日微運，宮中已不守矣。高祖嘉之，授大將軍，賜以直田宅、妓樂、金帛、車馬及什物等，不可勝數。四年，出為同州、蒲津、潼關等六防諸軍事、同州刺史。高祖將伐齊，召運參議。東夏底定，頗有力焉。五年，拜柱國，進爵盧國公，邑五千戶。宣政元年，轉司武上大夫，總宿衞軍事。高祖崩於雲陽宮，祕未發喪，運總侍衞兵還京師。宣帝即位，授上柱國。運之為宮正也，數進諫於帝。帝不能納，反疏忌之。時運又與王軌、宇文孝伯等皆為高祖所親待，軌屢言帝失於高祖。帝謂運預其事，愈更銜之。及軌被誅，運懼及於禍，問計於宇文孝伯。語在孝伯傳。尋而得出為秦州總管，秦渭等六州諸軍事、秦州刺史。然運至州，猶懼不免。大象元年二月，遂以憂薨於州，時年四十一。贈大後丞、秦渭河鄯成洮文等七州諸軍事、秦州刺史。諡曰（忠）〔中〕。子靖嗣。大象末，儀同大將軍。

sourceRange.text: 宇文孝伯字胡三，吏部安化公深之子也。其生與高祖同日，太祖甚愛之，養於第內。及長，又與高祖同學。武成元年，拜宗師上士。時年十六。孝伯性沉正謇諤，好直言。高祖即位，欲引置左右。時政在冢臣，不得專制，乃託言少與孝伯同業受經，思相啟發。由是晉公護弗之猜也，得入為右侍上士，恆侍讀書。天和元年，遷小宗師，領右侍儀同。及遭父憂，詔令於服中襲爵。高祖嘗從容謂之曰：「公之於我，猶漢高之與盧綰也。」乃賜以十三環金帶。自是恆侍左右，出入臥內，朝之機務，皆得預焉。孝伯亦竭心盡力，無所廻避。至於時政得失，及外間細事，皆以奏聞。高祖深委信之，當時莫與為比。及高祖將誅晉公護，密與衞王直圖之。唯孝伯及王軌、宇文神舉等頗得參預。護誅，授開府儀同三司，歷司會中大夫、左右小宮伯、東宮左宮正。

sourceRange.text: 孝閔帝踐阼，進爵為伯，增邑通前九百戶。保定元年，移鎮蠻谷。四年，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，徙鎮閻韓。仍從尉遲迥圍洛陽。天和元年，陝（西）〔州〕總管尉遲綱遣玄率儀同宇文能、趙乾等步騎五百於鹿盧交南，邀擊東魏洛州刺史獨孤永業。永業有眾二萬餘人，玄輕將五騎行前覘之，卒與之遇，便即交戰，殺傷數十人，獲馬并甲矟等，永業遂退。二年，進爵為侯。除白超防主。三年，遷熊州刺史。政存簡惠，百姓悅之。四年，轉和州刺史、伏流防主，進爵為公。五年，齊將斛律明月率眾向宜陽，兵威甚盛，玄率兵禦之，每戰輒剋。後以疾卒於位。

context.beforeSource: 魏恭帝二年，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, Xuan was raised to earl and his fief increased to a total of nine hundred households.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoding he transferred his headquarters to Manggu.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，徙鎮閻韓。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry and Baron with an establishment equal to the Three Dukes, and transferred his garrison to Yanhan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made General of Agile Cavalry with a baron's establishment equal to the Three Dukes and moved his garrison to Yanhan.

manualTranslations.zh: 仍從尉遲迥圍洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: He again followed Yuchi Jiong in besieging Luoyang.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianhe, Shan

manualTranslations.zh: 〔州〕總管尉遲綱遣玄率儀同宇文能、趙乾等步騎五百於鹿盧交南，邀擊東魏洛州刺史獨孤永業。
manualTranslations.literal: [zhou [in the received text]] Commander-in-Chief Yuchi Gang sent Xuan leading Yuwenneng, Baron with an establishment, Zhao Gan, and others with five hundred infantry and cavalry south of Lulu Crossing to intercept and strike Dugu Yongye, Eastern Wei's governor of Luo province.

manualTranslations.zh: 永業有眾二萬餘人，玄輕將五騎行前覘之，卒與之遇，便即交戰，殺傷數十人，獲馬并甲矟等，永業遂退。
manualTranslations.literal: Yongye had more than twenty thousand men; Xuan lightly took five horsemen forward to reconnoiter, suddenly encountered them, and at once joined battle, killing and wounding several tens; they captured horses, armor, spears, and the like, and Yongye then withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongye had more than twenty thousand men. Xuan rode ahead with only five horsemen to scout, ran into them unexpectedly, and fought at once, killing and wounding dozens and seizing horses, armor, and spears before Yongye withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，進爵為侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year his rank was advanced to marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was raised to marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 除白超防主。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed defender of Baichao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made defender of Baichao.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，遷熊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to governor of Xiong province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to governor of Xiong province.

manualTranslations.zh: 政存簡惠，百姓悅之。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance was marked by simplicity and kindness, and the common people were pleased with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His rule was simple and generous, and the people were content.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，轉和州刺史、伏流防主，進爵為公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to governor of He province and defender of Fulu, and his rank was advanced to duke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he became governor of He province and defender of Fulu and was raised to duke.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，齊將斛律明月率眾向宜陽，兵威甚盛，玄率兵禦之，每戰輒剋。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year the Qi general Hulu Mingyue led a host toward Yiyang; his military prestige was very imposing; Xuan led troops to resist him, and in every battle he prevailed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Qi general Hulu Mingyue marched on Yiyang with overwhelming force; Xuan met him in battle and won every engagement.

manualTranslations.zh: 後以疾卒於位。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he died of illness in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later died of illness in office.

sourceRange.text: 魏恭帝元年，又與開府斛斯璉等，共齊將段孝先戰于九曲，大破之。二年，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，加侍中。其年，授宜陽邑大中正，賜姓尉遲氏。太祖以忻著績累載，贈其祖昆及父興孫俱為儀同三司，昆齊州刺史，興孫徐州刺史。東魏洛州刺史獨孤永業號有智謀，往來境上，倚伏難測。忻與韓雄等恆令間諜覘其動靜，齊兵每至，輒擊破之。故永業深憚忻等，不敢為寇。孝閔帝踐阼，徵忻入朝，進爵為伯，尋又進爵許昌（郡）〔縣〕公，增邑一千戶。武成元年，除熊州刺史，增邑通前二千六百戶。又與開府敕勒慶破齊將王鸞嵩。仍從柱國陸通復石泉城。天和元年，卒於位。

manualTranslations.zh: 其年，授宜陽邑大中正，賜姓尉遲氏。

manualTranslations.literal: Because Xin had shown merit over many years, the Grand Ancestor posthumously enfeoffed his grandfather Kun and his father Xingsun both as Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes—Kun as governor of Qi province, Xingsun as governor of Xu province.

manualTranslations.zh: 東魏洛州刺史獨孤永業號有智謀，往來境上，倚伏難測。
manualTranslations.literal: Dugu Yongye, Eastern Wei's governor of Luo province, was famed for intelligence and strategy; he moved back and forth on the border, and his deployments were hard to fathom.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dugu Yongye, Eastern Wei's governor of Luo province, was known for his cunning; he moved along the frontier, and his movements were unpredictable.

manualTranslations.zh: 忻與韓雄等恆令間諜覘其動靜，齊兵每至，輒擊破之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xin with Han Xiong and others constantly sent spies to observe his movements; whenever Qi troops arrived, they would strike and defeat them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xin and Han Xiong constantly sent spies to watch him, and whenever Qi troops appeared they were beaten back.

manualTranslations.zh: 故永業深憚忻等，不敢為寇。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Yongye deeply feared Xin and the others and did not dare raid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongye therefore feared Xin and the others and did not dare raid.

manualTranslations.literal: Guo was by nature brave and resolute; his ambition was set on achieving merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo was brave and resolute by nature and aimed to win distinction.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏廢帝元年，率所部來附。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, he led his command in submission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei (551), he led his troops to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖嘉其遠至，待以優禮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor praised his coming from afar and treated him with exceptional courtesy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor praised his coming from afar and received him with exceptional courtesy.

manualTranslations.zh: 果因面陳取蜀之策，太祖深納之。
manualTranslations.literal: Guo thereupon presented in person his plan for taking Shu; the Grand Progenitor deeply accepted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo then presented his plan for taking Shu in person, and Grand Progenitor fully accepted it.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃授使持節、車騎大將軍、儀同三司、大都督、散騎常侍、沙州刺史、南安縣公，邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: He was then granted bearer of the staff of authority, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, Grand Governor, Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary, Regional Inspector of Sha Province, and Duke of Nan'an County, with a fief of one thousand households.

sourceRange.text: 雄處疆埸，務在保境息民，接待敵人，必推誠仗信。齊洛州刺史獨孤永業深相欽尚，移書稱美之。入為京兆尹，尋拜民部中大夫，進位大將軍，俄轉中外府長史。遷江陵總管、四州五防諸軍事，改封魯陽縣公。宣政元年，卒於鎮。大象初，追封魯陽郡公，邑三千五百戶，贈陳曹莒汴四州刺史。諡曰懷。雄善附會，能自謀身，故得任兼出納，保全爵祿。子長寬嗣。官至儀同大將軍。

manualTranslations.literal: When Xiong held the frontier, his aim was to secure the borders and give the people rest; when receiving enemies he always relied on sincerity and trust.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the frontier Xiong sought to secure the borders and give the people rest; in dealing with enemies he always acted with sincerity and trust.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊洛州刺史獨孤永業深相欽尚，移書稱美之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dugu Yongye, Qi inspector of Luo, deeply admired him and sent a letter of praise.

manualTranslations.zh: 入為京兆尹，尋拜民部中大夫，進位大將軍，俄轉中外府長史。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered service as governor of the capital district; soon he was appointed grand master of the Bureau of the People, advanced to grand general, and shortly transferred to chief clerk of the Palace and Exterior Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered service as metropolitan governor of Jingzhao; soon he was made grand master of the bureau of the people, advanced to grand general, and shortly became chief clerk of the palace and exterior office.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷江陵總管、四州五防諸軍事，改封魯陽縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to headquarters commander at Jiangling and commander-in-chief of military affairs over four provinces and five defenses, and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Luyang County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to headquarters commander at Jiangling and commander of military affairs over four provinces and five defenses, and was re-enfeoffed as duke of Luyang county.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣政元年，卒於鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xuanzheng he died at his post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanzheng (578) he died at his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 大象初，追封魯陽郡公，邑三千五百戶，贈陳曹莒汴四州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Daxiang he was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Luyang commandery with thirty-five hundred households and was given posthumously the offices of regional inspector of Chen, Cao, Ju, and Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Daxiang (579) he was posthumously made duke of Luyang commandery with thirty-five hundred households and was given the post of inspector of Chen, Cao, Ju, and Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰懷。
manualTranslations.literal: His posthumous name was Huai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His posthumous name was Huai.

manualTranslations.zh: 雄善附會，能自謀身，故得任兼出納，保全爵祿。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiong was good at attaching himself to the powerful and could plot for his own safety; therefore he gained offices both within and without the palace and preserved his rank and stipend.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiong was skilled at aligning himself with the powerful and protecting his own position, and so held offices both within and without the palace while keeping his rank and stipend.

manualTranslations.zh: 子長寬嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Changkuan succeeded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Changkuan succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 官至儀同大將軍。

sourceRange.text: 大統六年，擕家西入。太祖深禮之，除丞相府記室參軍，賜爵范陽縣伯。俄拜行臺郎中，專掌書記。十年，改封安息縣伯，邑五百戶。遷行臺右丞，出為華州長史，尋徵拜將作大匠。魏廢帝元年，加車騎大將軍、儀同三司，除京兆郡守，遷侍中。六官建，授小匠師下大夫，進授開府儀同三司、匠師中大夫，進爵為侯，增邑五百戶，轉工部中大夫。大司馬賀蘭祥討吐谷渾，以光為長史，進爵燕郡公。武成二年，詔光監營宗廟，既成，增邑四百戶。出為虞州刺史，尋治陝州總管府長史。重論討渾之功，增邑并前一千九百戶。天和二年卒，時年六十二。高祖少時，嘗受業於光，故贈賻有加恆典。贈少傅。諡曰簡。

context.beforeSource: 及魏孝武西遷，光於山東立義，遙授大都督、晉州刺史、安西將軍、銀青光祿大夫。
context.afterSource: 光性崇佛道，至誠信敬。
