manualTranslations.zh: 太祖深禮之，除丞相府記室參軍，賜爵范陽縣伯。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Ancestor treated him with deep courtesy, appointed him recording secretary on the chancellor's staff, and enfeoffed him as Baron of Fanyang county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor treated him with great courtesy, made him recording secretary on the chancellor's staff, and enfeoffed him as baron of Fanyang county.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄拜行臺郎中，專掌書記。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed secretariat gentleman of the traveling secretariat, exclusively in charge of written records.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was made secretariat gentleman of the traveling secretariat, exclusively in charge of written records.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，改封安息縣伯，邑五百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year, his enfeoffment was changed to Baron of Anxi county, with a fief of five hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his title was changed to baron of Anxi county with a fief of five hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷行臺右丞，出為華州長史，尋徵拜將作大匠。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to right assistant director of the mobile headquarters, sent out as chief clerk of Hua province, and soon summoned and appointed director of palace construction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right assistant director of the mobile headquarters, sent out as chief clerk of Hua province, and soon summoned to serve as director of palace construction.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏廢帝元年，加車騎大將軍、儀同三司，除京兆郡守，遷侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei, given the added ranks of General of Chariots and Cavalry and precedence equal to the Three Excellencies, appointed administrator of Jingzhao commandery, and transferred to attendant-in-ordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei he was given the added ranks of general of chariots and cavalry and precedence equal to the Three Excellencies, appointed administrator of Jingzhao commandery, and made attendant-in-ordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 六官建，授小匠師下大夫，進授開府儀同三司、匠師中大夫，進爵為侯，增邑五百戶，轉工部中大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, he was granted lower grand master of the junior artisan directorate, then advanced to opening-the-feudatory three-division court equipage and middle grand master of the artisan directorate, raised in rank to marquis with five hundred households added to his fief, and transferred to middle grand master of the ministry of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established he was made lower grand master of the junior artisan directorate, then advanced to opening-the-feudatory three-division court equipage and middle grand master of the artisan directorate, raised to marquis with five hundred additional households, and transferred to middle grand master of the ministry of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 大司馬賀蘭祥討吐谷渾，以光為長史，進爵燕郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: When Grand Marshal Helan Xiang campaigned against Tuyuhun, Guang was made chief clerk, and his noble rank was advanced to Duke of Yan commandery.

sourceRange.text: 天和元年，加授車騎大將軍、儀同三司。大將軍、樂平公竇集暴感風疾，精神瞀亂，無所覺知。諸醫先視者，皆云已不可救。僧垣後至，曰：「困則困矣，終當不死。若專以見付，相為治之。」其家忻然，請受方術。僧垣為合湯散，所患即瘳。大將軍、永世公叱伏列椿苦利積時，而不廢朝謁。燕公謹嘗問僧垣曰：「樂平、永世俱有痼疾，若如僕意，永世差輕。」對曰：「夫患有深淺，時有剋殺。樂平雖困，終當保全。永世雖輕，必不免死。」謹曰：「君言必死，當在何時？」對曰：「不出四月。」果如其言。謹歎異之。六年，遷遂伯中大夫。

sourceRange.text: 及大軍剋荊州，僧垣猶侍梁元帝，不離左右。為軍人所止，方泣涕而去。尋而中山公護使人求僧垣。僧垣至其營。復為燕公于謹所召，大相禮接。太祖又遣使馳驛徵僧垣，謹（故）〔固〕留不遣。謂使人曰：「吾年時衰暮，疹疾嬰沉。今得此人，望與之偕老。」太祖以謹勳德隆重，乃止焉。明年，隨謹至長安。武成元年，授小畿伯下大夫。

manualTranslations.zh: 魏恭帝元年，太祖令柱國于謹伐江陵，詧以兵會之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, the Grand Ancestor ordered Pillar of State Yu Jin to attack Jiangling, and Cha joined him with troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Gong of Wei, Grand Ancestor Yuwen Tai ordered Pillar of State Yu Jin to attack Jiangling, and Xiao Cha joined him with troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 及江陵平，太祖立詧為梁主，居江陵東城，資以江陵一州之地。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jiangling was pacified, the Grand Ancestor established Cha as ruler of Liang, had him reside in the eastern city of Jiangling, and granted him the territory of Jiangling province alone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jiangling fell, the Grand Ancestor established Xiao Cha as ruler of Liang, installed him in the eastern quarter of Jiangling, and granted him only the territory of Jiangling province.

manualTranslations.zh: 其襄陽所統，盡歸於我。
manualTranslations.literal: The territory he had governed at Xiangyang all reverted to us.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The territory he had governed at Xiangyang all reverted to Northern Wei control.

manualTranslations.zh: 詧乃稱皇帝於其國，年號大定。
manualTranslations.literal: Cha then declared himself emperor in his state, with the reign title Dading.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Cha then declared himself emperor in his state, adopting the reign title Dading.

manualTranslations.zh: 追尊其父統為昭明皇帝，廟號高宗，統妃蔡氏為昭德皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: He posthumously honored his father Tong as Emperor Zhaoming, with the temple name Gaozong, and Tong's consort Lady Cai as Empress Zhaode.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He posthumously honored his father Xiao Tong as Emperor Zhaoming, with the temple name Gaozong, and Xiao Tong's consort Lady Cai as Empress Zhaode.

manualTranslations.zh: 又尊其所生母龔氏為皇太后，立妻王氏為皇后，子巋為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: He also honored his birth mother Lady Gong as Empress Dowager, established his wife Lady Wang as empress, and made his son Kui crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also honored his birth mother Lady Gong as empress dowager, made his wife Lady Wang empress, and named his son Xiao Kui crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 其慶賞刑威，官方制度，竝同王者。
manualTranslations.literal: His rewards and punishments, offices and regulations were all the same as those of a true king.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His rewards and punishments, offices, and regulations all matched those of a full sovereign.

manualTranslations.zh: 唯上疏則稱臣，奉朝廷正朔。
manualTranslations.literal: Only in memorials to the throne did he call himself a subject and observe the court calendar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only in memorials to the Northern Wei court did he style himself a subject and observe its calendar.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於爵命其下，亦依梁氏之舊。
manualTranslations.literal: As for enfeoffments and appointments below him, he likewise followed the old practices of the House of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For enfeoffments and appointments below him, he likewise followed Liang precedent.

manualTranslations.zh: 其戎章勳級，則又兼用柱國等官。
manualTranslations.literal: In military insignia and orders of merit he also combined the use of offices such as Pillar of State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For military insignia and orders of merit he also employed Northern Wei offices such as Pillar of State.

manualTranslations.zh: 又追贈叔父邵陵王綸太宰，諡曰壯武。
manualTranslations.literal: He also posthumously granted his uncle Prince of Shaoling Xiao Lun the post of Grand Mentor, with the posthumous title Zhuangwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also posthumously granted his uncle Prince of Shaoling Xiao Lun the post of Grand Mentor, with the posthumous title Zhuangwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈兄河東王譽丞相，諡曰武桓。
manualTranslations.literal: He granted his elder brother Prince of Hedong Xiao Yu the post of Chancellor, with the posthumous title Wuhuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He granted his elder brother Prince of Hedong Xiao Yu the post of chancellor, with the posthumous title Wuhuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖乃置江陵防主，統兵居於西城，名曰助防。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Ancestor then appointed a defense commander for Jiangling, who commanded troops stationed in the western city under the title Assistant Defense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestor then appointed a defense commander for Jiangling who garrisoned troops in the western city under the title Assistant Defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 外示助詧備禦，內實兼防詧也。
manualTranslations.literal: Outwardly this displayed assistance to Cha in defense, but in truth it also guarded against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Outwardly this was presented as helping Xiao Cha with defense, but in truth it also kept watch over him.

manualTranslations.literal: Cha regarded Xiangyang as a place of strategic strength and also as the site where Emperor Wu of Liang had founded his power. manualTranslations.zh: 機辯有文學。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was skilled at winning men over and could secure the loyalty of those below him.

manualTranslations.zh: 嗣位之元年，尊其祖母龔太后曰太皇太后，嫡母王皇后曰皇太后，所生曹貴嬪曰皇太妃。

manualTranslations.zh: 其年五月，其太皇太后薨，諡曰元太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of that year the Grand Empress Dowager died; she was given the posthumous title Empress Dowager Yuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year the grand empress dowager died and was given the posthumous title Empress Dowager Yuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，其太妃又薨，諡曰孝皇太妃。

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，皇太后薨，諡曰宣靜皇后。

sourceRange.text: 魏孝昌中，有劉蠡升者，居雲陽谷，自稱天子，立年號，署百官。屬魏氏政亂，力不能討。蠡升遂分遣部眾，抄掠居民，汾、晉之間，畧無寧歲。齊神武遷鄴後，始密圖之。偽許以女妻蠡升太子，蠡升信之，遂遣其子詣鄴。齊神武厚為之禮，緩以婚期。蠡升既恃和親，不為之備。大統元年三月，齊神武潛師襲之。蠡升率輕騎出外徵兵，為其北部王所殺，斬首送於齊神武。其眾復立蠡升第三子南海王為主，率兵拒戰。齊神武擊滅之，獲其偽主，及其弟西海王，并皇后夫人王公以下四百餘人，歸於鄴。

context.beforeSource: 而凶悍恃險，數為寇亂。
context.afterSource: 居河西者，多恃險不賓。

context.afterLocal: 居河西者，多恃險不賓。

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝昌中，有劉蠡升者，居雲陽谷，自稱天子，立年號，署百官。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Wei Xiaochang era there was Liu Lisheng, who dwelt in Yunyang Valley, styled himself Son of Heaven, established an era name, and appointed the full bureaucracy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Wei Xiaochang era Liu Lisheng lived in Yunyang Valley, declared himself emperor, adopted an era name, and set up a full court.

manualTranslations.zh: 屬魏氏政亂，力不能討。
manualTranslations.literal: As the Wei house was in political disorder, they lacked the strength to suppress him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Wei in turmoil, the court lacked the strength to suppress him.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠡升遂分遣部眾，抄掠居民，汾、晉之間，畧無寧歲。
manualTranslations.literal: Lisheng then dispatched his followers in detachments to raid and plunder the people; between Fen and Jin there were scarcely any peaceful years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lisheng sent his bands to raid the countryside, and between Fen and Jin there was scarcely a peaceful year.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武遷鄴後，始密圖之。
manualTranslations.literal: After Qi Shenwu moved the capital to Ye, he first began to plot against him in secret.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Qi Shenwu moved to Ye, he began secretly planning against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 偽許以女妻蠡升太子，蠡升信之，遂遣其子詣鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: He falsely promised his daughter in marriage to Lisheng's heir; Lisheng believed it and sent his son to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He falsely promised his daughter to Lisheng's crown prince; Lisheng believed him and sent his son to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武厚為之禮，緩以婚期。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi Shenwu treated him with great courtesy and delayed the wedding date.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi Shenwu received him lavishly and kept postponing the wedding.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠡升既恃和親，不為之備。
manualTranslations.literal: Lisheng, relying on the marriage alliance, made no preparations against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Trusting the marriage alliance, Lisheng made no defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 大統元年三月，齊神武潛師襲之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Datong, Qi Shenwu secretly led troops to strike him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of Datong year one, Qi Shenwu launched a surprise attack.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠡升率輕騎出外徵兵，為其北部王所殺，斬首送於齊神武。
manualTranslations.literal: Lisheng led light cavalry out to levy troops and was killed by his northern king; his head was cut off and sent to Qi Shenwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lisheng rode out with light cavalry to raise troops and was killed by his northern king; his head was sent to Qi Shenwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 其眾復立蠡升第三子南海王為主，率兵拒戰。
manualTranslations.literal: His followers again set up Lisheng's third son, the Prince of Nanhai, as ruler and led troops to resist.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His followers installed Lisheng's third son, the Prince of Nanhai, as ruler and fought back.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊神武擊滅之，獲其偽主，及其弟西海王，并皇后夫人王公以下四百餘人，歸於鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi Shenwu struck and destroyed them, capturing the false ruler, his younger brother the Prince of Xihai, and the empress, consorts, princes, and officials below them—more than four hundred persons—and brought them back to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi Shenwu crushed them, capturing the pretender, his brother the Prince of Xihai, the empress, consorts, princes, and officials—more than four hundred people in all—and brought them to Ye.

sourceRange.text: 先是，氐首楊法深據陰平自稱〔王〕，亦盛之苗裔也。魏孝昌中，舉眾內附。自是職貢不絕。廢帝元年，以法深為黎州刺史。二年，楊辟邪據州反，羣氐復與同逆。詔叱羅協與趙昶討平之。太祖乃以大將軍宇文貴為大都督、六州諸軍事、興州刺史。貴威名先著，羣氐頗畏服之。是歲，楊法深從尉遲迥平蜀，軍回，法深旋鎮。尋與其種人楊崇集、楊陳侳各擁其眾，遞相攻討。趙昶時督成武沙三州諸軍事、成州刺史，遣使和解之。法深等從命。乃分其部落，更置州郡以處之。

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，氐首楊法深據陰平自稱王，亦盛之苗裔也。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier the Di chieftain Yang Fashen had held Yinping and styled himself king; he too was a descendant of Sheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier the Di chieftain Yang Fashen had seized Yinping and declared himself king; he too descended from Yang Sheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏孝昌中，舉眾內附。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Wei Xiaochang era he brought his following inward in submission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Wei Xiaochang era he submitted with his followers.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是職貢不絕。
manualTranslations.literal: From then on tribute and service never ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From then on tribute never ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢帝元年，以法深為黎州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Fei, Fashen was made Governor of Li Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei, Yang Fashen was appointed Governor of Li Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，楊辟邪據州反，羣氐復與同逆。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year Yang Bixie seized the prefecture and rebelled; the Di clans again joined the revolt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year Yang Bixie rebelled and seized the prefecture, and the Di clans joined him.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔叱羅協與趙昶討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Chiluo Xie and Zhao Chang to campaign and pacify them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chiluo Xie and Zhao Chang to suppress the rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖乃以大將軍宇文貴為大都督、六州諸軍事、興州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Progenitor then appointed Grand General Yuwen Gui grand commander over the six prefectures' military affairs and Governor of Xing Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Grand Progenitor appointed Grand General Yuwen Gui grand commander of military affairs for six prefectures and Governor of Xing Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 貴威名先著，羣氐頗畏服之。
manualTranslations.literal: Gui's martial renown was already established, and the Di clans greatly feared and submitted to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gui's fame had long preceded him, and the Di clans feared and obeyed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，楊法深從尉遲迥平蜀，軍回，法深旋鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Yang Fashen followed Yu Chijiong in pacifying Shu; when the army returned, Fashen resumed his garrison command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Yang Fashen followed Yu Chijiong in the Shu campaign; when the army returned, he resumed his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋與其種人楊崇集、楊陳侳各擁其眾，遞相攻討。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he and his tribesmen Yang Chongji and Yang Chenzhuang each held their own followings and attacked one another in turn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he and his kinsmen Yang Chongji and Yang Chenzhuang each raised followers and fought one another in turn.

manualTranslations.zh: 趙昶時督成武沙三州諸軍事、成州刺史，遣使和解之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao Chang then supervised military affairs for the three prefectures of Cheng, Wu, and Sha and was Governor of Cheng Prefecture; he sent envoys to mediate peace among them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Chang, then commanding military affairs for Cheng, Wu, and Sha and serving as Governor of Cheng, sent envoys to mediate.

manualTranslations.zh: 法深等從命。
manualTranslations.literal: Fashen and the others obeyed the order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fashen and the others obeyed.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃分其部落，更置州郡以處之。
manualTranslations.literal: They then divided their tribes and resettled them by establishing new prefectures and commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Their tribes were then divided and resettled under newly established prefectures and commanderies.
